1→/**
     2→ * Global Settings Write Queue
     3→ *
     4→ * Prevents network exhaustion by serializing and coalescing settings writes.
     5→ *
     6→ * Features:
     7→ * - Global concurrency limit (default: 1 in-flight write)
     8→ * - Per-target debouncing (coalesces rapid updates)
     9→ * - Merge-on-write (latest patch wins per field)
    10→ * - Optional AbortSignal passthrough for caller cancellation
    11→ * - Best-effort flush on page unload
    12→ *
    13→ * @see settings_system.md for the full settings architecture
    14→ */
    15→
    16→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    17→
    18→export interface QueuedWrite {
    19→  scope: 'user' | 'project' | 'shot';
    20→  entityId: string;
    21→  toolId: string;
    22→  patch: Record<string, unknown>;
    23→  signal?: AbortSignal;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface PendingWrite {
    27→  write: QueuedWrite;
    28→  resolvers: Array<{ resolve: (value: unknown) => void; reject: (error: unknown) => void }>;
    29→  timerId: NodeJS.Timeout | null;
    30→  enqueuedAt: number;
    31→}
    32→
    33→// Configuration
    34→const DEBOUNCE_MS = 300;
    35→const MAX_CONCURRENT = 1;
    36→
    37→// State
    38→const pendingByTarget = new Map<string, PendingWrite>();
    39→let inFlightCount = 0;
    40→const flushQueue: Array<{ targetKey: string; pending: PendingWrite }> = [];
    41→
    42→// The actual write function - injected to avoid circular imports
    43→let writeFunction: ((write: QueuedWrite) => Promise<unknown>) | null = null;
    44→
    45→function createAbortError(): Error {
    46→  if (typeof DOMException !== 'undefined') {
    47→    return new DOMException('Request was cancelled', 'AbortError');
    48→  }
    49→  const error = new Error('Request was cancelled');
    50→  error.name = 'AbortError';
    51→  return error;
    52→}
    53→
    54→function throwIfAborted(signal?: AbortSignal): void {
    55→  if (signal?.aborted) {
    56→    throw createAbortError();
    57→  }
    58→}
    59→
    60→/**
    61→ * Set the write function that performs the actual DB update.
    62→ * Must be called once at app init (in useToolSettings.ts).
    63→ * Also registers page-unload listeners on first call (deferred from module load).
    64→ */
    65→export function setSettingsWriteFunction(fn: (write: QueuedWrite) => Promise<unknown>) {
    66→  const isFirstInit = writeFunction === null;
    67→  writeFunction = fn;
    68→
    69→  if (isFirstInit && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    70→    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
    71→      flushAll();
    72→    });
    73→    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    74→      if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {
    75→        flushAll();
    76→      }
    77→    });
    78→  }
    79→}
    80→
    81→/**
    82→ * Create a unique key for deduplication
    83→ */
    84→function targetKey(write: QueuedWrite): string {
    85→  return `${write.scope}:${write.entityId}:${write.toolId}`;
    86→}
    87→
    88→/**
    89→ * Shallow merge (one level deep)
    90→ */
    91→function shallowMergePatch(existing: Record<string, unknown>, incoming: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
    92→  return { ...existing, ...incoming };
    93→}
    94→
    95→/**
    96→ * Process the next item in the flush queue
    97→ */
    98→async function processQueue() {
    99→  if (inFlightCount >= MAX_CONCURRENT || flushQueue.length === 0) {
   100→    return;
   101→  }
   102→
   103→  const next = flushQueue.shift();
   104→  if (!next) return;
   105→
   106→  const { targetKey: key, pending } = next;
   107→  
   108→  // Remove from pending map (we're about to process it)
   109→  pendingByTarget.delete(key);
   110→  
   111→  inFlightCount++;
   112→  
   113→  try {
   114→    if (!writeFunction) {
   115→      throw new Error('[SettingsWriteQueue] Write function not initialized');
   116→    }
   117→
   118→    throwIfAborted(pending.write.signal);
   119→    const result = await writeFunction(pending.write);
   120→    
   121→    // Resolve all waiters
   122→    for (const { resolve } of pending.resolvers) {
   123→      resolve(result);
   124→    }
   125→  } catch (error) {
   126→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'SettingsWriteQueue', showToast: false });
   127→
   128→    // Reject all waiters
   129→    for (const { reject } of pending.resolvers) {
   130→      reject(error);
   131→    }
   132→  } finally {
   133→    inFlightCount--;
   134→    
   135→    // Process next item
   136→    processQueue();
   137→  }
   138→}
   139→
   140→/**
   141→ * Schedule a pending write for flush
   142→ */
   143→function scheduleFlush(key: string, pending: PendingWrite) {
   144→  // Clear existing timer
   145→  if (pending.timerId) {
   146→    clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
   147→    pending.timerId = null;
   148→  }
   149→  
   150→  // Add to flush queue and process
   151→  flushQueue.push({ targetKey: key, pending });
   152→  processQueue();
   153→}
   154→
   155→/**
   156→ * Enqueue a settings write.
   157→ * 
   158→ * Returns a promise that resolves when the write completes.
   159→ * Multiple writes to the same target within the debounce window are merged.
   160→ * 
   161→ * @param write - The write to enqueue
   162→ * @param mode - 'debounced' (default) waits for debounce window; 'immediate' flushes now
   163→ */
   164→export function enqueueSettingsWrite(
   165→  write: QueuedWrite,
   166→  mode: 'debounced' | 'immediate' = 'debounced'
   167→): Promise<unknown> {
   168→  const key = targetKey(write);
   169→
   170→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
   171→    if (write.signal?.aborted) {
   172→      reject(createAbortError());
   173→      return;
   174→    }
   175→
   176→    const existing = pendingByTarget.get(key);
   177→
   178→    if (existing) {
   179→      // Merge with existing pending write
   180→      existing.write.patch = shallowMergePatch(existing.write.patch, write.patch);
   181→      if (write.signal) {
   182→        existing.write.signal = write.signal;
   183→      }
   184→      existing.resolvers.push({ resolve, reject });
   185→
   186→      if (mode === 'immediate') {
   187→        // Cancel debounce timer and flush now
   188→        scheduleFlush(key, existing);
   189→      }
   190→      // else: existing timer will handle it
   191→      
   192→    } else {
   193→      // Create new pending write
   194→      const pending: PendingWrite = {
   195→        write: { ...write, patch: { ...write.patch } },
   196→        resolvers: [{ resolve, reject }],
   197→        timerId: null,
   198→        enqueuedAt: Date.now(),
   199→      };
   200→
   201→      pendingByTarget.set(key, pending);
   202→
   203→      if (mode === 'immediate') {
   204→        scheduleFlush(key, pending);
   205→      } else {
   206→        // Set debounce timer
   207→        pending.timerId = setTimeout(() => {
   208→          scheduleFlush(key, pending);
   209→        }, DEBOUNCE_MS);
   210→      }
   211→    }
   212→  });
   213→}
   214→
   215→
   216→/**
   217→ * Flush all pending writes immediately.
   218→ * Best-effort: returns without waiting.
   219→ */
   220→function flushAll(): void {
   221→  for (const [key, pending] of pendingByTarget.entries()) {
   222→    if (pending.timerId) {
   223→      clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
   224→      pending.timerId = null;
   225→    }
   226→    flushQueue.push({ targetKey: key, pending });
   227→  }
   228→  pendingByTarget.clear();
   229→  processQueue();
   230→}
   231→
   232→

    28→
    29→/**
    30→ * Preload task mappings for a batch of generations in the background.
    31→ */
    32→export async function preloadGenerationTaskMappings(
    33→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    34→  generationIds: string[],
    35→  options: PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions = {},
    36→) {
    37→  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
    38→  const {
    39→    batchSize = 5,
    40→    delayBetweenBatches = 200,
    41→    preloadFullTaskData = false,
    42→    projectId,
    43→  } = options;
    44→
    45→  for (let i = 0; i < generationIds.length; i += batchSize) {
    46→    const batch = generationIds.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    47→
    48→    const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(batch, { projectId });
    49→    let reportedBatchQueryFailure = false;
    50→
    51→    const prefetchTasks: Array<Promise<unknown>> = [];
    52→
    53→    batch.forEach((generationId) => {
    54→      const mapping = mappings.get(generationId);
    55→      const cacheEntry = toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry(mapping);
    56→      queryClient.setQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
    57→        taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
    58→        cacheEntry,
    59→      );
    60→
    61→      if (!reportedBatchQueryFailure && cacheEntry.status === 'query_failed' && cacheEntry.queryError) {
    62→        reportedBatchQueryFailure = true;
    63→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(cacheEntry.queryError), {
    64→          context: 'GenerationTaskCache',
    65→          showToast: false,
    66→        });
    67→      }
    68→
    69→      if (preloadFullTaskData && cacheEntry.taskId && cacheEntry.status === 'ok') {
    70→        prefetchTasks.push(queryClient.prefetchQuery({
    71→          [REDACTED](cacheEntry.taskId),
    72→          queryFn: async () => {
    73→            const { data, error } = await supabase
    74→              .from('tasks')
    75→              .select('*')
    76→              .eq('id', cacheEntry.taskId)
    77→              .single();
    78→
    79→            if (error) throw error;
    80→            if (!isTaskDbRow(data)) {
    81→              throw new Error('Task row has unexpected shape');
    82→            }
    83→            return mapTaskDbRowToTask(data);
    84→          },
    85→          staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000,
    86→        }));
    87→      }
    88→    });
    89→
    90→    if (prefetchTasks.length > 0) {
    91→      await Promise.all(prefetchTasks);
    92→    }
    93→
    94→    if (i + batchSize < generationIds.length) {
    95→      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayBetweenBatches));
    96→    }
    97→  }
    98→}

   100→export function mergeGenerationsWithTaskData(
   101→  generations: GenerationRow[],

   103→): GenerationWithTaskData[] {

   107→      taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),

   111→    const taskMappingStatus = cachedMapping?.status ?? (taskId ? 'ok' : 'not_loaded');
   112→
   113→    return {
   114→      ...generation,
   115→      taskId,
   116→      taskData,
   117→      taskMappingStatus,
   118→      ...(cachedMapping?.queryError ? { taskMappingError: cachedMapping.queryError } : {}),
   119→    };
   120→  });
   121→}

    18→    return bootstrap.response;
    19→  }
    20→  const { supabaseAdmin, logger, auth, body } = bootstrap.value;
    21→  if (!auth?.userId) {
    22→    logger.error('Authentication failed');
    23→    await logger.flush();
    24→    return jsonResponse({ error: 'Authentication failed' }, 401);
    25→  }
    26→
    27→  try {
    28→    const tokenId = typeof body.tokenId === 'string' ? body.tokenId : null;
    29→
    30→    if (!tokenId) {
    31→      logger.error('Missing credential identifier');
    32→      await logger.flush();
    33→      return jsonResponse({ error: 'tokenId is required' }, 400);
    34→    }
    35→
    36→    // Delete the token (RLS will ensure user can only delete their own)
    37→    const { error: deleteError } = await supabaseAdmin
    38→      .from('user_api_tokens')
    39→      .delete()
    40→      .eq('id', tokenId)
    41→      .eq('user_id', auth.userId); // Extra safety check
    42→
    43→    if (deleteError) {
    44→      logger.error('Failed to revoke API credential', { error: deleteError.message });
    45→      await logger.flush();
    46→      return jsonResponse({ error: 'Failed to revoke token' }, 500);
    47→    }
    48→
    49→    logger.info('Revoked API credential', { user_id: auth.userId });
    50→    await logger.flush();
    51→    return jsonResponse({ success: true });
    52→  } catch (error: unknown) {
    53→    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error';
    54→    logger.error('Error in revoke-pat', { error: message });
    55→    await logger.flush();
    56→    return jsonResponse({ error: message }, 500);
    57→  }
    58→});

    64→    super(`Timeline write "${operation}" timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms`);
    65→    this.name = 'TimelineWriteTimeoutError';
    66→    if (cause !== undefined) {
    67→      (this as { cause?: unknown }).cause = cause;
    68→    }
    69→  }
    70→}
    71→
    72→export function isTimelineWriteTimeoutError(error: unknown): error is TimelineWriteTimeoutError {
    73→  return (
    74→    error instanceof TimelineWriteTimeoutError
    75→    || (
    76→      typeof error === 'object'
    77→      && error !== null
    78→      && 'code' in error
    79→      && (error as { code?: unknown }).code === TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CODE
    80→    )
    81→  );
    82→}
    83→
    84→/**
    85→ * Guard a write request with an abortable timeout so stalled network calls
    86→ * cannot block the serialized per-shot queue forever.
    87→ */
    88→export async function runTimelineWriteWithTimeout<T>(
    89→  operation: string,
    90→  task: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>,
    91→  options?: TimelineWriteTimeoutOptions,
    92→): Promise<T> {
    93→  const timeoutMs = options?.timeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_MS;
    94→  const startedAt = Date.now();
    95→  const controller = new AbortController();
    96→  let timedOut = false;
    97→
    98→  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
    99→    timedOut = true;
   100→    options?.onTimeout?.({
   101→      operation,
   102→      timeoutMs,
   103→      pendingMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
   104→    });
   105→    controller.abort();
   106→  }, timeoutMs);
   107→
   108→  try {
   109→    return await task(controller.signal);
   110→  } catch (error) {
   111→    if (timedOut || (controller.signal.aborted && isAbortError(error))) {
   112→      throw new TimelineWriteTimeoutError(operation, timeoutMs, error);
   113→    }
   114→    throw error;
   115→  } finally {
   116→    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
   117→  }
   118→}
   119→
   120→const shotWriteTail = new Map<string, Promise<void>>();
   121→const shotWriteDepth = new Map<string, number>();
   122→const shotWriteActive = new Map<string, { requestId: number; operation: string; startedAt: number }>();
   123→let writeRequestCounter = 0;
   124→const DEFAULT_SERIALIZED_TIMELINE_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;
   125→
   126→interface TimelineSerializedWriteOptions {
   127→  timeoutMs?: number;
   128→  onTimeout?: (meta: {
   129→    shotId: string;
   130→    operation: string;
   131→    timeoutMs: number;
   132→    pendingMs: number;
   133→    requestId: number;
   134→  }) => void;
   135→}
   136→
   137→function runSerializedTaskWithTimeout<T>(
   138→  operation: string,
   139→  task: () => Promise<T>,
   140→  timeoutMs: number,
   141→  onTimeout: () => void,
   142→): Promise<T> {
   143→  if (timeoutMs <= 0) {
   144→    return task();
   145→  }
   146→
   147→  return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
   148→    let settled = false;
   149→    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
   150→      if (settled) {
   151→        return;
   152→      }
   153→      settled = true;
   154→      onTimeout();
   155→      reject(new TimelineWriteTimeoutError(operation, timeoutMs));
   156→    }, timeoutMs);
   157→
   158→    Promise.resolve()
   159→      .then(task)
   160→      .then(
   161→        (result) => {
   162→          if (settled) {
   163→            return;
   164→          }
   165→          settled = true;
   166→          clearTimeout(timeoutId);
   167→          resolve(result);
   168→        },
   169→        (error) => {
   170→          if (settled) {
   171→            return;
   172→          }
   173→          settled = true;
   174→          clearTimeout(timeoutId);
   175→          reject(error);
   176→        },
   177→      );
   178→  });
   179→}
   180→
   181→/**
   182→ * Returns true if any serialized timeline write is active or queued for the
   183→ * given shot. Both the timeline drag path and the batch editor path go through
   184→ * runSerializedTimelineWrite, so this covers all writes across both paths.
   185→ * Used by useTimelinePositions.syncFromDatabase to suppress stale syncs while
   186→ * the batch editor is writing (the batch editor does not set isLockedRef, so
   187→ * without this check a background refetch during the midpoint RPC would snap
   188→ * positions back to pre-edit values).
   189→ */
   190→export function isTimelineWriteActive(shotId: string): boolean {
   191→  return (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 0) > 0;
   192→}
   193→
   194→/**
   195→ * Serialize timeline writes per shot to avoid overlapping updates from
   196→ * different UI flows (batch reorder, timeline drag, etc.).
   197→ */
   198→export async function runSerializedTimelineWrite<T>(
   199→  shotId: string,
   200→  operation: string,
   201→  task: () => Promise<T>,
   202→  onEvent?: TimelineWriteEventHandler,
   203→  options?: TimelineSerializedWriteOptions,
   204→): Promise<T> {
   205→  const requestId = ++writeRequestCounter;
   206→  const queuedAt = Date.now();
   207→  const previousTail = shotWriteTail.get(shotId) ?? Promise.resolve();
   208→  const nextDepth = (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 0) + 1;
   209→  shotWriteDepth.set(shotId, nextDepth);
   210→  const blockedBy = shotWriteActive.get(shotId);
   211→  const blockedByDurationMs = blockedBy ? Math.max(0, queuedAt - blockedBy.startedAt) : null;
   212→
   213→  onEvent?.('queued', {
   214→    shotId,
   215→    operation,
   216→    waitMs: 0,
   217→    durationMs: 0,
   218→    queueDepth: Math.max(0, nextDepth - 1),
   219→    requestId,
   220→    blockedByOperation: blockedBy?.operation ?? null,
   221→    blockedByDurationMs,
   222→  });
   223→
   224→  let releaseTail!: () => void;
   225→  const currentTail = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
   226→    releaseTail = resolve;
   227→  });
   228→
   229→  const chainedTail = previousTail.catch(() => undefined).then(() => currentTail);
   230→  shotWriteTail.set(shotId, chainedTail);
   231→
   232→  await previousTail.catch(() => undefined);
   233→
   234→  const startedAt = Date.now();
   235→  shotWriteActive.set(shotId, {
   236→    requestId,
   237→    operation,
   238→    startedAt,
   239→  });
   240→  onEvent?.('start', {
   241→    shotId,
   242→    operation,
   243→    waitMs: startedAt - queuedAt,
   244→    durationMs: 0,
   245→    queueDepth: Math.max(0, (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 1) - 1),
   246→    requestId,
   247→    blockedByOperation: blockedBy?.operation ?? null,
   248→    blockedByDurationMs,
   249→  });
   250→
   251→  try {
   252→    const timeoutMs = options?.timeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_SERIALIZED_TIMELINE_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS;
   253→    return await runSerializedTaskWithTimeout(
   254→      operation,
   255→      task,
   256→      timeoutMs,
   257→      () => {
   258→        options?.onTimeout?.({
   259→          shotId,
   260→          operation,
   261→          timeoutMs,
   262→          pendingMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
   263→          requestId,
   264→        });
   265→      },
   266→    );
   267→  } finally {
   268→    releaseTail();
   269→
   270→    const remainingDepth = Math.max(0, (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 1) - 1);
   271→    if (remainingDepth === 0) {
   272→      shotWriteDepth.delete(shotId);
   273→    } else {
   274→      shotWriteDepth.set(shotId, remainingDepth);
   275→    }
   276→
   277→    if (shotWriteTail.get(shotId) === chainedTail) {
   278→      shotWriteTail.delete(shotId);
   279→    }
   280→    if (shotWriteActive.get(shotId)?.requestId === requestId) {
   281→      shotWriteActive.delete(shotId);
   282→    }
   283→
   284→    onEvent?.('end', {
   285→      shotId,
   286→      operation,
   287→      waitMs: startedAt - queuedAt,
   288→      durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
   289→      queueDepth: Math.max(0, remainingDepth - 1),
   290→      requestId,
   291→      blockedByOperation: blockedBy?.operation ?? null,
   292→      blockedByDurationMs,
   293→    });
   294→  }
   295→}

1→type ManagedDebugGlobalKey =
     2→  | '__supabase_client__'
     3→  | 'supabase'
     4→  | '__RECONNECT_SCHEDULER__'
     5→  | '__DATA_FRESHNESS_MANAGER__';
     6→
     7→interface ActiveRegistration {
     8→  owner: string;
     9→  value: unknown;
    10→}
    11→
    12→const activeRegistrations = new Map<ManagedDebugGlobalKey, ActiveRegistration>();
    13→
    14→function hasWindow(): boolean {
    15→  return typeof window !== 'undefined';
    16→}
    17→
    18→export function registerDebugGlobal<K extends ManagedDebugGlobalKey>(
    19→  key: K,
    20→  value: NonNullable<Window[K]>,
    21→  owner: string,
    22→): () => void {
    23→  if (!hasWindow()) {
    24→    return () => {};
    25→  }
    26→
    27→  const globalWindow = window as Window;
    28→  const hadPrevious = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(globalWindow, key);
    29→  const previousValue = globalWindow[key];
    30→  const previousRegistration = activeRegistrations.get(key) ?? null;
    31→
    32→  globalWindow[key] = value;
    33→  activeRegistrations.set(key, { owner, value });
    34→
    35→  let disposed = false;
    36→  return () => {
    37→    if (disposed || !hasWindow()) {
    38→      return;
    39→    }
    40→    disposed = true;
    41→
    42→    const currentRegistration = activeRegistrations.get(key);
    43→    if (!currentRegistration || currentRegistration.value !== value) {
    44→      return;
    45→    }
    46→
    47→    if (previousRegistration) {
    48→      globalWindow[key] = previousRegistration.value as Window[K];
    49→      activeRegistrations.set(key, previousRegistration);
    50→      return;
    51→    }
    52→
    53→    if (hadPrevious) {
    54→      globalWindow[key] = previousValue as Window[K];
    55→    } else {
    56→      delete (globalWindow as Partial<Record<ManagedDebugGlobalKey, unknown>>)[key];
    57→    }
    58→
    59→    activeRegistrations.delete(key);
    60→  };
    61→}
    62→
    63→export function getDebugGlobal<K extends ManagedDebugGlobalKey>(key: K): Window[K] | undefined {
    64→  if (!hasWindow()) {
    65→    return undefined;
    66→  }
    67→  return (window as Window)[key];
    68→}
    69→
    70→export function getDebugGlobalOwner([REDACTED]): string | null {
    71→  return activeRegistrations.get(key)?.owner ?? null;
    72→}
    73→

1→export interface PayloadFieldMapping<TSource> {
     2→  from: keyof TSource;

     5→  include?: (value: TSource[keyof TSource]) => boolean;

     7→
     8→export function mapDefinedPayloadFields<TSource extends object>(
     9→  source: TSource,
    10→  mappings: readonly PayloadFieldMapping<TSource>[],
    11→): Record<string, unknown> {
    12→  const mapped: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    13→
    14→  mappings.forEach((mapping) => {
    15→    const sourceValue = source[mapping.from];
    16→    if (sourceValue === undefined) {
    17→      return;
    18→    }
    19→
    20→    if (mapping.include && !mapping.include(sourceValue)) {
    21→      return;
    22→    }
    23→
    24→    const outputKey = mapping.to ?? String(mapping.from);
    25→    mapped[outputKey] = mapping.transform
    26→      ? mapping.transform(sourceValue)
    27→      : sourceValue;
    28→  });
    29→
    30→  return mapped;
    31→}
    32→

    36→  mappings: readonly PayloadFieldMapping<TSource>[],
    37→): void {
    38→  Object.assign(target, mapDefinedPayloadFields(source, mappings));

    38→ */
    39→export class NetworkError extends AppError {
    40→  /** Whether the user appears to be offline */
    41→  public readonly isOffline: boolean;
    42→  /** Whether this was a timeout */
    43→  public readonly isTimeout: boolean;
    44→
    45→  constructor(
    46→    message: string,
    47→    options?: {
    48→      isOffline?: boolean;
    49→      isTimeout?: boolean;
    50→      context?: Record<string, unknown>;
    51→      cause?: Error;
    52→    }
    53→  ) {
    54→    super(message, { showToast: true, ...options });
    55→    this.name = 'NetworkError';
    56→    this.isOffline = options?.isOffline ?? !navigator.onLine;
    57→    this.isTimeout = options?.isTimeout ?? false;
    58→  }
    59→
    60→  static fromError(error: Error, context?: Record<string, unknown>): NetworkError {
    61→    const isTimeout = error.name === 'AbortError' || error.message.includes('timeout');
    62→    const isOffline = !navigator.onLine;
    63→
    64→    let message = 'Network request failed';
    65→    if (isOffline) {
    66→      message = 'You appear to be offline. Please check your connection.';
    67→    } else if (isTimeout) {
    68→      message = 'Request timed out. Please try again.';
    69→    }
    70→
    71→    return new NetworkError(message, { isOffline, isTimeout, context, cause: error });
    72→  }
    73→}
    74→
    75→/**
    76→ * Authentication/authorization errors
    77→ * User needs to log in or doesn't have permission
    78→ */
    79→export class AuthError extends AppError {
    80→  /** Whether the user needs to log in (vs lacking permission) */
    81→  public readonly needsLogin: boolean;
    82→
    83→  constructor(
    84→    message: string,
    85→    options?: {
    86→      needsLogin?: boolean;
    87→      context?: Record<string, unknown>;
    88→      cause?: Error;
    89→    }
    90→  ) {
    91→    super(message, { showToast: true, ...options });
    92→    this.name = 'AuthError';
    93→    this.needsLogin = options?.needsLogin ?? true;
    94→  }
    95→
    96→  static fromError(error: Error, context?: Record<string, unknown>): AuthError {
    97→    const message = error.message.toLowerCase();
    98→    const needsLogin = message.includes('unauthorized') || message.includes('not authenticated');
    99→
   100→    return new AuthError(
   101→      needsLogin ? 'Please log in to continue' : 'You don\'t have permission for this action',
   102→      { needsLogin, context, cause: error }
   103→    );
   104→  }
   105→}
   106→
   107→/**
   108→ * Validation errors (invalid input, missing required fields)
   109→ * These are user errors that can be corrected
   110→ */
   111→export class ValidationError extends AppError {
   112→  /** The field that failed validation, if applicable */
   113→  public readonly field?: string;
   114→
   115→  constructor(
   116→    message: string,
   117→    options?: {
   118→      field?: string;
   119→      context?: Record<string, unknown>;
   120→      cause?: Error;
   121→    }
   122→  ) {
   123→    super(message, { showToast: true, ...options });
   124→    this.name = 'ValidationError';
   125→    this.field = options?.field;
   126→  }
   127→}
   128→
   129→/**
   130→ * Server/API errors (5xx responses, unexpected server behavior)
   131→ * These are typically not the user's fault
   132→ */
   133→export class ServerError extends AppError {
   134→  /** HTTP status code if available */
   135→  public readonly statusCode?: number;
   136→
   137→  constructor(
   138→    message: string,
   139→    options?: {
   140→      statusCode?: number;
   141→      context?: Record<string, unknown>;
   142→      cause?: Error;
   143→    }
   144→  ) {
   145→    super(message, { showToast: true, ...options });
   146→    this.name = 'ServerError';
   147→    this.statusCode = options?.statusCode;
   148→  }
   149→}
   150→
   151→/**
   152→ * Errors that should be silently logged (not shown to user)
   153→ * Use for expected failures like localStorage unavailable, optional features
   154→ */
   155→export class SilentError extends AppError {
   156→  constructor(
   157→    message: string,
   158→    options?: {
   159→      context?: Record<string, unknown>;
   160→      cause?: Error;
   161→    }
   162→  ) {
   163→    super(message, { showToast: false, ...options });
   164→    this.name = 'SilentError';
   165→  }
   166→}
   167→
   168→/**
   169→ * Type guard to check if an error is one of our app errors
   170→ */
   171→export function isAppError(error: unknown): error is AppError {
   172→  return error instanceof AppError;
   173→}
   174→
   175→/**
   176→ * Type guard to check if an error is a network error
   177→ */
   178→export function isNetworkError(error: unknown): error is NetworkError {
   179→  return error instanceof NetworkError;
   180→}
   181→
   182→/**
   183→ * Type guard to check if an error is an auth error
   184→ */
   185→export function isAuthError(error: unknown): error is AuthError {
   186→  return error instanceof AuthError;
   187→}
   188→
   189→/**
   190→ * Categorize an unknown error into an appropriate AppError type
   191→ */
   192→export function categorizeError(error: unknown, context?: Record<string, unknown>): AppError {
   193→  // Already an AppError
   194→  if (isAppError(error)) {
   195→    return error;
   196→  }
   197→
   198→  // Convert to Error if needed
   199→  const err = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
   200→  const message = err.message.toLowerCase();
   201→
   202→  // Network errors
   203→  if (
   204→    err.name === 'AbortError' ||
   205→    message.includes('network') ||
   206→    message.includes('fetch') ||
   207→    message.includes('timeout') ||
   208→    message.includes('failed to fetch') ||
   209→    !navigator.onLine
   210→  ) {
   211→    return NetworkError.fromError(err, context);
   212→  }
   213→
   214→  // Auth errors
   215→  if (
   216→    message.includes('unauthorized') ||
   217→    message.includes('forbidden') ||
   218→    message.includes('not authenticated') ||
   219→    message.includes('authentication required')
   220→  ) {
   221→    return AuthError.fromError(err, context);
   222→  }
   223→
   224→  // Validation errors
   225→  if (
   226→    message.includes('required') ||
   227→    message.includes('invalid') ||
   228→    message.includes('validation')
   229→  ) {
   230→    return new ValidationError(err.message, { context, cause: err });
   231→  }
   232→
   233→  // Default to generic AppError
   234→  return new AppError(err.message, { context, cause: err });
   235→}
   236→

     9→
    10→/**
    11→ * Creates a task using the unified create-task edge function.
    12→ */
    13→export async function createTask(taskParams: BaseTaskParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
    14→  // Read access token from localStorage — avoids navigator.locks contention.
    15→  // getSession() acquires a shared navigator.lock blocked during token refresh.
    16→  const [REDACTED]();
    17→
    18→  if (!accessToken) {
    19→    throw new AuthError('Please log in to create tasks', { needsLogin: true });
    20→  }
    21→
    22→  const startTime = Date.now();
    23→  const requestId = `${startTime}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
    24→  const requestContext = {
    25→    requestId,
    26→    taskType: taskParams.task_type,
    27→    projectId: taskParams.project_id,
    28→  };
    29→  const timeoutMs = 20000; // 20s safety timeout to avoid indefinite UI stall
    30→  const controller = new AbortController();
    31→  const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
    32→    controller.abort();
    33→  }, timeoutMs);
    34→
    35→  try {
    36→    // Generate an idempotency key to prevent duplicate task creation from
    37→    // network retries or double-clicks. The server will return the existing
    38→    // task if this key was already used.
    39→    const idempotency_key = generateUUID();
    40→
    41→    const response = await fetch(`${getSupabaseUrl()}/functions/v1/create-task`, {
    42→      method: 'POST',
    43→      headers: {
    44→        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    45→        Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
    46→        [REDACTED](),
    47→      },
    48→      body: JSON.stringify({
    49→        params: taskParams.params,
    50→        task_type: taskParams.task_type,
    51→        project_id: taskParams.project_id,
    52→        dependant_on: null,
    53→        idempotency_key,
    54→      }),
    55→      signal: controller.signal,
    56→    });
    57→
    58→    if (!response.ok) {
    59→      const errorText = await response.text().catch(() => '');
    60→      throw new ServerError(errorText || 'Failed to create task', {
    61→        context: requestContext,
    62→      });
    63→    }
    64→
    65→    const data = await response.json() as unknown;
    66→    return parseTaskCreationResponse(data, requestContext);
    67→  } catch (err: unknown) {
    68→    const context = {
    69→      requestId,
    70→      taskType: taskParams.task_type,
    71→      projectId: taskParams.project_id,
    72→      durationMs: Date.now() - startTime,
    73→    };
    74→
    75→    if (import.meta.env.DEV) {
    76→      console.error('[createTask] invoke FAILED', context, err);

    79→    // Normalize abort errors for better UX

    83→        context,
    84→        cause: err instanceof Error ? err : undefined,
    85→      });
    86→    }

    88→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(err, {
    89→      context: 'TaskCreation',
    90→      showToast: false,
    91→      logData: context,
    92→    });
    93→  } finally {
    94→    clearTimeout(timeout);
    95→  }
    96→}

1→import { AppError, isNetworkError, SilentError } from './errors';
     2→
     3→const DEFAULT_ERROR_TITLES: Record<string, string> = {
     4→  NetworkError: 'Connection Error',
     5→  AuthError: 'Authentication Required',
     6→  ValidationError: 'Invalid Input',
     7→  ServerError: 'Server Error',
     8→  AppError: 'Error',
     9→};
    10→
    11→export function logAppError(context: string, appError: AppError): void {
    12→  if (appError instanceof SilentError) {
    13→    return;
    14→  }
    15→
    16→  const tag = `[${context}]`;
    17→  console.error(`${tag} ${appError.name}:`, appError.message, {
    18→    errorType: appError.name,
    19→    cause: appError.cause?.message,
    20→    ...appError.context,
    21→  });
    22→}
    23→
    24→export function getErrorTitle(appError: AppError, override?: string): string {
    25→  return override ?? DEFAULT_ERROR_TITLES[appError.name] ?? DEFAULT_ERROR_TITLES.AppError;
    26→}
    27→
    28→export function getErrorDescription(appError: AppError): string {
    29→  if (!isNetworkError(appError)) {
    30→    return appError.message;
    31→  }
    32→
    33→  if (appError.isOffline) {
    34→    return 'You appear to be offline. Please check your connection.';
    35→  }
    36→
    37→  if (appError.isTimeout) {
    38→    return 'Request timed out. Please try again.';
    39→  }
    40→
    41→  return appError.message;
    42→}
    43→

     3→import { runTaskCreationPipeline } from './taskCreatorPipeline';
     4→import { composeTaskRequest } from './taskRequestComposer';
     5→
     6→/**
     7→ * Parameters for creating an image upscale task
     8→ */
     9→interface ImageUpscaleTaskParams {
    10→  project_id: string;
    11→  image_url: string; // The source image to upscale
    12→  generation_id?: string | null; // Optional: the generation ID to update with upscaled URL
    13→  source_variant_id?: string; // Optional: track which variant was the source for lineage
    14→  scale_factor?: number; // Default to 2x upscaling
    15→  noise_scale?: number; // Default to 0.1
    16→  output_format?: string; // Default to "jpeg"
    17→  shot_id?: string; // Optional: associate with shot for navigation from TasksPane
    18→}
    19→
    20→/**
    21→ * Validates image upscale task parameters
    22→ * @param params - Parameters to validate
    23→ * @throws TaskValidationError if validation fails
    24→ */
    25→function validateImageUpscaleParams(params: ImageUpscaleTaskParams): void {
    26→  validateRequiredFields(params, ['project_id', 'image_url']);
    27→
    28→  if (params.image_url.trim() === '') {
    29→    throw new TaskValidationError('Image URL cannot be empty', 'image_url');
    30→  }
    31→
    32→  // Validate URL format
    33→  try {
    34→    new URL(params.image_url);
    35→  } catch {
    36→    throw new TaskValidationError('Image URL must be a valid URL', 'image_url');
    37→  }
    38→
    39→  if (params.scale_factor !== undefined && (params.scale_factor < 1 || params.scale_factor > 8)) {
    40→    throw new TaskValidationError('Scale factor must be between 1 and 8', 'scale_factor');
    41→  }
    42→}
    43→
    44→/**
    45→ * Builds the task params for an image-upscale task
    46→ */
    47→function buildImageUpscaleTaskParams(
    48→  params: ImageUpscaleTaskParams
    49→): Record<string, unknown> {
    50→  const taskParams: Record<string, unknown> = {
    51→    image: params.image_url,
    52→    scale_factor: params.scale_factor ?? 2,
    53→    noise_scale: params.noise_scale ?? 0.1,
    54→    output_format: params.output_format ?? "jpeg",
    55→  };
    56→
    57→  // Add generation_id to task params so the worker knows which generation to update
    58→  // Also add based_on for lineage tracking (same as inpaint and other edit tasks)
    59→  // is_primary=true makes the upscaled version the main display variant
    60→  if (params.generation_id) {
    61→    taskParams.generation_id = params.generation_id;
    62→    taskParams.based_on = params.generation_id;
    63→    taskParams.is_primary = true;
    64→  }
    65→
    66→  // Track source variant if enhancing from a specific variant
    67→  if (params.source_variant_id) {
    68→    taskParams.source_variant_id = params.source_variant_id;
    69→  }
    70→
    71→  if (params.shot_id) {
    72→    taskParams.shot_id = params.shot_id;
    73→  }
    74→
    75→  return taskParams;
    76→}
    77→
    78→/**
    79→ * Creates an image upscale task
    80→ * 
    81→ * @param params - Image upscale task parameters
    82→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
    83→ */
    84→export async function createImageUpscaleTask(params: ImageUpscaleTaskParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
    85→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({
    86→    params,
    87→    context: 'createImageUpscaleTask',
    88→    validate: validateImageUpscaleParams,
    89→    buildTaskRequest: (pipelineParams) => composeTaskRequest({
    90→      source: pipelineParams,
    91→      taskType: 'image-upscale',
    92→      params: buildImageUpscaleTaskParams(pipelineParams),
    93→    }),
    94→  });
    95→}

     6→
     7→interface ShotGenerationMetadata {
     8→  magicEditPrompts?: Array<{
     9→    prompt: string;
    10→    timestamp: string;
    11→    numImages?: number;
    12→    isNextSceneBoostEnabled?: boolean;

    24→
    25→interface UseShotGenerationMetadataOptions {
    26→  shotId: string;
    27→  shotGenerationId: string;
    28→  enabled?: boolean;
    29→}
    30→
    31→export function useShotGenerationMetadata({
    32→  shotId,
    33→  shotGenerationId,
    34→  enabled = true
    35→}: UseShotGenerationMetadataOptions) {
    36→  const [metadata, setMetadata] = useState<ShotGenerationMetadata>({});
    37→  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
    38→  const [isUpdating, setIsUpdating] = useState(false);
    39→  const invalidateGenerations = useInvalidateGenerations();
    40→
    41→  // Load metadata from database
    42→  useEffect(() => {
    43→
    44→    if (!enabled || !shotGenerationId) {
    45→      setIsLoading(false);
    46→      return;
    47→    }
    48→
    49→    let cancelled = false;
    50→
    51→    const loadMetadata = async () => {
    52→      try {
    53→        
    54→        const { data, error } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    55→          .select('metadata')
    56→          .eq('id', shotGenerationId)
    57→          .maybeSingle();
    58→
    59→        if (error) {
    60→          normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useShotGenerationMetadata.load', showToast: false, logData: { shotGenerationId: shotGenerationId.substring(0, 8) } });
    61→          if (!cancelled) {
    62→            setMetadata({});
    63→            setIsLoading(false);
    64→          }
    65→          return;
    66→        }
    67→
    68→        const loadedMetadata = (data?.metadata as ShotGenerationMetadata) || {};
    69→
    70→        if (!cancelled) {
    71→          setMetadata(loadedMetadata);
    72→          setIsLoading(false);
    73→        }
    74→      } catch (err) {
    75→        normalizeAndPresentError(err, { context: 'useShotGenerationMetadata.loadMetadata', showToast: false });
    76→        if (!cancelled) {
    77→          setMetadata({});
    78→          setIsLoading(false);
    79→        }
    80→      }
    81→    };
    82→
    83→    loadMetadata();
    84→    return () => { cancelled = true; };
    85→  }, [shotGenerationId, enabled]);
    86→
    87→  // Update metadata in database
    88→  const updateMetadata = useCallback(async (updates: Partial<ShotGenerationMetadata>) => {
    89→    
    90→    if (!shotGenerationId || isUpdating) {
    91→      return;
    92→    }
    93→
    94→    setIsUpdating(true);
    95→
    96→    try {
    97→      const newMetadata = { ...metadata, ...updates };
    98→      
    99→      const { error } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
   100→        .update({ metadata: toJson(newMetadata) })
   101→        .eq('id', shotGenerationId);
   102→
   103→      if (error) {
   104→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useShotGenerationMetadata.update', showToast: false, logData: { shotGenerationId: shotGenerationId.substring(0, 8) } });
   105→        throw error;
   106→      }
   107→
   108→      // Update local state
   109→      setMetadata(newMetadata);
   110→
   111→      // Invalidate related queries to trigger UI updates (only if shotId is available)
   112→      if (shotId) {
   113→        invalidateGenerations(shotId, {
   114→          reason: 'magic-edit-prompt-persist',
   115→          scope: 'all'
   116→        });
   117→      }
   118→
   119→    } catch (error) {
   120→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useShotGenerationMetadata.updateMetadata', showToast: false });
   121→      throw error;
   122→    } finally {
   123→      setIsUpdating(false);
   124→    }
   125→  }, [shotId, shotGenerationId, metadata, isUpdating, invalidateGenerations]);
   126→
   127→  // Convenience method to add a magic edit prompt
   128→  const addMagicEditPrompt = useCallback(async (
   129→    prompt: string, 
   130→    numImages?: number,
   131→    isNextSceneBoostEnabled?: boolean,
   132→    isInSceneBoostEnabled?: boolean
   133→  ) => {
   134→
   135→    const newPromptEntry = {
   136→      prompt,
   137→      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
   138→      numImages,
   139→      isNextSceneBoostEnabled,
   140→      isInSceneBoostEnabled
   141→    };
   142→
   143→    const existingPrompts = metadata.magicEditPrompts || [];
   144→    const updatedPrompts = [...existingPrompts, newPromptEntry];
   145→
   146→    // Keep only the last 10 prompts to prevent unbounded growth
   147→    const trimmedPrompts = updatedPrompts.slice(-10);
   148→
   149→    await updateMetadata({
   150→      magicEditPrompts: trimmedPrompts,
   151→      lastMagicEditPrompt: prompt,
   152→      lastMagicEditNumImages: numImages,
   153→      lastMagicEditNextSceneBoost: isNextSceneBoostEnabled,
   154→      lastMagicEditInSceneBoost: isInSceneBoostEnabled
   155→    });
   156→    
   157→  }, [metadata, updateMetadata]);
   158→
   159→  // Get the most recent magic edit prompt
   160→  const getLastMagicEditPrompt = useCallback((): string => {
   161→    const prompt = metadata.lastMagicEditPrompt || '';
   162→    return prompt;
   163→  }, [metadata]);
   164→
   165→  // Get all magic edit prompts
   166→  const getMagicEditPrompts = useCallback(() => {
   167→    return metadata.magicEditPrompts || [];
   168→  }, [metadata]);
   169→
   170→  // Get last settings
   171→  const getLastSettings = useCallback(() => {
   172→    return {
   173→      numImages: metadata.lastMagicEditNumImages || 4,
   174→      isNextSceneBoostEnabled: metadata.lastMagicEditNextSceneBoost || false,
   175→      isInSceneBoostEnabled: metadata.lastMagicEditInSceneBoost || false
   176→    };
   177→  }, [metadata]);
   178→
   179→  return {
   180→    metadata,
   181→    isLoading,
   182→    isUpdating,
   183→    updateMetadata,
   184→    addMagicEditPrompt,
   185→    getLastMagicEditPrompt,
   186→    getMagicEditPrompts,
   187→    getLastSettings
   188→  };
   189→}

   107→// Maximum frames allowed per segment (81-frame limit)
   108→const MAX_SEGMENT_FRAMES = 81;
   109→
   110→/**
   111→ * Validates individual travel segment parameters
   112→ */
   113→function validateIndividualTravelSegmentParams(params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams): void {
   114→  const errors: string[] = [];
   115→
   116→  if (!params.project_id) {
   117→    errors.push("project_id is required");
   118→  }
   119→
   120→  // Either parent_generation_id OR shot_id must be provided
   121→  // (shot_id is used to create a new parent if none exists)
   122→  if (!params.parent_generation_id && !params.shot_id) {
   123→    errors.push("Either parent_generation_id or shot_id is required");
   124→  }
   125→
   126→  if (typeof params.segment_index !== 'number' || params.segment_index < 0) {
   127→    errors.push("segment_index must be a non-negative number");
   128→  }
   129→
   130→  if (!params.start_image_url) {
   131→    errors.push("start_image_url is required");
   132→  }
   133→
   134→  // end_image_url is optional for trailing segments (single-image-to-video mode)
   135→  // When not provided, the GPU worker will generate video from just the start image
   136→
   137→  // Enforce 81-frame limit per segment
   138→  const numFrames = (
   139→    typeof params.num_frames === 'number'
   140→      ? params.num_frames
   141→      : (typeof params.originalParams?.num_frames === 'number' ? params.originalParams.num_frames : undefined)
   142→  ) ?? 49;
   143→  if (numFrames > MAX_SEGMENT_FRAMES) {
   144→    errors.push(`num_frames (${numFrames}) exceeds maximum of ${MAX_SEGMENT_FRAMES} frames per segment`);
   145→  }
   146→
   147→  if (errors.length > 0) {
   148→    throw new TaskValidationError(errors.join(", "));
   149→  }
   150→}

   195→function asPhaseConfig(value: unknown): PhaseConfig | undefined {
   196→  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) {
   197→    return undefined;
   198→  }
   199→  const candidate = value as {
   200→    num_phases?: unknown;
   201→    steps_per_phase?: unknown;
   202→    flow_shift?: unknown;
   203→    sample_solver?: unknown;
   204→    model_switch_phase?: unknown;
   205→    phases?: unknown;
   206→  };
   207→  if (
   208→    typeof candidate.num_phases !== 'number'
   209→    || !Array.isArray(candidate.steps_per_phase)
   210→    || !candidate.steps_per_phase.every((step) => typeof step === 'number')
   211→    || typeof candidate.flow_shift !== 'number'
   212→    || typeof candidate.sample_solver !== 'string'
   213→    || typeof candidate.model_switch_phase !== 'number'
   214→    || !Array.isArray(candidate.phases)
   215→  ) {
   216→    return undefined;
   217→  }
   218→  return value as PhaseConfig;
   219→}

   245→function mergeAdditionalLoraMap(
   246→  target: Record<string, number>,
   247→  source: unknown
   248→): void {

   250→  for (const [path, strength] of Object.entries(sourceRecord)) {

   258→  params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams,

   307→function buildSegmentState(params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams): SegmentBuildState {
   308→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params.originalParams);
   309→  const contractData = readTravelContractData(snapshot);
   310→  const orig = snapshot.rawParams;
   311→  const orchDetails = snapshot.orchestratorDetails;
   312→  const inputImages = buildInputImages(params);
   313→  const allInputImages = contractData.inputImages ?? inputImages;
   314→  const finalSeed = resolveFinalSeed(params, orig, orchDetails);
   315→  const additionalLoras = buildAdditionalLoras(params, orig, orchDetails, contractData.additionalLoras);
   316→  const motionMode = (
   317→    params.motion_mode
   318→    ?? asMotionMode(contractData.motionMode)
   319→    ?? 'basic'
   320→  );
   321→  const amountOfMotion = params.amount_of_motion
   322→    ?? contractData.amountOfMotion
   323→    ?? 0.5;
   324→  const explicitPhaseConfig = (
   325→    params.phase_config
   326→    ?? asPhaseConfig(contractData.phaseConfig)
   327→  );
   328→  const phaseConfig = explicitPhaseConfig
   329→    ?? buildBasicModePhaseConfig(false, amountOfMotion, params.loras ?? []);
   330→  const advancedMode = motionMode === 'basic'
   331→    ? false
   332→    : (
   333→      params.advanced_mode
   334→      ?? contractData.advancedMode
   335→      ?? !!explicitPhaseConfig
   336→    );
   337→  const loraMultipliers = phaseConfig.phases.flatMap((phase) =>
   338→    (phase.loras || []).map((lora) => ({
   339→      url: lora.url,
   340→      multiplier: typeof lora.multiplier === 'number' ? lora.multiplier : Number(lora.multiplier) || 0,
   341→    }))
   342→  );
   343→  const modelName = contractData.modelName
   344→    ?? DEFAULT_I2V_MODEL;
   345→  const flowShift = resolveNumberCandidate(
   346→    phaseConfig.flow_shift,
   347→    orig.flow_shift,
   348→    orchDetails.flow_shift,
   349→  ) ?? 5;
   350→  const sampleSolver = resolveStringCandidate(
   351→    phaseConfig.sample_solver,
   352→    orig.sample_solver,
   353→    orchDetails.sample_solver,
   354→  ) ?? 'euler';
   355→  const guidanceScale = resolveNumberCandidate(
   356→    phaseConfig.phases?.[0]?.guidance_scale,
   357→    orig.guidance_scale,
   358→    orchDetails.guidance_scale,
   359→  ) ?? 1;
   360→  const guidance2Scale = resolveNumberCandidate(
   361→    phaseConfig.phases?.[1]?.guidance_scale,
   362→    orig.guidance2_scale,
   363→    orchDetails.guidance2_scale,
   364→  ) ?? 1;
   365→  const guidancePhases = resolveNumberCandidate(
   366→    phaseConfig.num_phases,
   367→    orig.guidance_phases,
   368→    orchDetails.guidance_phases,
   369→  ) ?? 2;
   370→  const numInferenceSteps = phaseConfig.steps_per_phase
   371→    ? phaseConfig.steps_per_phase.reduce((sum: number, steps: number) => sum + steps, 0)
   372→    : (
   373→      resolveNumberCandidate(orig.num_inference_steps, orchDetails.num_inference_steps)
   374→      ?? 6
   375→    );
   376→  const modelSwitchPhase = resolveNumberCandidate(
   377→    phaseConfig.model_switch_phase,
   378→    orig.model_switch_phase,
   379→    orchDetails.model_switch_phase,
   380→  ) ?? 1;
   381→  const switchThreshold = firstDefined(orig.switch_threshold, orchDetails.switch_threshold);
   382→  const rawNumFrames = resolveNumberCandidate(params.num_frames, orig.num_frames) ?? 49;
   383→  const numFrames = Math.min(rawNumFrames, MAX_SEGMENT_FRAMES);
   384→  const basePrompt = resolveStringCandidate(
   385→    params.base_prompt,
   386→    contractData.prompt,
   387→    orig.base_prompt,
   388→    orig.prompt,
   389→  ) ?? "";
   390→  const negativePrompt = resolveStringCandidate(
   391→    params.negative_prompt,
   392→    contractData.negativePrompt,
   393→  ) ?? "";
   394→  const enhancedPrompt = resolveStringCandidate(
   395→    params.enhanced_prompt,
   396→    contractData.enhancedPrompt,
   397→  );
   398→  const fpsHelpers = resolveNumberCandidate(orig.fps_helpers, orchDetails.fps_helpers) ?? 16;
   399→  const segmentFramesExpanded = contractData.segmentFramesExpanded;
   400→  const frameOverlapExpanded = contractData.frameOverlapExpanded;
   401→  const structureGuidance = resolveStructureGuidance(
   402→    params,
   403→    orig,
   404→    orchDetails,
   405→    contractData.structureGuidance,
   406→  );
   407→
   408→  return {

   410→    orchDetails,

   412→    allInputImages,

   701→function buildIndividualTravelSegmentParams(
   702→  params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams,
   703→  finalResolution: string
   704→): Record<string, unknown> {
   705→  const state = buildSegmentState(params);
   706→  const orchestratorDetails = buildOrchestratorDetails(params, state, finalResolution);
   707→  const sourceSnapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params.originalParams);
   708→  const legacyContractTaskId = extractOrchestratorTaskIdParam(params.originalParams);
   709→  const legacyRunId = extractRunIdParam(params.originalParams);
   710→  const orchestratorTaskId = resolveSnapshotOrchestratorTaskId(sourceSnapshot)
   711→    ?? legacyContractTaskId
   712→    ?? asString(state.orchDetails.orchestrator_task_id)
   713→    ?? asString(state.orig.orchestrator_task_id_ref);
   714→  const runId = resolveSnapshotRunId(sourceSnapshot)
   715→    ?? legacyRunId
   716→    ?? asString(state.orchDetails.run_id)
   717→    ?? asString(state.orig.run_id);
   718→
   719→  const hasPairShotGenerationId = Boolean(
   720→    params.pair_shot_generation_id
   721→    || params.start_image_variant_id
   722→    || params.end_image_variant_id,
   723→  );
   724→  const segmentRegenerationMode = hasPairShotGenerationId
   725→    ? 'segment_regen_from_pair'
   726→    : 'segment_regen_from_order';
   727→  const generationRouting = params.child_generation_id
   728→    ? 'variant_child'
   729→    : 'child_generation';
   730→
   731→  const familyContract = buildIndividualSegmentFamilyContract({
   732→    segmentRegenerationMode,
   733→    generationRouting,
   734→    segmentIndex: params.segment_index,
   735→    hasEndImage: Boolean(params.end_image_url),
   736→    hasPairShotGenerationId,
   737→  });
   738→
   739→  const composedPayload = composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   740→    taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   741→    orchestratorDetails,
   742→    orchestrationInput: {
   743→      taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   744→      orchestratorTaskId,
   745→      runId,
   746→      parentGenerationId: params.parent_generation_id,
   747→      childGenerationId: params.child_generation_id,
   748→      childOrder: params.segment_index,
   749→      shotId: params.shot_id,
   750→      generationRouting,
   751→      siblingLookup: runId ? 'run_id' : 'orchestrator_task_id',
   752→      segmentRegenerationMode,
   753→    },
   754→    taskViewInput: {
   755→      inputImages: state.inputImages,
   756→      prompt: state.basePrompt,
   757→      enhancedPrompt: state.enhancedPrompt,
   758→      negativePrompt: state.negativePrompt,
   759→      modelName: state.modelName,
   760→      resolution: finalResolution,
   761→    },
   762→    familyContract,
   763→  });
   764→  const taskParams = {
   765→    ...buildTaskParamsPayload(params, state, finalResolution, orchestratorDetails),
   766→    ...composedPayload,
   767→  };
   768→  taskParams.individual_segment_params = buildIndividualSegmentParamsPayload(params, state);
   769→  return taskParams;
   770→}
   771→
   772→/**
   773→ * Creates an individual travel segment regeneration task
   774→ * 
   775→ * This creates a standalone task (visible in TasksPane) that regenerates
   776→ * a single segment and creates a variant on the parent generation when complete.
   777→ * The task params match the exact structure of travel_segment for GPU worker compatibility.
   778→ * 
   779→ * @param params - Individual travel segment parameters
   780→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
   781→ */
   782→export async function createIndividualTravelSegmentTask(params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
   783→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({
   784→    params,
   785→    context: 'IndividualTravelSegment',
   786→    validate: validateIndividualTravelSegmentParams,
   787→    buildTaskRequest: async (requestParams) => {
   788→      const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
   789→
   790→      const effectiveParentGenerationId = await ensureShotParentGenerationId({
   791→        projectId: requestParams.project_id,
   792→        shotId: requestParams.shot_id,
   793→        parentGenerationId: requestParams.parent_generation_id,
   794→        context: 'IndividualTravelSegment',
   795→      });
   796→
   797→      let effectiveChildGenerationId = requestParams.child_generation_id;
   798→
   799→      if (!effectiveChildGenerationId && effectiveParentGenerationId) {
   800→        if (requestParams.pair_shot_generation_id) {
   801→          const { data: childByPairId, error: pairIdError } = await supabase
   802→            .from('generations')
   803→            .select('id')
   804→            .eq('parent_generation_id', effectiveParentGenerationId)
   805→            .eq('pair_shot_generation_id', requestParams.pair_shot_generation_id)
   806→            .limit(1)
   807→            .maybeSingle();
   808→
   809→          if (pairIdError) {
   810→            throw new Error(
   811→              `IndividualTravelSegment.lookupChildByPairId failed: ${pairIdError.message}`,
   812→            );
   813→          }
   814→
   815→          if (childByPairId) {
   816→            effectiveChildGenerationId = childByPairId.id;
   817→          }
   818→        }
   819→
   820→        if (!effectiveChildGenerationId && requestParams.segment_index !== undefined && !requestParams.pair_shot_generation_id) {
   821→          const { data: childByOrder, error: orderError } = await supabase
   822→            .from('generations')
   823→            .select('id')
   824→            .eq('parent_generation_id', effectiveParentGenerationId)
   825→            .eq('child_order', requestParams.segment_index)
   826→            .limit(1)
   827→            .maybeSingle();
   828→
   829→          if (orderError) {
   830→            throw new Error(
   831→              `IndividualTravelSegment.lookupChildByOrder failed: ${orderError.message}`,
   832→            );
   833→          }
   834→
   835→          if (childByOrder) {
   836→            effectiveChildGenerationId = childByOrder.id;
   837→          }
   838→        }
   839→      }
   840→
   841→      const paramsWithIds = {
   842→        ...requestParams,
   843→        parent_generation_id: effectiveParentGenerationId,
   844→        child_generation_id: effectiveChildGenerationId,
   845→      };
   846→
   847→      const directResolution = asString(requestParams.parsed_resolution_wh);
   848→      const originalParams = toRecordOrEmpty(requestParams.originalParams);
   849→      const originalOrchestratorDetails = toRecordOrEmpty(originalParams.orchestrator_details);
   850→      const origResolutionValue =
   851→        originalParams.parsed_resolution_wh ?? originalOrchestratorDetails.parsed_resolution_wh;
   852→      const origResolution = directResolution
   853→        ?? (typeof origResolutionValue === 'string' ? origResolutionValue : undefined);
   854→      const { resolution: finalResolution } = await resolveProjectResolution(
   855→        requestParams.project_id,
   856→        origResolution,
   857→      );
   858→
   859→      const taskParams = buildIndividualTravelSegmentParams(paramsWithIds, finalResolution);
   860→
   861→      return composeTaskRequest({
   862→        source: requestParams,
   863→        taskType: 'individual_travel_segment',
   864→        params: taskParams,
   865→      });
   866→    },
   867→  });
   868→}
   869→

   871→

   176→ * @param params - The update parameters

   178→ * @param mode - 'debounced' (default) or 'immediate' for flush-on-unmount
   179→ * @returns The full merged settings after update
   180→ */
   181→function isSettingsWriteMode(value: unknown): value is SettingsWriteMode {
   182→  return value === 'debounced' || value === 'immediate';
   183→}
   184→
   185→export function updateToolSettingsSupabase(
   186→  params: UpdateToolSettingsParams,
   187→  mode?: SettingsWriteMode,
   188→): Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
   189→export function updateToolSettingsSupabase(
   190→  params: UpdateToolSettingsParams,
   191→  signal?: AbortSignal,
   192→  mode?: SettingsWriteMode,
   193→): Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
   194→export function updateToolSettingsSupabase(
   195→  params: UpdateToolSettingsParams,
   196→  signalOrMode?: AbortSignal | SettingsWriteMode,
   197→  maybeMode: SettingsWriteMode = 'debounced',
   198→): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
   199→  const { scope, id, toolId, patch } = params;
   200→  const signal = isAbortSignal(signalOrMode) ? signalOrMode : undefined;
   201→  const mode = isSettingsWriteMode(signalOrMode) ? signalOrMode : maybeMode;
   202→
   203→  return enqueueSettingsWrite({
   204→    scope,
   205→    entityId: id,
   206→    toolId,
   207→    patch: patch as Record<string, unknown>,
   208→    ...(signal ? { signal } : {}),
   209→  }, mode) as Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
   210→}
   211→
   212→// ============================================================================
   213→// Cache format helpers
   214→// ============================================================================
   215→
   216→/**
   217→ * Helper to check if a cache value has the wrapper format.
   218→ * fetchToolSettingsSupabase always returns { settings, hasShotSettings },
   219→ * but legacy or manually-set cache entries may use flat format.
   220→ */
   221→function isSettingsWrapper(data: unknown): data is SettingsFetchResult {
   222→  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return false;
   223→  return 'settings' in data && 'hasShotSettings' in data;
   224→}
   225→
   226→/**
   227→ * Helper to extract settings from cache data (handles wrapper format)
   228→ * Cache stores data as { settings: T, hasShotSettings: boolean }
   229→ */
   230→export function extractSettingsFromCache<T>(cacheData: unknown): T | undefined {
   231→  if (!cacheData) return undefined;
   232→  return isSettingsWrapper(cacheData) ? (cacheData.settings as T) : (cacheData as T);
   233→}
   234→
   235→/**
   236→ * Helper to update settings cache with proper wrapper format
   237→ * Use this in setQueryData callbacks for optimistic updates
   238→ *
   239→ * @param prev - The previous cache value (may be wrapper or flat format)
   240→ * @param updater - Either an object of updates, or a function that receives prevSettings and returns updates
   241→ */
   242→export function updateSettingsCache<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
   243→  prev: unknown,
   244→  updater: Partial<T> | ((prevSettings: T) => Partial<T>)
   245→): SettingsFetchResult<T> {
   246→  const wrapper = isSettingsWrapper(prev);
   247→  const prevSettings = (wrapper ? ((prev as SettingsFetchResult).settings ?? {}) : (prev ?? {})) as T;
   248→  const updates = typeof updater === 'function' ? updater(prevSettings) : updater;
   249→  return {
   250→    settings: { ...prevSettings, ...updates } as T,
   251→    hasShotSettings: wrapper ? ((prev as SettingsFetchResult).hasShotSettings ?? false) : false
   252→  };
   253→}
   254→
   255→// ============================================================================
   256→// Query retry helper
   257→// ============================================================================
   258→
   259→/** Determines whether a failed settings query should be retried. */
   260→function shouldRetrySettingsQuery(failureCount: number, error: Error): boolean {
   261→  const classified = classifyToolSettingsError(error);
   262→  if (
   263→    classified.code === 'auth_required'
   264→    || classified.code === 'cancelled'
   265→    || classified.code === 'network'
   266→  ) {
   267→    return false;
   268→  }
   269→  return failureCount < 3;
   270→}
   271→
   272→// ============================================================================
   273→// Mutation success/error helpers
   274→// ============================================================================
   275→
   276→/** Merge mutation result into query cache and refetch related caches. */
   277→function handleMutationSuccess(
   278→  fullMergedSettings: Record<string, unknown> | null,
   279→  toolId: string,
   280→  projectId: string | undefined,
   281→  shotId: string | undefined,
   282→  queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>,
   283→) {
   284→  if (fullMergedSettings === null) return;
   285→
   286→  queryClient.setQueryData(
   287→    queryKeys.settings.tool(toolId, projectId, shotId),
   288→    (oldData: unknown) => {
   289→      const oldWrapper = isSettingsWrapper(oldData);
   290→      const oldSettings = oldWrapper
   291→        ? (((oldData as SettingsFetchResult).settings ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>)
   292→        : ((oldData ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>);
   293→      const mergedSettings = deepMerge({}, oldSettings, fullMergedSettings);
   294→
   295→      return {
   296→        settings: mergedSettings,
   297→        hasShotSettings: oldWrapper ? ((oldData as SettingsFetchResult).hasShotSettings ?? false) : false
   298→      };
   299→    }
   300→  );
   301→
   302→  if (shotId) {
   303→    queryClient.refetchQueries({ [REDACTED](shotId) });
   304→  }
   305→}
   306→
   307→/** Log/toast mutation errors and invalidate cache for non-network failures. */
   308→function handleMutationError(
   309→  error: Error,
   310→  toolId: string,
   311→  projectId: string | undefined,
   312→  shotId: string | undefined,
   313→  queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>,
   314→) {
   315→  const classified = classifyToolSettingsError(error);
   316→
   317→  if (classified.code === 'cancelled') {
   318→    return;
   319→  }
   320→
   321→  if (classified.code === 'network') return;
   322→
   323→  normalizeAndPresentError(classified, { context: 'useToolSettings.update', toastTitle: `Failed to save ${toolId} settings` });
   324→
   325→  queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   326→    [REDACTED](toolId, projectId, shotId)
   327→  });
   328→}
   329→
   330→// Type overloads
   331→export function useToolSettings<T>(toolId: string, context?: { projectId?: string; shotId?: string; enabled?: boolean }): {
   332→  settings: T | undefined;
   333→  isLoading: boolean;
   334→  error: Error | null;
   335→  update: (scope: SettingsScope, settings: Partial<T>) => Promise<void>;
   336→  isUpdating: boolean;
   337→  /** Whether the shot had settings stored in DB (vs just defaults/project settings) */
   338→  hasShotSettings: boolean;
   339→};
   340→
   341→/**
   342→ * Low-level hook for reading and writing tool settings across all scopes.
   343→ *
   344→ * Performs cascade resolution (defaults -> user -> project -> shot) and returns
   345→ * a merged settings object. Writes go through the global settings write queue.
   346→ *
   347→ * Most features should use `useAutoSaveSettings` instead, which adds auto-save,
   348→ * dirty tracking, and entity-change handling on top of this hook.
   349→ *
   350→ * Use this directly only when you need manual save control or complex write patterns.
   351→ *
   352→ * @see docs/structure_detail/settings_system.md for the full settings hook decision tree
   353→ */
   354→export function useToolSettings<T>(
   355→  toolId: string,
   356→  context?: { projectId?: string; shotId?: string; enabled?: boolean }
   357→) {
   358→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   359→
   360→  // Determine parameter shapes
   361→  const projectIdFromRuntime = getProjectSelectionFallbackId() ?? undefined;
   362→  const projectId: string | undefined = context?.projectId ?? projectIdFromRuntime ?? undefined;
   363→  const shotId: string | undefined = context?.shotId;
   364→  const fetchEnabled: boolean = context?.enabled ?? true;
   365→
   366→  // Refs to access current values in stable callbacks without recreating them
   367→  const projectIdRef = useRef(projectId);
   368→  projectIdRef.current = projectId;
   369→  const shotIdRef = useRef(shotId);
   370→  shotIdRef.current = shotId;
   371→
   372→  // Fetch merged settings using Supabase with mobile optimizations
   373→  const { data: queryResult, isLoading, error } = useQuery({
   374→    [REDACTED](toolId, projectId, shotId),
   375→    queryFn: async ({ signal }): Promise<SettingsFetchResult> => {
   376→      return fetchToolSettingsSupabaseOrThrow(toolId, { projectId, shotId }, signal);
   377→    },
   378→    enabled: !!toolId && fetchEnabled,
   379→    ...QUERY_PRESETS.static,
   380→    staleTime: 10 * 60 * 1000,
   381→    retry: shouldRetrySettingsQuery,
   382→    retryDelay: STANDARD_RETRY_DELAY,
   383→    networkMode: 'online',
   384→  });
   385→
   386→  // Extract settings and hasShotSettings from the query result
   387→  const wrapper = isSettingsWrapper(queryResult);
   388→  const settings = wrapper ? (queryResult as SettingsFetchResult).settings : queryResult;
   389→  const hasShotSettings = wrapper ? ((queryResult as SettingsFetchResult).hasShotSettings ?? false) : false;
   390→
   391→  // Log errors for debugging (except expected cancellations)
   392→  if (error && classifyToolSettingsError(error).code !== 'cancelled') {
   393→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useToolSettings', showToast: false });
   394→  }
   395→
   396→  // Update settings mutation
   397→  const updateMutation = useMutation({
   398→    mutationFn: async ({ scope, settings: newSettings, entityId }: {
   399→      scope: SettingsScope;
   400→      settings: Partial<T>;
   401→      entityId?: string;
   402→    }) => {
   403→      let idForScope: string | undefined = entityId;
   404→
   405→      if (!idForScope) {
   406→        if (scope === 'user') {
   407→          const { data: { user } } = await getCachedUserId();
   408→          idForScope = user?.id;
   409→          if (!idForScope) {
   410→            throw new ToolSettingsError(
   411→              'auth_required',
   412→              'Authentication required for user settings update',
   413→            );
   414→          }
   415→        } else if (scope === 'project') {
   416→          idForScope = projectId;
   417→        } else if (scope === 'shot') {
   418→          idForScope = shotId;
   419→        }
   420→      }
   421→
   422→      if (!idForScope) {
   423→        throw new ToolSettingsError(
   424→          'invalid_scope_identifier',
   425→          `Missing identifier for ${scope} tool settings update`,
   426→        );
   427→      }
   428→
   429→      const fullMergedSettings = await updateToolSettingsSupabase({
   430→          scope,
   431→          id: idForScope,
   432→          toolId,
   433→          patch: newSettings,
   434→      });
   435→
   436→      return fullMergedSettings;
   437→    },
   438→    onSuccess: (fullMergedSettings) => {
   439→      handleMutationSuccess(fullMergedSettings, toolId, projectId, shotId, queryClient);
   440→    },
   441→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   442→      handleMutationError(error, toolId, projectId, shotId, queryClient);
   443→    },
   444→  });
   445→
   446→  // Get stable reference to mutateAsync - useMutation returns a new object each render
   447→  // but mutateAsync itself is stable
   448→  const mutateAsyncRef = useRef(updateMutation.mutateAsync);
   449→  mutateAsyncRef.current = updateMutation.mutateAsync;
   450→
   451→  // CRITICAL: Wrap in useCallback with stable deps to prevent cascading re-renders.
   452→  // Use refs to access current projectId/shotId without recreating this function.
   453→  // The entityId is snapshotted at call time via refs for correctness.
   454→  const update = useCallback(async (scope: SettingsScope, settings: Partial<T>): Promise<void> => {
   455→    // Snapshot the target entity id NOW to prevent cross-project/shot overwrites
   456→    // Use refs to get current values without causing callback recreation
   457→    const entityId = scope === 'project' ? projectIdRef.current : (scope === 'shot' ? shotIdRef.current : undefined);
   458→
   459→    // NOTE: No debounce here - callers (like useShotSettings) are responsible for debouncing.
   460→    // Using mutateAsync so callers can await the actual DB write completion.
   461→    // Use ref to access stable mutateAsync without recreating this callback.
   462→    await mutateAsyncRef.current({ scope, settings, entityId });
   463→  }, []); // Empty deps - all values accessed via refs for stability
   464→
   465→  return useMemo(() => ({
   466→    settings: settings as T | undefined,
   467→    isLoading,
   468→    error: error as Error | null,
   469→    update,
   470→    isUpdating: updateMutation.isPending,
   471→    hasShotSettings,
   472→  }), [settings, isLoading, error, update, updateMutation.isPending, hasShotSettings]);
   473→}
   474→

    49→         error.message?.includes('signal is aborted');

    11→export class AppError extends Error {

    27→    super(message);

    30→    this.context = options?.context;
    31→    this.cause = options?.cause;

    39→export class NetworkError extends AppError {

    56→    this.isOffline = options?.isOffline ?? !navigator.onLine;
    57→    this.isTimeout = options?.isTimeout ?? false;

    59→
    60→  static fromError(error: Error, context?: Record<string, unknown>): NetworkError {
    61→    const isTimeout = error.name === 'AbortError' || error.message.includes('timeout');
    62→    const isOffline = !navigator.onLine;
    63→
    64→    let message = 'Network request failed';

    67→    } else if (isTimeout) {

1→import type { AppError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errors';
     2→import {
     3→  reportError,
     4→  type ErrorReportOptions,
     5→} from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/coreReporter';
     6→import { presentRuntimeError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeErrorPresenter';
     7→
     8→export interface RuntimeErrorOptions extends ErrorReportOptions {
     9→  toastTitle?: string;
    10→  showToast?: boolean;
    11→}
    12→
    13→/** Normalize unknown errors and route them through the shared presenter. */
    14→export function normalizeAndPresentError(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): AppError {
    15→  const { context, logData, onError, toastTitle, showToast } = options;
    16→  const appError = reportError(error, { context, logData, onError });
    17→
    18→  const shouldShowToast = showToast ?? appError.showToast;
    19→  if (shouldShowToast) {
    20→    presentRuntimeError(appError, toastTitle);
    21→  }
    22→
    23→  return appError;
    24→}
    25→
    26→/** Normalize, present, then throw for caller-level control-flow stops. */
    27→export function normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): never {
    28→  throw normalizeAndPresentError(error, options);
    29→}
    30→

    45→function asRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null {
    46→  return value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
    47→    ? (value as Record<string, unknown>)
    48→    : null;
    49→}
    50→
    51→function resolvePathValue(params: unknown, path: TaskParamPath): unknown {
    52→  let value: unknown = params;
    53→  for (const segment of path) {
    54→    const record = asRecord(value);
    55→    if (!record || !(segment in record)) {
    56→      return undefined;
    57→    }
    58→    value = record[segment];
    59→  }
    60→  return value;
    61→}
    62→
    63→export function resolveByPrecedence<T>(...candidates: Array<T | null | undefined>): T | undefined {
    64→  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    65→    if (candidate !== undefined && candidate !== null) {
    66→      return candidate;
    67→    }
    68→  }
    69→  return undefined;
    70→}
    71→
    72→export function extractTaskParamValue(
    73→  params: unknown,
    74→  paths: readonly TaskParamPath[],
    75→): unknown {
    76→  for (const path of paths) {
    77→    const value = resolvePathValue(params, path);
    78→    if (value !== undefined && value !== null) {
    79→      return value;
    80→    }
    81→  }
    82→  return undefined;
    83→}
    84→
    85→export function extractTaskParamString(
    86→  params: unknown,
    87→  paths: readonly TaskParamPath[],
    88→): string | null {
    89→  const value = extractTaskParamValue(params, paths);
    90→  if (typeof value !== 'string') {
    91→    return null;
    92→  }
    93→  const normalized = value.trim();
    94→  return normalized.length > 0 ? normalized : null;
    95→}
    96→
    97→export function extractTaskParamBoolean(
    98→  params: unknown,
    99→  paths: readonly TaskParamPath[],
   100→): boolean | null {
   101→  const value = extractTaskParamValue(params, paths);
   102→  return parseTaskParamBoolean(value);
   103→}
   104→
   105→function parseTaskParamBoolean(value: unknown): boolean | null {
   106→  if (typeof value === 'boolean') {
   107→    return value;
   108→  }
   109→  if (typeof value === 'number') {
   110→    if (value === 1) return true;
   111→    if (value === 0) return false;
   112→    return null;
   113→  }
   114→  if (typeof value === 'string') {
   115→    const normalized = value.trim().toLowerCase();
   116→    if (normalized === 'true' || normalized === '1') return true;
   117→    if (normalized === 'false' || normalized === '0') return false;
   118→  }
   119→  return null;
   120→}
   121→
   122→function summarizeTaskParamValue(value: unknown): string | number | boolean | null {
   123→  if (value === null) {
   124→    return null;
   125→  }
   126→  if (typeof value === 'string' || typeof value === 'number' || typeof value === 'boolean') {
   127→    return value;
   128→  }
   129→  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
   130→    return '[array]';
   131→  }
   132→  if (typeof value === 'object') {
   133→    return '[object]';
   134→  }
   135→  return String(value);
   136→}
   137→
   138→export function extractOrchestratorTaskIdParam(params: unknown): string | null {
   139→  return extractTaskParamString(params, TASK_PARAM_CONTRACT_PATHS.orchestratorTaskId);
   140→}
   141→
   142→export function extractRunIdParam(params: unknown): string | null {
   143→  return extractTaskParamString(params, TASK_PARAM_CONTRACT_PATHS.runId);
   144→}
   145→
   146→export function extractBasedOnParam(params: unknown): string | null {
   147→  return extractTaskParamString(params, TASK_PARAM_CONTRACT_PATHS.basedOn);
   148→}
   149→
   150→export function extractShotIdParam(params: unknown): string | null {
   151→  return extractTaskParamString(params, TASK_PARAM_CONTRACT_PATHS.shotId);
   152→}
   153→
   154→export function extractAddInPositionParam(params: unknown): boolean {
   155→  const rawValue = extractTaskParamValue(params, TASK_PARAM_CONTRACT_PATHS.addInPosition);
   156→  const parsed = parseTaskParamBoolean(rawValue);

   167→        rawValue: summarizeTaskParamValue(rawValue),
   168→      },
   169→    });
   170→  }

    35→

    38→ */
    39→interface UseVariantsReturn {
    40→  variants: GenerationVariant[];
    41→  primaryVariant: GenerationVariant | null;
    42→  activeVariant: GenerationVariant | null;
    43→  isLoading: boolean;

    51→interface UseVariantsProps {
