    55→
    56→export const useVariants = ({
    57→  generationId,
    58→  enabled = true,
    59→}: UseVariantsProps): UseVariantsReturn => {
    60→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    61→  const [activeVariantId, setActiveVariantIdInternal] = useState<string | null>(null);
    62→  
    63→  // Stable callback - no deps needed since we just forward to internal setter

    76→    queryFn: async () => {
    77→      if (!generationId) return [];
    78→
    79→      const { data, error } = await supabase().from('generation_variants')
    80→        .select('*')
    81→        .eq('generation_id', generationId)
    82→        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

    84→      if (error) {

    37→ * 1. Service Role Key - Direct match with SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
    38→ * 2. Personal Access Token (PAT) - Looked up in user_api_tokens table
    39→ * 3. JWT User Auth (optional) - Extract user ID from JWT payload.sub
    40→ *
    41→ * NOTE: We intentionally do NOT accept JWTs with service_role claims.
    42→ * Only the actual service key can be used for service role access.
    43→ * This prevents unsigned/forged JWTs from gaining elevated privileges.
    44→ *
    45→ * @param req - The incoming HTTP request
    46→ * @param supabaseAdmin - Supabase admin client for database queries
    47→ * @param logPrefix - Optional prefix for log messages (e.g., "[FUNCTION-NAME]")
    48→ * @param options - Optional settings for auth behavior
    49→ * @returns AuthResult with authentication details
    50→ */
    51→export async function authenticateRequest(
    52→  req: Request,
    53→  supabaseAdmin: SupabaseClient,
    54→  logPrefix: string = "[AUTH]",
    55→  options: AuthOptions = {}
    56→): Promise<AuthResult> {
    57→  // Extract authorization header
    58→  const authHeader = req.headers.get("Authorization");
    59→  if (!authHeader?.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
    60→    return {
    61→      isServiceRole: false,
    62→      userId: null,
    63→      success: false,
    64→      error: "Missing or invalid Authorization header",
    65→      statusCode: 401
    66→    };
    67→  }
    68→
    69→  const [REDACTED](7); // Remove "Bearer " prefix
    70→  const serviceKey = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY");
    71→
    72→  if (!serviceKey) {
    73→    console.error(`${logPrefix} Missing SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY environment variable`);
    74→    return {
    75→      isServiceRole: false,
    76→      userId: null,
    77→      success: false,
    78→      error: "Server configuration error",
    79→      statusCode: 500
    80→    };
    81→  }
    82→
    83→  // 1) Check if token matches service-role key directly (SECURE)
    84→  if (token === serviceKey) {
    85→    return {
    86→      isServiceRole: true,
    87→      userId: null,
    88→      success: true
    89→    };
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  // 2) If JWT user auth is enabled, try to decode JWT and extract user ID
    93→  if (options.allowJwtUserAuth) {
    94→    try {
    95→      const parts = token.split(".");
    96→      if (parts.length === 3) {
    97→        const payloadB64 = parts[1];
    98→        const padded = payloadB64 + "=".repeat((4 - payloadB64.length % 4) % 4);
    99→        const payload = JSON.parse(atob(padded));
   100→
   101→        // Check if this is a regular user JWT (not service role)
   102→        const role = payload.role || payload.app_metadata?.role;
   103→        if (!["service_role", "supabase_admin"].includes(role) && payload.sub) {
   104→          return {
   105→            isServiceRole: false,
   106→            userId: payload.sub,
   107→            success: true,
   108→            isJwtAuth: true
   109→          };
   110→        }
   111→      }
   112→    } catch {
   113→      // Not a valid JWT - continue to PAT lookup
   114→    }
   115→  }
   116→
   117→  // 3) Personal Access Token (PAT) - look up in user_api_tokens table (SECURE)
   118→
   119→  const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin
   120→    .from("user_api_tokens")
   121→    .select("user_id")
   122→    .eq("token", token)
   123→    .single();
   124→
   125→  if (error || !data) {
   126→    console.error(`${logPrefix} Credential lookup failed`);
   127→    return {
   128→      isServiceRole: false,
   129→      userId: null,
   130→      success: false,
   131→      error: "Invalid or expired token",
   132→      statusCode: 403
   133→    };
   134→  }
   135→
   136→  const userId = data.user_id;
   137→  return {
   138→    isServiceRole: false,
   139→    userId,
   140→    success: true
   141→  };
   142→}

   160→  // Get task and its project

   227→    }

   229→    if (options.auth?.requireServiceRole && !auth.isServiceRole) {
   230→      return {
   231→        ok: false,
   232→        response: buildErrorResponse('Unauthorized - service role required', 403, format),
   233→      };
   234→    }
   235→  }
   236→
   237→  return {
   238→    ok: true,
   239→    value: {
   240→      req,
   241→      body: body as TBody,
   242→      supabaseAdmin,
   243→      logger,
   244→      auth,
   245→    },
   246→  };
   247→}
   248→
   249→function toErrorMessage(error: unknown): string {
   250→  if (error instanceof Error) {
   251→    return error.message;
   252→  }
   253→  return String(error);
   254→}
   255→
   256→/**
   257→ * High-level request wrapper that standardizes edge endpoint choreography:
   258→ * bootstrap -> handler -> unified unexpected-error response -> guaranteed flush.
   259→ */
   260→export async function withEdgeRequest<TBody extends Record<string, unknown> = Record<string, unknown>>(
   261→  req: Request,
   262→  options: EdgeBootstrapOptions,
   263→  handler: (context: EdgeRequestContext<TBody>) => Promise<Response>,
   264→): Promise<Response> {
   265→  const bootstrap = await bootstrapEdgeHandler<TBody>(req, options);
   266→  if (!bootstrap.ok) {
   267→    return bootstrap.response;
   268→  }
   269→
   270→  const context = bootstrap.value;
   271→  try {
   272→    return await handler(context);
   273→  } catch (error: unknown) {
   274→    context.logger.critical('Unexpected error', {
   275→      error: toErrorMessage(error),
   276→    });
   277→    return buildErrorResponse('Internal server error', 500, errorFormat(options));
   278→  } finally {
   279→    await context.logger.flush();
   280→  }
   281→}
   282→

   113→interface EdgeErrorEnvelopeInput {
   114→  errorCode: string;
   115→  message: string;
   116→  recoverable: boolean;
   117→  retryAfter?: number;
   118→}
   119→
   120→export function edgeErrorResponse(
   121→  input: EdgeErrorEnvelopeInput,
   122→  status: number,
   123→  extraHeaders?: Record<string, string>,
   124→): Response {
   125→  return new Response(
   126→    JSON.stringify({
   127→      error: input.errorCode,
   128→      errorCode: input.errorCode,
   129→      message: input.message,
   130→      recoverable: input.recoverable,
   131→      ...(input.retryAfter !== undefined ? { retryAfter: input.retryAfter } : {}),
   132→    }),
   133→    {
   134→      status,
   135→      headers: {
   136→        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
   137→        'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
   138→        ...(extraHeaders ?? {}),
   139→      },
   140→    },
   141→  );
   142→}

   144→interface ParseJsonBodyOptions {
   145→  mode?: 'strict' | 'loose';
   146→  message?: string;
   147→  nonObjectMessage?: string;
   148→}
   149→
   150→export async function parseJsonBody(
   151→  req: Request,
   152→  logger?: SystemLogger,
   153→  options?: ParseJsonBodyOptions,
   154→): Promise<OperationResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
   155→  const mode = options?.mode ?? 'strict';
   156→  const message = options?.message ?? 'Invalid JSON body';
   157→  const nonObjectMessage = options?.nonObjectMessage ?? 'JSON body must be an object';
   158→
   159→  try {
   160→    const bodyText = await req.text();
   161→    if (!bodyText) {
   162→      return operationSuccess({}, { policy: 'best_effort' });
   163→    }
   164→
   165→    const parsed = JSON.parse(bodyText);
   166→    if (isJsonObject(parsed)) {
   167→      return operationSuccess(parsed, { policy: 'best_effort' });
   168→    }
   169→
   170→    if (mode === 'loose') {
   171→      logger?.debug('Non-object JSON body provided, using empty object defaults');
   172→      return operationSuccess(coerceLooseObject(parsed), { policy: 'fail_open' });
   173→    }
   174→
   175→    logger?.error(nonObjectMessage);
   176→    if (logger) {
   177→      await logger.flush();
   178→    }
   179→    return operationFailure(new Error(nonObjectMessage), {
   180→      policy: 'fail_closed',
   181→      errorCode: 'invalid_json_body_shape',
   182→      message: nonObjectMessage,
   183→      recoverable: false,
   184→      cause: parsed,
   185→    });
   186→  } catch (error) {
   187→    if (mode === 'loose') {
   188→      logger?.debug('No valid JSON body provided, using defaults');
   189→      return operationSuccess({}, { policy: 'fail_open' });
   190→    }
   191→    logger?.error(message);
   192→    if (logger) {
   193→      await logger.flush();
   194→    }
   195→    return operationFailure(error, {
   196→      policy: 'fail_closed',
   197→      errorCode: 'invalid_json_body',
   198→      message,
   199→      recoverable: false,
   200→      cause: error,
   201→    });
   202→  }
   203→}
   204→
   205→export async function parseJsonBodyStrict(
   206→  req: Request,
   207→  logger?: SystemLogger,
   208→  options?: ParseJsonBodyOptions,
   209→): Promise<OperationResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
   210→  return parseJsonBody(req, logger, {
   211→    mode: 'strict',
   212→    message: options?.message,
   213→    nonObjectMessage: options?.nonObjectMessage,
   214→  });
   215→}

    16→export function generateUniqueFilename(extension: string): string {

    18→  const randomStr = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 10);
    19→  return `${timestamp}-${randomStr}.${extension}`;
    20→}
    21→
    22→/**
    23→ * Generate a unique thumbnail filename
    24→ */
    25→export function generateThumbnailFilename(): string {
    26→  const timestamp = Date.now();
    27→  const randomStr = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8);
    28→  return `thumb_${timestamp}_${randomStr}.jpg`;
    29→}
    30→
    31→/**
    32→ * Get file extension from filename, with MIME type fallback
    33→ */
    34→export function getFileExtension(
    35→  filename: string,
    36→  mimeType?: string,
    37→  defaultExt: string = 'bin'
    38→): string {
    39→  // Handle URLs and query/hash suffixes from signed object paths.
    40→  const cleanName = filename
    41→    .split('?')[0]
    42→    .split('#')[0]
    43→    .split('/')
    44→    .pop() ?? filename;
    45→  const dotIndex = cleanName.lastIndexOf('.');
    46→  if (dotIndex > 0 && dotIndex < cleanName.length - 1) {
    47→    return cleanName.slice(dotIndex + 1).toLowerCase();
    48→  }
    49→  
    50→  // Fallback to MIME type
    51→  if (mimeType) {
    52→    const mimeExt = mimeType.split('/')[1]?.split(';')[0]?.replace('jpeg', 'jpg');
    53→    if (mimeExt) return mimeExt;
    54→  }
    55→  
    56→  return defaultExt;
    57→}
    58→

1→import {
     2→  resolveProjectResolution,
     3→  generateTaskId,
     4→  generateRunId,
     5→  createTask,
     6→} from "../../taskCreation";
     7→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     8→import type { TravelBetweenImagesTaskInput, TravelBetweenImagesTaskResult } from './types';
     9→import { validateTravelBetweenImagesParams, buildTravelBetweenImagesPayload } from './payloadBuilder';
    10→import { TOOL_IDS } from '@/shared/lib/toolIds';
    11→import { ensureShotParentGenerationId } from '../shotParentGeneration';
    12→
    13→/**
    14→ * Creates a travel between images task using the unified approach.
    15→ * This replaces the direct call to the steerable-motion edge function.
    16→ *
    17→ * @param params - Travel between images task parameters
    18→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task and parent generation ID
    19→ */
    20→export async function createTravelBetweenImagesTask(params: TravelBetweenImagesTaskInput): Promise<TravelBetweenImagesTaskResult> {
    21→
    22→  try {
    23→    // 1. Validate parameters
    24→    validateTravelBetweenImagesParams(params);
    25→
    26→    // 2. Resolve project resolution
    27→    const { resolution: finalResolution } = await resolveProjectResolution(
    28→      params.project_id,
    29→      params.resolution
    30→    );
    31→
    32→    // 3. Generate IDs for orchestrator payload (not for database)
    33→    const orchestratorTaskId = generateTaskId("sm_travel_orchestrator");
    34→    const runId = generateRunId();
    35→
    36→    // 4. Ensure we have a canonical parent generation for this shot.
    37→    // If one already exists, reuse it. If none exists yet, create exactly one.
    38→    const effectiveParentGenerationId = await ensureShotParentGenerationId({
    39→      projectId: params.project_id,
    40→      shotId: params.shot_id,
    41→      parentGenerationId: params.parent_generation_id,
    42→      context: 'TravelBetweenImages',
    43→    });
    44→
    45→    // 5. Build orchestrator payload (now includes parent_generation_id)
    46→    const orchestratorPayload = buildTravelBetweenImagesPayload(
    47→      params,
    48→      finalResolution,
    49→      orchestratorTaskId,
    50→      runId,
    51→      effectiveParentGenerationId
    52→    );
    53→
    54→    // 6. Determine task type based on turbo mode
    55→    const isTurboMode = params.turbo_mode === true;
    56→    const taskType = isTurboMode ? 'wan_2_2_i2v' : 'travel_orchestrator';
    57→
    58→    // Create task using unified create-task function (no task_id - let DB auto-generate)
    59→    const result = await createTask({
    60→      project_id: params.project_id,
    61→      task_type: taskType,
    62→      params: {
    63→        tool_type: TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES, // Override tool_type for proper generation tagging
    64→        orchestrator_details: orchestratorPayload,
    65→        // Also store parent_generation_id at top level for easy access
    66→        ...(effectiveParentGenerationId ? { parent_generation_id: effectiveParentGenerationId } : {}),
    67→        // Also store at top level for direct access by worker (not just in orchestrator_details)
    68→        ...(params.generation_name ? { generation_name: params.generation_name } : {}),
    69→      }
    70→    });
    71→
    72→    return {
    73→      task: result,
    74→      parentGenerationId: effectiveParentGenerationId,
    75→    };
    76→
    77→  } catch (error) {
    78→    throw normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'TravelBetweenImages', showToast: false });
    79→  }
    80→}
    81→

   150→      cumEdit += b.images_edited;
   151→      cumVid += b.videos_generated;
   152→      chartData.push({ date: b.date, images_generated: cumImg, images_edited: cumEdit, videos_generated: cumVid });

   208→      image: chartUrl ? { url: chartUrl } : undefined,
   209→      footer: {

   211→      },
   212→      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),

   214→
   215→    const discordPayload = { embeds: [embed] };

   252→/**
   253→ * Aggregate daily buckets into weekly buckets (Mon-Sun weeks)
   254→ */
   255→function aggregateByWeek(buckets: DayBucket[]): DayBucket[] {
   256→  const weekMap = new Map<string, DayBucket>();
   257→
   258→  for (const bucket of buckets) {
   259→    const date = new Date(bucket.date + "T00:00:00Z");
   260→    // Get Monday of this week
   261→    const day = date.getUTCDay();
   262→    const diff = day === 0 ? -6 : 1 - day; // Monday = 1
   263→    const monday = new Date(date);
   264→    monday.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate() + diff);
   265→    const [REDACTED]().substring(0, 10);
   266→
   267→    if (!weekMap.has(weekKey)) {
   268→      weekMap.set(weekKey, { date: weekKey, images_generated: 0, images_edited: 0, videos_generated: 0 });
   269→    }
   270→    const week = weekMap.get(weekKey)!;
   271→    week.images_generated += bucket.images_generated;
   272→    week.images_edited += bucket.images_edited;
   273→    week.videos_generated += bucket.videos_generated;
   274→  }
   275→
   276→  return Array.from(weekMap.values()).sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
   277→}

    97→    const thumbnailHeight = Math.round(originalHeight / 3)
    98→

   125→      .from(MEDIA_BUCKET)
   126→      .upload(thumbnailPath, thumbnailBlob, {
   127→        contentType: 'image/jpeg',
   128→        upsert: true
   129→      })
   130→
   131→    if (uploadError) {

   133→      throw new Error(`Thumbnail upload failed: ${uploadError.message}`)
   134→    }
   135→

    11→function needsSceneMigration(reference: ReferenceImage): boolean {

    19→function migrateSceneReference(reference: ReferenceImage): ReferenceImage {
    20→  const updates: Partial<ReferenceImage> = { ...reference };
    21→
    22→  if (
    23→    (reference.referenceMode as string) === 'scene-imprecise' ||
    24→    (reference.referenceMode as string) === 'scene-precise'

    27→    updates.inThisSceneStrength = reference.inThisSceneStrength ?? 1.0;

    30→  }

     5→ * File structure:

     7→ * - generation-handlers.ts: All handlers

    14→import { extractShotAndPosition, extractBasedOn } from './params.ts';

    35→type GenerationSkipReason =
    36→  | 'orchestration_task'
    37→  | 'skip_generation_flag';
    38→
    39→interface GenerationRef {
    40→  id: string;
    41→}
    42→
    43→export type GenerationCreationOutcome =
    44→  | { status: 'skipped'; reason: GenerationSkipReason }
    45→  | { status: 'created'; generation: GenerationRef };
    46→
    47→interface CompletedTaskData {
    48→  category?: string;
    49→  task_type?: string;
    50→  tool_type?: string;
    51→  project_id?: string;
    52→  params: Record<string, unknown>;
    53→}
    54→
    55→interface GenerationRouteParams {
    56→  basedOn: string | null;
    57→  createAsGeneration: boolean;
    58→  childGenerationId: string | null;
    59→  parentGenerationId: string | null;
    60→  childOrder: number | null;
    61→  isSingleItem: boolean;
    62→  isStitchTask: boolean;
    63→}
    64→
    65→interface GenerationHandlerContext {
    66→  supabase: SupabaseClient;
    67→  taskId: string;
    68→  taskData: CompletedTaskData;
    69→  publicUrl: string;
    70→  thumbnailUrl: string | null;
    71→  logger?: unknown;
    72→  childGenerationId?: string;
    73→  parentGenerationId?: string;
    74→  childOrder?: number | null;
    75→  isSingleItem?: boolean;
    76→}
    77→
    78→type GenerationRouteAttempt =
    79→  | 'variant_on_child'
    80→  | 'variant_on_parent'
    81→  | 'child_generation'
    82→  | 'standalone';
    83→
    84→function toGenerationRef(value: unknown): GenerationRef | null {
    85→  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') {
    86→    return null;
    87→  }
    88→
    89→  const candidate = value as { id?: unknown };
    90→  if (typeof candidate.id !== 'string' || candidate.id.length === 0) {
    91→    return null;
    92→  }
    93→
    94→  return { id: candidate.id };
    95→}
    96→
    97→function normalizeCompletedTaskData(taskData: unknown): CompletedTaskData {
    98→  const record = asObjectOrEmpty(taskData);
    99→  return {
   100→    category: typeof record.category === 'string' ? record.category : undefined,
   101→    task_type: typeof record.task_type === 'string' ? record.task_type : undefined,
   102→    tool_type: typeof record.tool_type === 'string' ? record.tool_type : undefined,
   103→    project_id: typeof record.project_id === 'string' ? record.project_id : undefined,
   104→    params: asObjectOrEmpty(record.params),
   105→  };
   106→}
   107→
   108→function getGenerationSkipReason(taskData: CompletedTaskData): GenerationSkipReason | null {
   109→  if (taskData.category === 'orchestration') {
   110→    return 'orchestration_task';
   111→  }
   112→
   113→  if (taskData.params.skip_generation === true) {
   114→    return 'skip_generation_flag';
   115→  }
   116→
   117→  return null;
   118→}
   119→
   120→function resolveGenerationRouteParams(taskData: CompletedTaskData): GenerationRouteParams {
   121→  const params = taskData.params;
   122→  const payloadSnapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   123→
   124→  const basedOn = extractBasedOn(params);
   125→  const createAsGeneration = (
   126→    params.create_as_generation === true
   127→    || payloadSnapshot.orchestrationContract.create_as_generation === true
   128→  );
   129→
   130→  const childGenerationId = resolveSnapshotChildGenerationId(payloadSnapshot);
   131→  const parentGenerationId = resolveSnapshotParentGenerationId(payloadSnapshot);
   132→  const childOrder = resolveSnapshotChildOrder(payloadSnapshot);
   133→  const isSingleItem = resolveSnapshotIsSingleItem(payloadSnapshot);
   134→
   135→  const isStitchTask = taskData.task_type === TASK_TYPES.TRAVEL_STITCH
   136→    || taskData.task_type === TASK_TYPES.JOIN_FINAL_STITCH;
   137→
   138→  return {
   139→    basedOn,
   140→    createAsGeneration,
   141→    childGenerationId,
   142→    parentGenerationId,
   143→    childOrder,
   144→    isSingleItem,
   145→    isStitchTask,
   146→  };
   147→}
   148→
   149→function classifyGenerationRouteAttempts(routeParams: GenerationRouteParams): GenerationRouteAttempt[] {
   150→  const attempts: GenerationRouteAttempt[] = [];
   151→
   152→  if (routeParams.childGenerationId) {
   153→    attempts.push('variant_on_child');
   154→  }
   155→
   156→  if (routeParams.isStitchTask && routeParams.parentGenerationId) {
   157→    attempts.push('variant_on_parent');
   158→  }
   159→
   160→  if (routeParams.parentGenerationId) {
   161→    attempts.push('child_generation');
   162→  }
   163→
   164→  attempts.push('standalone');
   165→  return attempts;
   166→}
   167→
   168→async function executeGenerationRouteAttempt(
   169→  attempt: GenerationRouteAttempt,
   170→  ctx: GenerationHandlerContext,
   171→): Promise<GenerationRef | null> {
   172→  switch (attempt) {
   173→    case 'variant_on_child':
   174→      return toGenerationRef(await handleVariantOnChild(ctx));
   175→    case 'variant_on_parent':
   176→      return toGenerationRef(await handleVariantOnParent(ctx));
   177→    case 'child_generation':
   178→      return toGenerationRef(await handleChildGeneration(ctx));
   179→    case 'standalone':
   180→      return toGenerationRef(await handleStandaloneGeneration(ctx));
   181→  }
   182→}
   183→
   184→/**
   185→ * Main function to create generation from completed task
   186→ *
   187→ * PARAMS-DRIVEN ROUTING - all 6 cases in one place:
   188→ * 1. Regeneration: existing generation for this task → add variant
   189→ * 2. Variant on source: based_on present → variant on that generation
   190→ * 3. Variant on child: child_generation_id present → variant on existing child
   191→ * 4. Stitch task: travel_stitch/join_final_stitch → variant on parent
   192→ * 5. Child generation: parent_generation_id present → child under parent
   193→ * 6. Standalone: neither → independent generation
   194→ *
   195→ * Single-item detection: is_single_item param OR (is_first_segment && is_last_segment)
   196→ * Child order: child_order OR segment_index OR join_index
   197→ */
   198→export async function createGenerationFromTask(
   199→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   200→  taskId: string,
   201→  taskData: unknown,
   202→  publicUrl: string,
   203→  thumbnailUrl: string | null | undefined,
   204→  logger?: unknown,
   205→  authContext: CompletionAuthContext,
   206→): Promise<GenerationCreationOutcome> {
   207→  assertCompletionAuthContext(authContext, 'createGenerationFromTask');
   208→
   209→  const normalizedTaskData = normalizeCompletedTaskData(taskData);
   210→  const skipReason = getGenerationSkipReason(normalizedTaskData);
   211→  if (skipReason) {
   212→    return { status: 'skipped', reason: skipReason };
   213→  }
   214→
   215→  const routeParams = resolveGenerationRouteParams(normalizedTaskData);
   216→
   217→  logger?.debug("Generation routing", {
   218→    task_id: taskId,
   219→    based_on: routeParams.basedOn,
   220→    child_generation_id: routeParams.childGenerationId,
   221→    parent_generation_id: routeParams.parentGenerationId,
   222→    child_order: routeParams.childOrder,
   223→    is_single_item: routeParams.isSingleItem,
   224→    is_stitch_task: routeParams.isStitchTask,
   225→  });
   226→
   227→  try {
   228→    const existingGenerationRaw = await findExistingGeneration(supabase, taskId);
   229→    const existingGeneration = toGenerationRef(existingGenerationRaw);
   230→    if (existingGenerationRaw && !existingGeneration) {
   231→      throw new CompletionError({
   232→        code: 'generation_existing_shape_invalid',
   233→        context: 'createGenerationFromTask',
   234→        recoverable: false,
   235→        message: `Existing generation lookup returned an invalid shape for task ${taskId}`,
   236→        metadata: { task_id: taskId },
   237→      });
   238→    }
   239→
   240→    if (existingGeneration) {
   241→      const generation = await handleRegeneration(
   242→        supabase,
   243→        taskId,
   244→        normalizedTaskData,
   245→        existingGeneration,
   246→        publicUrl,
   247→        thumbnailUrl,
   248→        logger,
   249→      );
   250→      return { status: 'created', generation };
   251→    }
   252→
   253→    if (routeParams.basedOn && !routeParams.createAsGeneration) {
   254→      const success = await handleVariantCreation(
   255→        supabase,
   256→        taskId,
   257→        normalizedTaskData,
   258→        routeParams.basedOn,
   259→        publicUrl,
   260→        thumbnailUrl,
   261→      );
   262→      if (success) {
   263→        return { status: 'created', generation: { id: routeParams.basedOn } };
   264→      }
   265→    }
   266→
   267→    const handlerContext: GenerationHandlerContext = {
   268→      supabase,
   269→      taskId,
   270→      taskData: normalizedTaskData,
   271→      publicUrl,
   272→      thumbnailUrl: thumbnailUrl || null,
   273→      logger,
   274→      childGenerationId: routeParams.childGenerationId ?? undefined,
   275→      parentGenerationId: routeParams.parentGenerationId ?? undefined,
   276→      childOrder: routeParams.childOrder,
   277→      isSingleItem: routeParams.isSingleItem,
   278→    };
   279→
   280→    for (const attempt of classifyGenerationRouteAttempts(routeParams)) {
   281→      const generation = await executeGenerationRouteAttempt(attempt, handlerContext);
   282→      if (generation) {
   283→        return { status: 'created', generation };
   284→      }
   285→    }
   286→
   287→    throw new CompletionError({
   288→      code: 'generation_route_no_result',
   289→      context: 'createGenerationFromTask',
   290→      recoverable: false,
   291→      message: `No generation route produced a result for task ${taskId}`,
   292→      metadata: {
   293→        task_id: taskId,
   294→        task_type: normalizedTaskData.task_type,
   295→        route_attempts: classifyGenerationRouteAttempts(routeParams),
   296→      },
   297→    });
   298→
   299→  } catch (error) {
   300→    const normalizedError = toCompletionError(error, {
   301→      code: 'generation_completion_failed',
   302→      context: 'createGenerationFromTask',
   303→      recoverable: true,
   304→      message: `Failed to create generation for task ${taskId}`,
   305→      metadata: {
   306→        task_id: taskId,
   307→        task_type: normalizedTaskData.task_type,
   308→      },
   309→    });
   310→    logger?.error("Error creating generation", {
   311→      task_id: taskId,
   312→      error: normalizedError.message,
   313→      error_code: normalizedError.code,
   314→      recoverable: normalizedError.recoverable,
   315→      error_context: normalizedError.context,
   316→      error_metadata: normalizedError.metadata,
   317→    });
   318→    throw normalizedError;
   319→  }
   320→}
   321→
   322→/**
   323→ * Handle regeneration case - task already has a generation, create new variant
   324→ */
   325→async function handleRegeneration(
   326→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   327→  taskId: string,
   328→  taskData: CompletedTaskData,
   329→  existingGeneration: GenerationRef,
   330→  publicUrl: string,
   331→  thumbnailUrl: string | null | undefined,
   332→  logger?: unknown
   333→): Promise<GenerationRef> {
   334→  logger?.info("Existing generation found - creating regenerated variant", {
   335→    task_id: taskId,
   336→    existing_generation_id: existingGeneration.id,
   337→    action: "create_regenerated_variant"
   338→  });
   339→
   340→  const variantParams = {
   341→    ...taskData.params,
   342→    source_task_id: taskId,
   343→    created_from: 'task_completion',
   344→    tool_type: taskData.tool_type,
   345→  };
   346→
   347→  await createVariant(
   348→    supabase,
   349→    existingGeneration.id,
   350→    publicUrl,
   351→    thumbnailUrl || null,
   352→    variantParams,
   353→    true,
   354→    'regenerated',
   355→    null
   356→  );
   357→
   358→  const { shotId, addInPosition } = extractShotAndPosition(taskData.params);
   359→  if (shotId) {
   360→    await linkGenerationToShot(supabase, shotId, existingGeneration.id, addInPosition);
   361→  }
   362→
   363→  const { error: markGenerationCreatedError } = await supabase
   364→    .from('tasks')
   365→    .update({ generation_created: true })
   366→    .eq('id', taskId);
   367→
   368→  if (markGenerationCreatedError) {
   369→    throw new CompletionError({
   370→      code: 'regeneration_generation_created_update_failed',
   371→      context: 'handleRegeneration',
   372→      recoverable: true,
   373→      message: `Failed to persist generation_created marker for task ${taskId}`,
   374→      metadata: {
   375→        task_id: taskId,
   376→        existing_generation_id: existingGeneration.id,
   377→      },
   378→      cause: markGenerationCreatedError,
   379→    });
   380→  }
   381→
   382→  return existingGeneration;
   383→}
   384→

1→/**
     2→ * Enforces a consistent provider-guard error for context hooks.
     3→ */
     4→export function requireContextValue<T>(
     5→  context: T | undefined | null,
     6→  hookName: string,
     7→  providerName: string,
     8→): T {
     9→  if (context === undefined || context === null) {
    10→    const article = /^a/i.test(providerName) ? 'an' : 'a';
    11→    throw new Error(
    12→      `${hookName} must be used within ${article} ${providerName}. ` +
    13→        `Make sure the component is rendered inside the ${providerName} tree.`,
    14→    );
    15→  }
    16→  return context;
    17→}

1→export type OperationFailurePolicy = 'fail_closed' | 'fail_open' | 'degrade' | 'best_effort';
     2→
     3→export interface OperationFailure {
     4→  ok: false;
     5→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
     6→  recoverable: boolean;
     7→  error: Error;
     8→  errorCode: string;
     9→  message: string;
    10→  cause?: unknown;
    11→}
    12→
    13→export interface OperationSuccess<T = void> {
    14→  ok: true;
    15→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    16→  recoverable: false;
    17→  value: T;
    18→}
    19→
    20→export type OperationResult<T = void> = OperationSuccess<T> | OperationFailure;
    21→
    22→interface OperationSuccessOptions {
    23→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface OperationFailureOptions {
    27→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    28→  recoverable?: boolean;
    29→  errorCode?: string;
    30→  message?: string;
    31→  cause?: unknown;
    32→}
    33→
    34→export function operationSuccess<T>(
    35→  value: T,
    36→  options?: OperationSuccessOptions,
    37→): OperationSuccess<T> {
    38→  return {
    39→    ok: true,
    40→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    41→    recoverable: false,
    42→    value,
    43→  };
    44→}
    45→
    46→export function operationFailure(
    47→  error: unknown,
    48→  options?: OperationFailureOptions,
    49→): OperationFailure {
    50→  const normalizedError = error instanceof Error
    51→    ? error
    52→    : new Error(options?.message ?? String(error));
    53→
    54→  return {
    55→    ok: false,
    56→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    57→    recoverable: options?.recoverable ?? true,
    58→    error: normalizedError,
    59→    errorCode: options?.errorCode ?? 'operation_failed',
    60→    message: options?.message ?? normalizedError.message,
    61→    cause: options?.cause,
    62→  };
    63→}
    64→

     4→ * Prevents network exhaustion by serializing and coalescing settings writes.
     5→ *
     6→ * Features:

     8→ * - Per-target debouncing (coalesces rapid updates)

    10→ * - Optional AbortSignal passthrough for caller cancellation

    46→  if (typeof DOMException !== 'undefined') {

    48→  }
    49→  const error = new Error('Request was cancelled');
    50→  error.name = 'AbortError';

    53→
    54→function throwIfAborted(signal?: AbortSignal): void {

    80→}

    83→  return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : undefined;
    84→}
    85→
    86→function parseString(value: unknown): string | undefined {
    87→  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : undefined;
    88→}
    89→
    90→function hasLegacyField(
    91→  value: unknown,
    92→  field: string,
    93→): boolean {
    94→  return Boolean(
    95→    value
    96→    && typeof value === 'object'
    97→    && !Array.isArray(value)
    98→    && field in (value as Record<string, unknown>)
    99→    && (value as Record<string, unknown>)[field] !== undefined,
   100→  );
   101→}

   103→export interface TravelStructureLegacyUsage {
   104→  topLevelFields: LegacyTopLevelField[];
   105→  structureVideoFields: LegacyStructureVideoField[];
   106→}
   107→
   108→export function collectTravelStructureLegacyUsage(
   109→  value: unknown,
   110→): TravelStructureLegacyUsage {
   111→  const record = value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
   112→    ? (value as Record<string, unknown>)
   113→    : {};
   114→
   115→  const topLevelFields = LEGACY_TRAVEL_TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS.filter(
   116→    (field) => record[field] !== undefined,
   117→  );
   118→
   119→  const structureVideos = Array.isArray(record.structure_videos)
   120→    ? record.structure_videos
   121→    : [];
   122→  const structureVideoFields = LEGACY_TRAVEL_STRUCTURE_VIDEO_FIELDS.filter((field) =>
   123→    structureVideos.some((entry) => hasLegacyField(entry, field)),
   124→  );
   125→
   126→  return { topLevelFields, structureVideoFields };
   127→}
   128→
   129→export function enforceTravelStructureLegacyPolicy(
   130→  usage: TravelStructureLegacyUsage,
   131→  options?: {
   132→    context?: string;
   133→    enforcement?: 'warn' | 'throw' | 'auto';
   134→  },
   135→): boolean {
   136→  const usedFields = [...usage.topLevelFields, ...usage.structureVideoFields];
   137→  if (usedFields.length === 0) {
   138→    return false;
   139→  }
   140→
   141→  const details = usedFields.join(', ');
   142→  return signalPastRemovalTargetUsage({
   143→    alias: 'travel_between_images.legacy_structure_fields',
   144→    policy: legacyStructurePolicy,
   145→    remediation: `Migrate to structure_guidance + canonical structure_videos. Legacy fields seen: ${details}.` +
   146→      (options?.context ? ` Context: ${options.context}.` : ''),
   147→    enforcement: options?.enforcement ?? 'auto',
   148→  });
   149→}
   150→
   151→/**
   152→ * Canonical migration adapter for legacy structure-video settings.
   153→ * Preserves explicit structure_type values and only falls back to defaults
   154→ * when legacy payloads omit type information.
   155→ */
   156→export function migrateLegacyStructureVideos(
   157→  value: unknown,
   158→  options: LegacyStructureVideoMigrationOptions,
   159→): MigratedLegacyStructureVideo[] {
   160→  const settings = asRecord(value);
   161→  if (!settings) {
   162→    return [];
   163→  }
   164→
   165→  const topLevelStructureType = parseStructureType(
   166→    settings.structure_video_type ?? settings.structureType,
   167→  );
   168→  const topLevelTreatment = parseTreatment(
   169→    settings.structure_video_treatment ?? settings.treatment,
   170→  );
   171→  const topLevelMotionStrength = parseNumber(
   172→    settings.structure_video_motion_strength ?? settings.motionStrength,
   173→  );
   174→  const topLevelUni3cEndPercent = parseNumber(settings.uni3c_end_percent);
   175→
   176→  const rawStructureVideos = Array.isArray(settings.structure_videos)
   177→    ? settings.structure_videos
   178→    : null;
   179→  if (rawStructureVideos) {
   180→    return rawStructureVideos
   181→      .map((entry) => {
   182→        const record = asRecord(entry);
   183→        if (!record) {
   184→          return null;
   185→        }
   186→
   187→        const path = parseString(record.path);
   188→        if (!path) {
   189→          return null;
   190→        }
   191→
   192→        const metadata = asRecord(record.metadata);
   193→        const resourceId = parseString(record.resource_id);
   194→        return {
   195→          path,
   196→          start_frame: parseNumber(record.start_frame) ?? 0,
   197→          end_frame: parseNumber(record.end_frame) ?? options.defaultEndFrame,
   198→          treatment: parseTreatment(record.treatment) ?? topLevelTreatment ?? options.defaultVideoTreatment,
   199→          motion_strength: parseNumber(record.motion_strength) ?? topLevelMotionStrength ?? options.defaultMotionStrength,
   200→          structure_type: parseStructureType(record.structure_type) ?? topLevelStructureType ?? options.defaultStructureType,
   201→          uni3c_end_percent: parseNumber(record.uni3c_end_percent) ?? topLevelUni3cEndPercent ?? options.defaultUni3cEndPercent,
   202→          metadata: metadata as VideoMetadata | null ?? null,
   203→          resource_id: resourceId ?? null,
   204→        } satisfies MigratedLegacyStructureVideo;
   205→      })
   206→      .filter((entry): entry is MigratedLegacyStructureVideo => entry !== null);
   207→  }
   208→
   209→  const singlePath = parseString(settings.structure_video_path ?? settings.path);
   210→  if (!singlePath) {
   211→    return [];
   212→  }
   213→
   214→  const metadata = asRecord(settings.metadata);
   215→  const resourceId = parseString(settings.resource_id ?? settings.resourceId);
   216→  return [{
   217→    path: singlePath,
   218→    start_frame: 0,
   219→    end_frame: options.defaultEndFrame,
   220→    treatment: topLevelTreatment ?? options.defaultVideoTreatment,
   221→    motion_strength: topLevelMotionStrength ?? options.defaultMotionStrength,
   222→    structure_type: topLevelStructureType ?? options.defaultStructureType,
   223→    uni3c_end_percent: topLevelUni3cEndPercent ?? options.defaultUni3cEndPercent,
   224→    metadata: metadata as VideoMetadata | null ?? null,
   225→    resource_id: resourceId ?? null,
   226→  }];
   227→}

    49→/**
    50→ * Hook for quick shot creation with image (UI wrapper around useShotCreation)
    51→ * 
    52→ * Used by:
    53→ * - ShotSelectorWithAdd
    54→ * - MediaGalleryItem
    55→ * - MediaLightbox (via useShotCreation wrapper)
    56→ * 
    57→ * This is a thin wrapper that adds:
    58→ * - Success state management (for "Visit Shot" button)
    59→ * - Navigation handling
    60→ * - External loading state sync
    61→ * 
    62→ * Core shot creation logic is delegated to useShotCreation.
    63→ */
    64→export const useQuickShotCreate = ({
    65→  generationId,
    66→  generationPreview,
    67→  shots,
    68→  onShotChange,
    69→  onClose,
    70→  onLoadingStart,
    71→  onLoadingEnd,
    72→}: UseQuickShotCreateProps): UseQuickShotCreateReturn => {
    73→  const { navigateToShot } = useShotNavigation();
    74→  const { createShot, isCreating } = useShotCreation();
    75→
    76→  const [quickCreateSuccess, setQuickCreateSuccess] = useState<QuickCreateSuccessState>({
    77→    isSuccessful: false,
    78→    shotId: null,
    79→    shotName: null,
    80→    isLoading: false,
    81→  });
    82→
    83→  const clearQuickCreateSuccess = useCallback(() => {
    84→    setQuickCreateSuccess({
    85→      isSuccessful: false,
    86→      shotId: null,
    87→      shotName: null,
    88→      isLoading: false,
    89→    });
    90→  }, []);
    91→
    92→  const handleQuickCreateAndAdd = useCallback(async (shotName?: string) => {
    93→
    94→    onLoadingStart?.();
    95→    
    96→    try {
    97→      // Use unified shot creation hook
    98→      const result = await createShot({
    99→        generationId,
   100→        generationPreview,
   101→        // Use provided name or let useShotCreation auto-generate
   102→        name: shotName || undefined,
   103→        // Settings inheritance and lastAffectedShot are handled automatically
   104→      });
   105→
   106→      if (!result) {
   107→        // Error already shown by useShotCreation
   108→        return;
   109→      }
   110→
   111→      // Select the newly created shot in the dropdown
   112→      onShotChange?.(result.shotId);
   113→
   114→      // Set success state with loading=true initially while cache syncs
   115→      setQuickCreateSuccess({
   116→        isSuccessful: true,
   117→        shotId: result.shotId,
   118→        shotName: result.shotName,
   119→        isLoading: true,
   120→      });
   121→
   122→      // After a brief delay for UI/cache to settle, show the Visit button as ready
   123→      setTimeout(() => {
   124→        setQuickCreateSuccess(prev =>
   125→          prev.shotId === result.shotId
   126→            ? { ...prev, isLoading: false }
   127→            : prev
   128→        );
   129→      }, 150);
   130→
   131→      // Clear success state after 5 seconds
   132→      setTimeout(() => {
   133→        clearQuickCreateSuccess();
   134→      }, 5000);
   135→
   136→    } catch (error) {
   137→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {

   139→        toastTitle: 'Failed to create shot and add image. Please try again.'
   140→      });
   141→    } finally {

   143→    }
   144→  }, [

   148→    onShotChange,

   150→    onLoadingEnd,

   156→

   159→
   160→    // Try to find the shot in the list first

   162→

   165→      navigateToShot({

   167→        name: shot.name,
   168→        images: [],
   169→        position: 0,
   170→      }, { isNewlyCreated: true });
   171→    } else {

   174→        id: quickCreateSuccess.shotId,
   175→        name: quickCreateSuccess.shotName || 'Shot',
   176→        images: [],
   177→        position: 0,
   178→      }, { isNewlyCreated: true });
   179→    }
   180→
   181→    // Clear the success state

   183→  }, [quickCreateSuccess, shots, navigateToShot, onClose, clearQuickCreateSuccess]);
   184→
   185→  return {
   186→    isCreatingShot: isCreating,
   187→    quickCreateSuccess,
   188→    handleQuickCreateAndAdd,
   189→    handleQuickCreateSuccess,

   169→    // After DOM updates, restore scroll so the (new) swap button stays in the same place
   170→    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
   171→      const newButton = swapButtonRef.current;
   172→      if (!newButton) return;
   173→      const rectAfter = newButton.getBoundingClientRect();
   174→      const scrollDelta = rectAfter.top - offsetFromTop;
   175→      if (Math.abs(scrollDelta) > 1) {
   176→        window.scrollBy({ top: scrollDelta, behavior: 'instant' });
   177→      }
   178→    });
   179→  }, [setGenerateMode, swapButtonRef]);

   202→    joinKeepBridgingImages, joinEnhancePrompt, joinModel, joinNumInferenceSteps,
   203→    joinGuidanceScale, joinSeed, joinMotionMode, joinPhaseConfig,
   204→    joinSelectedPhasePresetId, joinRandomSeed, joinUpdateField, joinUpdateFields,
   205→  ]);
   206→
   207→  // LoRA manager interface for Join Segments (shot-level persistence via joinSettings)
   208→  // This creates a compatible interface with useLoraManager for the JoinClipsSettingsForm
   209→  // Uses joinSelectedLorasRef in handlers so they always read the latest value at call time.
   210→  const joinLoraManager = useMemo((): JoinLoraManager => ({
   211→    selectedLoras: joinSelectedLoras,
   212→    setSelectedLoras: (loras: SelectedLora[]) => {
   213→      joinUpdateField('selectedLoras', loras);
   214→    },
   215→    isLoraModalOpen: isJoinLoraModalOpen,
   216→    setIsLoraModalOpen: (open: boolean) => setIsJoinLoraModalOpen(open),
   217→    handleAddLora: (loraToAdd: LoraModel, _isManualAction = true, initialStrength?: number) => {
   218→      const currentLoras = joinSelectedLorasRef.current;
   219→      if (currentLoras.find(sl => sl.id === loraToAdd["Model ID"])) {
   220→        return; // Already exists
   221→      }
   222→      if (loraToAdd["Model Files"] && loraToAdd["Model Files"].length > 0) {
   223→        const loraName = loraToAdd.Name !== "N/A" ? loraToAdd.Name : loraToAdd["Model ID"];
   224→        const hasHighNoise = !!loraToAdd.high_noise_url;
   225→        const hasLowNoise = !!loraToAdd.low_noise_url;
   226→        const isMultiStage = hasHighNoise || hasLowNoise;
   227→        const primaryPath = isMultiStage
   228→          ? (loraToAdd.high_noise_url || loraToAdd.low_noise_url)
   229→          : (loraToAdd["Model Files"][0].url || loraToAdd["Model Files"][0].path);
   230→
   231→        const newLora: SelectedLora = {
   232→          id: loraToAdd["Model ID"],
   233→          name: loraName,
   234→          path: (hasHighNoise ? loraToAdd.high_noise_url : primaryPath) ?? '',
   235→          strength: initialStrength || 1.0,
   236→          previewImageUrl: loraToAdd.Images?.[0]?.url,
   237→          trigger_word: loraToAdd.trigger_word,
   238→          lowNoisePath: hasLowNoise ? loraToAdd.low_noise_url : undefined,
   239→          isMultiStage,
   240→        };
   241→        joinUpdateField('selectedLoras', [...currentLoras, newLora]);
   242→      }
   243→    },
   244→    handleRemoveLora: (loraId: string) => {
   245→      joinUpdateField('selectedLoras', joinSelectedLorasRef.current.filter(l => l.id !== loraId));
   246→    },
   247→    handleLoraStrengthChange: (loraId: string, newStrength: number) => {

   250→      );
   251→    },

   100→export class ToolSettingsError extends Error {
   101→  readonly code: ToolSettingsErrorCode;
   102→  readonly recoverable: boolean;
   103→  readonly metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
   104→  readonly cause?: unknown;
   105→
   106→  constructor(
   107→    code: ToolSettingsErrorCode,
   108→    message: string,

   111→    super(message);
   112→    this.name = 'ToolSettingsError';
   113→    this.code = code;

   124→export function classifyToolSettingsError(error: unknown): ToolSettingsError {
   125→  if (isToolSettingsError(error)) {

   127→  }
   128→
   129→  if (isCancellationError(error)) {
   130→    return new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   131→      recoverable: true,
   132→      cause: error,

   139→      recoverable: false,
   140→      cause: error,
   141→    });
   142→  }
   143→
   144→  if (

   148→    || message.includes('Network exhaustion')

   150→    return new ToolSettingsError('network', message, {
   151→      recoverable: true,
   152→      cause: error,
   153→    });
   154→  }
   155→
   156→  return new ToolSettingsError('unknown', message, {
   157→    recoverable: false,
   158→    cause: error,
   159→  });
   160→}

   163→  return operationFailure(error, {
   164→    policy: error.recoverable ? 'best_effort' : 'fail_closed',
   165→    recoverable: error.recoverable,
   166→    errorCode: error.code,
   167→    message: error.message,
   168→    cause: error.cause,
   169→  });

   177→    || code === 'network'
   178→    || code === 'scope_fetch_failed'
   179→    || code === 'invalid_scope_identifier'
   180→    || code === 'unknown'
   181→  ) ? code : 'unknown';

   189→/** The wrapper format returned by fetchToolSettingsSupabase */
   190→export interface SettingsFetchResult<T = unknown> {

   195→// ============================================================================
   196→// Auth helpers
   197→// ============================================================================
   198→
   199→/**
   200→ * Get authenticated user ID without acquiring navigator.locks.
   201→ *
   202→ * Resolution order (all synchronous / lock-free):
   203→ *   1. In-memory cache (set by AuthContext via setCachedUserId)
   204→ *   2. localStorage session (same key Supabase uses; contains full user object)
   205→ *   3. null — user is genuinely signed out
   206→ *
   207→ * Previously this called getSession() / getUser() which both acquire a shared
   208→ * navigator.lock. During token refresh Supabase holds an EXCLUSIVE lock, so
   209→ * ALL shared-lock requests queue behind it — blocking for 600ms-16s. By reading
   210→ * the user ID from localStorage instead we avoid locks entirely. Token validity
   211→ * for actual data requests is handled by createSupabaseClient's cached token.
   212→ */
   213→export function getCachedUserId(): Promise<{ data: { user: { id: string } | null }; error: null }> {
   214→  // Check in-memory cache first
   215→  if (cachedUser && (Date.now() - cachedUserAt) < USER_CACHE_MS) {
   216→    return Promise.resolve({ data: { user: { id: cachedUser.id } }, error: null });
   217→  }
   218→
   219→  // Read from localStorage — synchronous, no navigator.locks, always fresh
   220→  const localUserId = readUserIdFromStorage();
   221→  if (localUserId) {
   222→    cachedUser = { id: localUserId };
   223→    cachedUserAt = Date.now();
   224→    return Promise.resolve({ data: { user: { id: localUserId } }, error: null });
   225→  }
   226→
   227→  // No session in storage — user is signed out
   228→  return Promise.resolve({ data: { user: null }, error: null });
   229→}

   232→// Settings fetch helpers
   233→// ============================================================================

   235→type SettingsRow = { data: { settings: unknown } | null; error: unknown };

   237→function throwIfAborted(signal?: AbortSignal): void {
   238→  if (!signal?.aborted) {
   239→    return;
   240→  }
   241→
   242→  throw new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   243→    recoverable: true,
   244→  });
   245→}
   246→
   247→type AbortableQuery<T> = {
   248→  abortSignal?: (signal: AbortSignal) => T;
   249→};
   250→
   251→function maybeAttachAbortSignal<T>(query: T, signal?: AbortSignal): T {
   252→  if (!signal) {
   253→    return query;
   254→  }
   255→
   256→  const abortable = query as AbortableQuery<T>;
   257→  if (typeof abortable.abortSignal === 'function') {
   258→    return abortable.abortSignal(signal);
   259→  }
   260→
   261→  return query;
   262→}
   263→
   264→async function raceWithAbort<T>(promise: Promise<T>, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<T> {
   265→  if (!signal) {
   266→    return promise;
   267→  }
   268→
   269→  throwIfAborted(signal);
   270→
   271→  return await new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
   272→    const onAbort = () => {
   273→      cleanup();
   274→      reject(new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   275→        recoverable: true,
   276→      }));
   277→    };
   278→
   279→    const cleanup = () => {
   280→      signal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
   281→    };
   282→
   283→    signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
   284→    promise.then(
   285→      (value) => {
   286→        cleanup();
   287→        resolve(value);
   288→      },
   289→      (error) => {
   290→        cleanup();
   291→        reject(error);
   292→      },
   293→    );
   294→  });
   295→}

   297→/** Fetch settings from all three scopes (user, project, shot) in parallel. */
   298→function fetchAllScopes(
   299→  supabaseClient: ReturnType<typeof getSupabaseClient>,
   300→  userId: string,
   301→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,
   302→  signal?: AbortSignal,
   303→): Promise<[SettingsRow, SettingsRow, SettingsRow]> {
   304→  const userQuery = maybeAttachAbortSignal(
   305→    supabaseClient
   306→      .from('users')
   307→      .select('settings')
   308→      .eq('id', userId)
   309→      .maybeSingle(),
   310→    signal,
   311→  );
   312→
   313→  const projectQuery = ctx.projectId
   314→    ? maybeAttachAbortSignal(
   315→        supabaseClient
   316→          .from('projects')
   317→          .select('settings')
   318→          .eq('id', ctx.projectId)
   319→          .maybeSingle(),
   320→        signal,
   321→      )
   322→    : Promise.resolve({ data: null, error: null });
   323→
   324→  const shotQuery = ctx.shotId
   325→    ? maybeAttachAbortSignal(
   326→        supabaseClient
   327→          .from('shots')
   328→          .select('settings')
   329→          .eq('id', ctx.shotId)
   330→          .maybeSingle(),
   331→        signal,
   332→      )
   333→    : Promise.resolve({ data: null, error: null });
   334→
   335→  return Promise.all([
   336→    userQuery,
   337→    projectQuery,
   338→    shotQuery,
   339→  ]) as Promise<[SettingsRow, SettingsRow, SettingsRow]>;
   340→}

   342→/** Extract tool-specific settings from scope results and merge in priority order. */
   343→function extractAndMergeSettings(
   344→  userResult: SettingsRow,
   345→  projectResult: SettingsRow,
   346→  shotResult: SettingsRow,
   347→  toolId: string,
   348→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,
   349→): SettingsFetchResult {
   350→  if (userResult.error) {
   351→    throw new ToolSettingsError(
   352→      'scope_fetch_failed',
   353→      `Failed to load user settings: ${getErrorMessage(userResult.error)}`,
   354→      { recoverable: true, cause: userResult.error, metadata: { scope: 'user' } },
   355→    );
   356→  }
   357→  if (ctx.projectId && projectResult.error) {
   358→    throw new ToolSettingsError(
   359→      'scope_fetch_failed',
   360→      `Failed to load project settings: ${getErrorMessage(projectResult.error)}`,
   361→      { recoverable: true, cause: projectResult.error, metadata: { scope: 'project', projectId: ctx.projectId } },
   362→    );
   363→  }
   364→  if (ctx.shotId && shotResult.error) {
   365→    throw new ToolSettingsError(
   366→      'scope_fetch_failed',
   367→      `Failed to load shot settings: ${getErrorMessage(shotResult.error)}`,
   368→      { recoverable: true, cause: shotResult.error, metadata: { scope: 'shot', shotId: ctx.shotId } },
   369→    );
   370→  }
   371→
   372→  const userSettingsData = userResult.data?.settings as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   373→  const projectSettingsData = projectResult.data?.settings as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   374→  const shotSettingsData = shotResult.data?.settings as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   375→  const userSettings = (userSettingsData?.[toolId] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
   376→  const projectSettings = (projectSettingsData?.[toolId] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
   377→  const shotSettings = (shotSettingsData?.[toolId] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
   378→  const defaultSettings = (toolDefaultsRegistry[toolId] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined) ?? {};
   379→
   380→  const hasShotSettings = shotSettings && Object.keys(shotSettings).length > 0;
   381→
   382→  // Merge in priority order: defaults -> user -> project -> shot
   383→  const merged = deepMerge(
   384→    {},
   385→    defaultSettings,
   386→    userSettings,
   387→    projectSettings,
   388→    shotSettings
   389→  );
   390→
   391→  return { settings: merged, hasShotSettings };
   392→}
   393→
   394→// ============================================================================
   395→// Settings fetch
   396→// ============================================================================
   397→
   398→/**
   399→ * Fetch and merge tool settings from all scopes using direct Supabase calls.
   400→ *
   401→ * Pipeline: dedup → auth → fetchAllScopes → extractAndMerge.
   402→ * Uses single-flight deduplication for concurrent identical requests.
   403→ *
   404→ * @returns `{ settings, hasShotSettings }` wrapper
   405→ */
   406→export async function fetchToolSettingsSupabase(
   407→  toolId: string,
   408→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,
   409→  signal?: AbortSignal
   410→): Promise<OperationResult<SettingsFetchResult>> {
   411→  try {
   412→    reportUnknownSettingsId(toolId);
   413→
   414→    // Check if request was cancelled before starting
   415→    if (signal?.aborted) {
   416→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   417→        recoverable: true,
   418→      }));
   419→    }
   420→
   421→    // Single-flight dedupe key for concurrent identical requests
   422→    const singleFlightKey = JSON.stringify({ toolId, projectId: ctx.projectId ?? null, shotId: ctx.shotId ?? null });
   423→    const existingPromise = inflightSettingsFetches.get(singleFlightKey);
   424→    if (existingPromise) {
   425→      const value = await raceWithAbort(existingPromise as Promise<SettingsFetchResult>, signal);
   426→      return operationSuccess(value);
   427→    }
   428→
   429→    const promise = (async (): Promise<SettingsFetchResult> => {
   430→      throwIfAborted(signal);
   431→
   432→      const { data: { user } } = await getCachedUserId();
   433→
   434→      if (!user) {
   435→        throw new ToolSettingsError('auth_required', 'Authentication required');
   436→      }
   437→
   438→      throwIfAborted(signal);
   439→
   440→      const supabaseClient = getSupabaseClient();
   441→      const [userResult, projectResult, shotResult] = await fetchAllScopes(supabaseClient, user.id, ctx, signal);
   442→      throwIfAborted(signal);
   443→      return extractAndMergeSettings(userResult, projectResult, shotResult, toolId, ctx);
   444→    })();
   445→
   446→    inflightSettingsFetches.set(singleFlightKey, promise);
   447→    // The .finally cleanup promise is intentionally not awaited or returned.
   448→    // Suppress its rejection to avoid unhandled rejection warnings — the original
   449→    // `promise` reference (returned below) handles propagation to the caller.
   450→    promise.finally(() => {
   451→      inflightSettingsFetches.delete(singleFlightKey);
   452→    }).catch(() => {});
   453→    const value = await raceWithAbort(promise, signal);
   454→    return operationSuccess(value);
   455→
   456→  } catch (error: unknown) {
   457→    if (isToolSettingsError(error) && error.code === 'cancelled') {
   458→      return toOperationFailure(error);
   459→    }
   460→    if (isCancellationError(error)) {
   461→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   462→        recoverable: true,
   463→        cause: error,
   464→      }));
   465→    }
   466→    // Build context info without calling getSession() — can block during token refresh
   467→    const errorMsg = getErrorMessage(error);
   468→    const contextInfo = {
   469→      visibilityState: typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.visibilityState : 'unknown',
   470→      hidden: typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.hidden : false,
   471→      online: typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator.onLine : true,
   472→    };
   473→
   474→    if (errorMsg.includes('Auth timeout') || errorMsg.includes('Auth request was cancelled')) {
   475→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   476→        context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase.authTimeout',
   477→        showToast: false,
   478→        logData: contextInfo,
   479→      });
   480→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError(
   481→        'network',
   482→        'Authentication check timed out. Please retry.',
   483→        {
   484→          recoverable: true,
   485→          cause: error,
   486→          metadata: { ...contextInfo, reason: 'auth_timeout' },
   487→        },
   488→      ));
   489→    }
   490→
   491→    if (errorMsg.includes('Failed to fetch')) {
   492→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase.network', showToast: false, logData: contextInfo });
   493→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError(
   494→        'network',
   495→        'Network connection issue. Please check your internet connection.',
   496→        {
   497→          recoverable: true,
   498→          cause: error,
   499→          metadata: contextInfo,
   500→        },
   501→      ));
   502→    }
   503→
   504→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase', showToast: false, logData: contextInfo });
   505→    return toOperationFailure(classifyToolSettingsError(error));
   506→  }
   507→}
   508→
   509→/**
   510→ * Fetch tool settings and throw `ToolSettingsError` on failure.
   511→ *
   512→ * Use this from hook boundaries that already model errors as thrown exceptions
   513→ * (for example React Query query functions and mutation pipelines) so read/write
   514→ * settings flows share the same error contract.
   515→ */
   516→export async function fetchToolSettingsSupabaseOrThrow(
   517→  toolId: string,
   518→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,
   519→  signal?: AbortSignal,
   520→): Promise<SettingsFetchResult> {
   521→  const result = await fetchToolSettingsSupabase(toolId, ctx, signal);
   522→  if (!result.ok) {
   523→    throw toToolSettingsErrorFromOperationFailure(result);
   524→  }
   525→  return result.value;
   526→}
   527→

    89→    });
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  if (variantCountsData) {
    93→    for (const item of variantCountsData as Array<{ generation_id: string; viewed_at: string | null }>) {
    94→      const genId = item.generation_id;
    95→      derivedCounts[genId] = (derivedCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    96→      if (item.viewed_at === null) {
    97→        hasUnviewedVariants[genId] = true;
    98→        unviewedVariantCounts[genId] = (unviewedVariantCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    99→      }
   100→    }
   101→  }
   102→
   103→  return { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts };
   104→}
   105→
   106→/**
   107→ * Fail-open variant of calculateDerivedCounts for non-critical UI surfaces.
   108→ * Keeps badge rendering resilient when counts query intermittently fails.
   109→ */
   110→export async function calculateDerivedCountsSafe(
   111→  generationIds: string[]
   112→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
   113→  try {
   114→    return await calculateDerivedCounts(generationIds);
   115→  } catch (error) {
   116→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'generationTransformers.calculateDerivedCountsSafe', showToast: false });
   117→    return {
   118→      ...createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(),
   119→      degraded: true,
   120→      errorCode: 'query_failed',
   121→    };
   122→  }
   123→}
   124→
   125→/**
   126→ * Raw variant record from generation_variants table (before transformation)
   127→ */
   128→export interface RawVariant {
   129→  id: string;
   130→  generation_id: string;
   131→  location: string;
   132→  thumbnail_url?: string | null;
   133→  params?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   134→  variant_type?: string | null;
   135→  name?: string | null;
   136→  created_at: string;
   137→  /** Only present for derived-items queries */
   138→  is_primary?: boolean;
   139→  viewed_at?: string | null;
   140→}
   141→
   142→/**
   143→ * Raw generation record from database (before transformation)
   144→ */
   145→export interface RawGeneration {
   146→  id: string;
   147→  location: string;
   148→  thumbnail_url?: string | null;
   149→  type?: string | null;
   150→  created_at: string;
   151→  updated_at?: string | null;
   152→  params?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   153→  starred?: boolean | null;
   154→  tasks?: string[] | string | null;
   155→  based_on?: string | null;
   156→  name?: string | null;
   157→  derivedCount?: number; // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   158→  hasUnviewedVariants?: boolean; // Whether any variants have viewed_at === null (for NEW badge)
   159→  unviewedVariantCount?: number; // Count of unviewed variants
   160→  // Parent/child relationship fields
   161→  is_child?: boolean | null;
   162→  parent_generation_id?: string | null;
   163→  child_order?: number | null;
   164→  // JSONB column mapping shot_id -> array of timeline_frames
   165→  // Each generation can appear multiple times in the same shot (different positions)
   166→  // Example: { "shot_id_123": [120, 420, null] } means 3 entries: at frame 120, 420, and one unpositioned
   167→  shot_data?: Record<string, (number | null)[]>;
   168→}
   169→
   170→/**
   171→ * Raw shot_generation record from database (before transformation)
   172→ */
   173→export interface RawShotGeneration {
   174→  id: string;
   175→  shot_id: string;
   176→  generation_id: string;
   177→  timeline_frame: number | null;
   178→  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   179→  created_at?: string;
   180→  generation?: RawGeneration | RawGeneration[] | null;
   181→  generations?: RawGeneration | RawGeneration[] | null;
   182→}
   183→
   184→/**
   185→ * Options for transformation customization
   186→ */
   187→interface TransformOptions {
   188→  /** Shot image entry ID (from shot_generations table) */
   189→  shotImageEntryId?: string;
   190→  /** Timeline frame position */
   191→  timeline_frame?: number | null;
   192→  /** Additional metadata to merge */
   193→  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   194→  /** Shot ID for filtering */
   195→  shotId?: string;
   196→  /** Whether to include verbose logging */
   197→  verbose?: boolean;
   198→}
   199→
   200→/**
   201→ * Extract prompt from various nested param structures
   202→ */
   203→function extractPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): string {
   204→  if (!params) return 'No prompt';
   205→
   206→  const originalParams = params.originalParams as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   207→  const orchestratorDetails = originalParams?.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   208→  const metadataBlock = params.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   209→
   210→  return (
   211→    (orchestratorDetails?.prompt as string) ||
   212→    (params.prompt as string) ||
   213→    (metadataBlock?.prompt as string) ||
   214→    'No prompt'
   215→  );
   216→}
   217→
   218→/**
   219→ * Extract thumbnail URL with fallback logic
   220→ * Handles special case for travel-between-images videos where thumbnail might be in params
   221→ */
   222→function extractThumbnailUrl(item: RawGeneration, mainUrl: string): string {
   223→  // Start with database thumbnail_url field
   224→  let thumbnailUrl = item.thumbnail_url;
   225→  const toolType = item.params?.tool_type;
   226→  
   227→  // If no thumbnail in database, check params for travel-between-images videos
   228→  if (!thumbnailUrl && isToolId(toolType) && toolType === TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES) {
   229→    const originalParams = item.params?.originalParams as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   230→    const orchestratorDetails = originalParams?.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   231→    const fullPayload = item.params?.full_orchestrator_payload as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   232→    const originalFullPayload = originalParams?.full_orchestrator_payload as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   233→
   234→    thumbnailUrl =
   235→      (item.params?.thumbnailUrl as string) ||
   236→      (orchestratorDetails?.thumbnail_url as string) ||
   237→      (fullPayload?.thumbnail_url as string) ||
   238→      (originalFullPayload?.thumbnail_url as string);
   239→  }
   240→  
   241→  // Final fallback to main URL
   242→  return thumbnailUrl || mainUrl;
   243→}
   244→
   245→/**
   246→ * Normalize timeline_frame to position (divide by 50)
   247→ */
   248→function normalizePosition(timelineFrame: number | null | undefined): number | null {
   249→  if (timelineFrame === null || timelineFrame === undefined) return null;
   250→  return Math.floor(timelineFrame / 50);
   251→}
   252→
   253→/**
   254→ * Transform a raw generation record from database to UI format
   255→ * 
   256→ * This is the MAIN transformation function used by most hooks/components
   257→ * 
   258→ * @param item - Raw generation from database query
   259→ * @param options - Optional customization (shot context, metadata, etc.)
   260→ * @returns Transformed generation ready for UI display
   261→ */
   262→export function transformGeneration(
   263→  item: RawGeneration,
   264→  options: TransformOptions = {}
   265→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   266→  const mainUrl = item.location;
   267→  const thumbnailUrl = extractThumbnailUrl(item, mainUrl);
   268→  const taskIdParse = parseGenerationTaskId(item.tasks);
   269→  const taskId = taskIdParse.taskId;
   270→  const prompt = extractPrompt(item.params);
   271→  
   272→  // Extract content_type from params for proper download file extensions
   273→  // Stored as 'image' or 'video', convert to MIME type
   274→  const storedContentType = item.params?.content_type;
   275→  const isVideo = item.type?.includes('video') || storedContentType === 'video' || false;
   276→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   277→  if (storedContentType === 'video') {
   278→    // Default to mp4 for videos, can be overridden by URL extension
   279→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   280→  } else if (storedContentType === 'image') {
   281→    // Default to png for images, can be overridden by URL extension  
   282→    contentType = 'image/png';
   283→  }
   284→  
   285→  // Compute stable URL identities for caching/comparison
   286→  // Supabase URLs have rotating tokens but the file path is stable
   287→  const urlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(mainUrl);
   288→  const thumbUrlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(thumbnailUrl);
   289→
   290→  // Base transformation - fields common to all generations
   291→  const baseItem: GeneratedImageWithMetadata = {
   292→    id: item.id,
   293→    url: mainUrl,
   294→    thumbUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   295→    urlIdentity,
   296→    thumbUrlIdentity,
   297→    prompt,
   298→    metadata: {
   299→      ...(item.params || {}),
   300→      taskId, // Include task ID in metadata for MediaGalleryItem
   301→      taskIdStatus: taskIdParse.status, // Surface parse health to avoid silent shape drift
   302→      based_on: item.based_on, // Include based_on for lineage tracking
   303→      ...(options.metadata || {}), // Merge any additional metadata
   304→    },
   305→    createdAt: item.created_at,
   306→    updatedAt: item.updated_at,
   307→    isVideo,
   308→    contentType, // For proper download file extensions
   309→    starred: item.starred || false,
   310→    based_on: item.based_on, // Top level for easy access
   311→    position: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   312→    timeline_frame: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   313→    name: item.name || (item.params?.name as string | undefined) || undefined,
   314→    derivedCount: item.derivedCount || 0, // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   315→    hasUnviewedVariants: item.hasUnviewedVariants || false, // For NEW badge display
   316→    unviewedVariantCount: item.unviewedVariantCount || 0, // Count for tooltip
   317→    // Parent/child relationship fields
   318→    is_child: item.is_child ?? undefined,
   319→    parent_generation_id: item.parent_generation_id ?? undefined,
   320→    child_order: item.child_order ?? undefined,
   321→  };
   322→
   323→  // Normalize JSONB shot_data into a flat association list.
   324→  const shotGenerations = expandShotData(item.shot_data as Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined);
   325→  
   326→  // If shot context is provided via options, use it
   327→  if (options.shotImageEntryId || options.timeline_frame !== undefined) {
   328→    return {
   329→      ...baseItem,
   330→      shotImageEntryId: options.shotImageEntryId,
   331→      timeline_frame: options.timeline_frame ?? null,
   332→      position: normalizePosition(options.timeline_frame),
   333→    };
   334→  }
   335→
   336→  // Otherwise, process shot associations from query data
   337→  if (shotGenerations.length > 0) {
   338→    // Single shot optimization
   339→    if (shotGenerations.length === 1) {
   340→      const singleShot = shotGenerations[0];
   341→      return {
   342→        ...baseItem,
   343→        shot_id: singleShot.shot_id,
   344→        position: normalizePosition(singleShot.timeline_frame),
   345→        timeline_frame: singleShot.timeline_frame,
   346→      };
   347→    }
   348→    
   349→    // Multiple shots: include all associations
   350→    const allAssociations = shotGenerations.map(shotGen => ({
   351→      shot_id: shotGen.shot_id,
   352→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame,
   353→      position: normalizePosition(shotGen.timeline_frame),
   354→    }));
   355→    
   356→    // When filtering by specific shot, use that shot as primary
   357→    let primaryShot = shotGenerations[0];
   358→    if (options.shotId) {
   359→      const matchingShot = shotGenerations.find(shotGen => shotGen.shot_id === options.shotId);
   360→      if (matchingShot) {
   361→        primaryShot = matchingShot;
   362→      }
   363→    }
   364→
   365→    return {
   366→      ...baseItem,
   367→      shot_id: primaryShot.shot_id,
   368→      position: normalizePosition(primaryShot.timeline_frame),
   369→      timeline_frame: primaryShot.timeline_frame,
   370→      all_shot_associations: allAssociations,
   371→    };
   372→  }
   373→  
   374→  return baseItem;
   375→}
   376→
   377→/**
   378→ * Transform for Timeline component's specific needs
   379→ * Maps to GenerationRow format expected by Timeline
   380→ */
   381→export function transformForTimeline(
   382→  shotGen: RawShotGeneration
   383→): GenerationRow & { timeline_frame?: number } {
   384→  const gen = shotGen.generation || shotGen.generations;
   385→  const genData = Array.isArray(gen) ? gen[0] : gen;
   386→  
   387→  if (!genData) {
   388→    return {
   389→      // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   390→      id: shotGen.id,
   391→      generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   392→      // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   393→      shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   394→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   395→    };
   396→  }
   397→  
   398→  return {
   399→    // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   400→    id: shotGen.id,
   401→    generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   402→    // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   403→    shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   404→    imageUrl: genData.location,
   405→    thumbUrl: genData.location,
   406→    location: genData.location,
   407→    type: genData.type ?? undefined,
   408→    createdAt: genData.created_at,
   409→    timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   410→    metadata: (shotGen.metadata as GenerationMetadata | undefined) ?? undefined,
   411→    starred: genData.starred ?? false,
   412→    based_on: genData.based_on ?? undefined,
   413→    derivedCount: genData.derivedCount ?? 0,
   414→  };
   415→}
   416→
   417→/**
   418→ * Detect if a URL points to a video based on file extension.
   419→ * Used for variants which lack a `type` column.
   420→ */
   421→function isVideoUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
   422→  if (!url) return false;
   423→  const videoExtensions = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv'];
   424→  return videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().includes(ext));
   425→}
   426→
   427→/**
   428→ * Transform a raw variant record from generation_variants table to UI format.
   429→ *
   430→ * Mirrors `transformGeneration` but for variants, which have a different
   431→ * schema (no `type` column, different metadata shape).
   432→ *
   433→ * @param variant - Raw variant from database query
   434→ * @param options - Optional overrides (e.g. toolType fallback)
   435→ * @returns Transformed variant ready for UI display
   436→ */
   437→export function transformVariant(
   438→  variant: RawVariant,
   439→  options?: { toolType?: string }
   440→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   441→  const isVideo = isVideoUrl(variant.location);
   442→  const variantParams = (variant.params ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
   443→  const storedContentType = variantParams.content_type as string | undefined;
   444→
   445→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   446→  if (storedContentType === 'video' || isVideo) {
   447→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   448→  } else {
   449→    contentType = 'image/png';
   450→  }
   451→
   452→  return {
   453→    id: variant.id,
   454→    url: variant.location,
   455→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   456→    isVideo,
   457→    contentType,
   458→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   459→    starred: false, // Variants don't have starred flag
   460→    metadata: {
   461→      prompt: variantParams.prompt as string | undefined,
   462→      variant_type: variant.variant_type,
   463→      name: variant.name,
   464→      generation_id: variant.generation_id,
   465→      tool_type: (variantParams.tool_type as string) || options?.toolType,
   466→      created_from: variantParams.created_from as string | undefined,
   467→      source_task_id: variantParams.source_task_id as string | undefined,
   468→      content_type: storedContentType,
   469→    },
   470→    shot_id: undefined,
   471→    position: undefined,
   472→    all_shot_associations: undefined,
   473→  };
   474→}
   475→

    60→

    64→| `/src/pages` | Top-level pages | `HomePage`, `ShotsPage`, `ArtPage`, `SharePage`, `NotFoundPage`, payment pages |

    68→| `/supabase/migrations` | DB migrations | Schema changes (use `db push --linked`) |
