1→/**
     2→ * Shared billing utilities for edge functions
     3→ *
     4→ * Centralizes:
     5→ *  - Orchestrator/sub-task detection (extractOrchestratorRef, isSubTask)
     6→ *  - Sub-task query filter for Supabase `.or()` calls
     7→ *  - Cost calculation HTTP trigger
     8→ *
     9→ * Consumers: calculate-task-cost, update-task-status, complete_task
    10→ */
    11→
    12→import { buildOrchestratorRefOrFilter, extractOrchestratorRefFromParams } from './orchestratorReference.ts';
    13→import { readEdgeErrorCode } from './edgeRequest.ts';
    14→import {
    15→  operationFailure,
    16→  operationSuccess,
    17→  type OperationResult,
    18→} from './edgeOperation.ts';
    19→
    20→interface TaskQueryResponse {
    21→  data: unknown[] | null;
    22→  error: unknown;
    23→}
    24→
    25→interface TaskQueryBuilder extends PromiseLike<TaskQueryResponse> {
    26→  eq(column: string, value: string): TaskQueryBuilder;
    27→  or(filter: string): TaskQueryBuilder;
    28→}
    29→
    30→interface TaskQueryClient {
    31→  from(table: string): {
    32→    select(columns: string): TaskQueryBuilder;
    33→  };
    34→}
    35→
    36→// ===== Constants =====
    37→
    38→/** UUID v4 regex — used to distinguish real orchestrator FK refs from human-readable IDs */
    39→export const UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
    40→
    41→// ===== Orchestrator reference extraction =====
    42→
    43→/**
    44→ * Extract orchestrator_task_id from task params.
    45→ *
    46→ * Sub-tasks can store the orchestrator reference in multiple param paths
    47→ * depending on the task type and how they were created:
    48→ *  - params.orchestrator_task_id_ref          (travel_segment)
    49→ *  - params.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id  (join_clips_segment)
    50→ *  - params.originalParams.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id (legacy)
    51→ *  - params.orchestrator_task_id              (some legacy tasks)
    52→ *
    53→ * Returns the raw string value (may not be a valid UUID) or null.
    54→ */
    55→export function extractOrchestratorRef(params: unknown): string | null {
    56→  const contractOrReferencePath = extractOrchestratorRefFromParams(params);
    57→  if (contractOrReferencePath) {
    58→    return contractOrReferencePath;
    59→  }
    60→
    61→  if (!params || typeof params !== 'object') return null;
    62→
    63→  const p = params as Record<string, unknown>;
    64→  const details = p.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    65→  const originalParams = p.originalParams as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    66→  const originalDetails = originalParams?.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    67→
    68→  return (
    69→    (p.orchestrator_task_id_ref as string) ||
    70→    (details?.orchestrator_task_id as string) ||
    71→    (originalDetails?.orchestrator_task_id as string) ||
    72→    (p.orchestrator_task_id as string) ||
    73→    null
    74→  );
    75→}
    76→
    77→/**
    78→ * Determine whether a task is a sub-task of an orchestrator.
    79→ *
    80→ * A task is a sub-task when:
    81→ *  1. Its params contain an orchestrator reference (via any of the known paths)
    82→ *  2. That reference is a valid UUID (not a human-readable orchestrator ID)
    83→ *  3. The reference is NOT the task's own ID (orchestrators store their own ID
    84→ *     in params.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id for children to copy)
    85→ *
    86→ * @param params  - task.params (object, not stringified)
    87→ * @param taskId  - the task's own ID, to guard against self-references
    88→ * @returns The orchestrator task ID if this is a sub-task, or null otherwise
    89→ */
    90→export function getSubTaskOrchestratorId(params: unknown, taskId: string): string | null {
    91→  const ref = extractOrchestratorRef(params);
    92→  if (!ref) return null;
    93→  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(ref)) return null;
    94→  if (ref === taskId) return null;
    95→  return ref;
    96→}
    97→
    98→// ===== Sub-task query filter =====
    99→
   100→/**
   101→ * Build a Supabase PostgREST `.or()` filter string that finds all tasks
   102→ * whose params reference the given orchestrator task ID.
   103→ *
   104→ * Covers all four param paths where a sub-task may store the reference.
   105→ *
   106→ * Usage:
   107→ *   supabase.from('tasks').select('...').or(buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorId))
   108→ */
   109→export function buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId: string): string {
   110→  return [
   111→    buildCanonicalSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId),
   112→    buildLegacySubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId),
   113→  ].join(',');
   114→}
   115→
   116→export function buildCanonicalSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId: string): string {
   117→  return buildOrchestratorRefOrFilter(orchestratorTaskId);
   118→}
   119→
   120→export function buildLegacySubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId: string): string {
   121→  return [
   122→    `params->orchestrator_details->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
   123→    `params->originalParams->orchestrator_details->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
   124→    `params->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
   125→  ].join(',');
   126→}
   127→
   128→export interface CompletedSubTaskRow {
   129→  id: string;
   130→  generation_started_at: string | null;
   131→  generation_processed_at: string | null;
   132→  status: string;
   133→}
   134→
   135→export type SubTaskLookupStage = 'canonical' | 'legacy';
   136→
   137→export class SubTaskLookupError extends Error {
   138→  readonly code = 'subtask_lookup_failed';
   139→  readonly stage: SubTaskLookupStage;
   140→  readonly cause?: unknown;
   141→
   142→  constructor(stage: SubTaskLookupStage, cause: unknown) {
   143→    super(`[Billing] Failed to query ${stage} sub-task references`);
   144→    this.name = 'SubTaskLookupError';
   145→    this.stage = stage;
   146→    this.cause = cause;
   147→  }
   148→}
   149→
   150→export async function lookupCompletedSubTasksForOrchestrator(
   151→  supabaseAdmin: TaskQueryClient,
   152→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   153→): Promise<CompletedSubTaskRow[]> {
   154→  const canonicalResult = await supabaseAdmin
   155→    .from('tasks')
   156→    .select(`
   157→      id,
   158→      generation_started_at,
   159→      generation_processed_at,
   160→      status
   161→    `)
   162→    .or(buildCanonicalSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId))
   163→    .eq('status', 'Complete');
   164→
   165→  if (canonicalResult.error) {
   166→    throw new SubTaskLookupError('canonical', canonicalResult.error);
   167→  }
   168→
   169→  const canonicalTasks = (canonicalResult.data ?? []) as CompletedSubTaskRow[];
   170→  if (canonicalTasks.length > 0) {
   171→    return canonicalTasks;
   172→  }
   173→
   174→  const legacyResult = await supabaseAdmin
   175→    .from('tasks')
   176→    .select(`
   177→      id,
   178→      generation_started_at,
   179→      generation_processed_at,
   180→      status
   181→    `)
   182→    .or(buildLegacySubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId))
   183→    .eq('status', 'Complete');
   184→
   185→  if (legacyResult.error) {
   186→    throw new SubTaskLookupError('legacy', legacyResult.error);
   187→  }
   188→
   189→  const legacyTasks = (legacyResult.data ?? []) as CompletedSubTaskRow[];
   190→  if (legacyTasks.length > 0) {
   191→    return legacyTasks;
   192→  }
   193→
   194→  return [];
   195→}
   196→
   197→// ===== Cost calculation trigger =====
   198→
   199→/**
   200→ * Trigger the calculate-task-cost edge function for a given task.
   201→ *
   202→ * Returns an explicit outcome so callers can branch on billing success/failure.
   203→ *
   204→ * @param supabaseUrl - The Supabase project URL
   205→ * @param serviceKey  - The service role key for authentication
   206→ * @param taskId      - The task ID to calculate cost for
   207→ * @param logTag      - Optional log tag prefix (default: 'CostCalc')
   208→ */
   209→export interface CostCalculationTriggerValue {
   210→  status: number | null;
   211→  skipped?: boolean;
   212→  cost?: number;
   213→}
   214→
   215→export type CostCalculationTriggerResult = OperationResult<CostCalculationTriggerValue>;
   216→
   217→function isObjectRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
   218→  return !!value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value);
   219→}
   220→
   221→function parseJsonRecord(text: string): Record<string, unknown> | null {
   222→  if (!text.trim()) {
   223→    return null;
   224→  }
   225→  try {
   226→    const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
   227→    return isObjectRecord(parsed) ? parsed : null;
   228→  } catch {
   229→    return null;
   230→  }
   231→}
   232→
   233→export async function triggerCostCalculation(
   234→  params: {
   235→    supabaseUrl: string;
   236→    serviceKey: string;
   237→    taskId: string;
   238→    logTag?: string;
   239→  },
   240→): Promise<CostCalculationTriggerResult> {
   241→  const {
   242→    supabaseUrl,
   243→    serviceKey,
   244→    taskId,
   245→    logTag = 'CostCalc',
   246→  } = params;
   247→  try {
   248→    const costResp = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/calculate-task-cost`, {
   249→      method: "POST",
   250→      headers: {
   251→        "Authorization": `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
   252→        "Content-Type": "application/json"
   253→      },
   254→      body: JSON.stringify({ task_id: taskId })
   255→    });
   256→
   257→    if (costResp.ok) {
   258→      const bodyText = await costResp.text();
   259→      const costData = parseJsonRecord(bodyText);
   260→      if (!costData) {
   261→        return operationFailure(new Error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned an invalid success payload`), {
   262→          policy: 'degrade',
   263→          errorCode: 'cost_calculation_invalid_response',
   264→          message: `[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned an invalid success payload`,
   265→          recoverable: true,
   266→          cause: { status: costResp.status },
   267→        });
   268→      }
   269→
   270→      const costErrorCode = readEdgeErrorCode(costData);
   271→      if (costErrorCode) {
   272→        return operationFailure(new Error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned an error payload`), {
   273→          policy: 'degrade',
   274→          errorCode: costErrorCode,
   275→          message: typeof costData.message === 'string'
   276→            ? costData.message
   277→            : `[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned an error payload`,
   278→          recoverable: true,
   279→          cause: { status: costResp.status, payload: costData },
   280→        });
   281→      }
   282→
   283→      const skipped = costData.skipped === true;
   284→      const successFlag = costData.success;
   285→      if (!skipped && successFlag !== true) {
   286→        return operationFailure(new Error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned success status without success=true`), {
   287→          policy: 'degrade',
   288→          errorCode: 'cost_calculation_invalid_response',
   289→          message: `[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned success status without success=true`,
   290→          recoverable: true,
   291→          cause: { status: costResp.status, payload: costData },
   292→        });
   293→      }
   294→
   295→      const costValue = costData.cost;
   296→      if (!skipped && (typeof costValue !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(costValue))) {
   297→        return operationFailure(new Error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation success payload missing numeric cost`), {
   298→          policy: 'degrade',
   299→          errorCode: 'cost_calculation_invalid_response',
   300→          message: `[${logTag}] Cost calculation success payload missing numeric cost`,
   301→          recoverable: true,
   302→          cause: { status: costResp.status, payload: costData },
   303→        });
   304→      }
   305→
   306→      return operationSuccess(
   307→        {
   308→          status: costResp.status,
   309→          skipped,
   310→          cost: typeof costValue === 'number' && Number.isFinite(costValue)
   311→            ? costValue
   312→            : undefined,
   313→        },
   314→        { policy: 'best_effort' },
   315→      );
   316→    }
   317→
   318→    const errTxt = await costResp.text();
   319→    const errPayload = parseJsonRecord(errTxt);
   320→    const errorCode = readEdgeErrorCode(errPayload) ?? 'cost_calculation_failed';
   321→    const message = typeof errPayload?.message === 'string'
   322→      ? errPayload.message
   323→      : (errTxt || 'Cost calculation failed');
   324→    return operationFailure(new Error(message), {
   325→      policy: 'degrade',
   326→      errorCode,
   327→      message,
   328→      recoverable: costResp.status >= 500,
   329→      cause: { status: costResp.status, payload: errPayload ?? errTxt },
   330→    });
   331→  } catch (costErr) {
   332→    const message = costErr instanceof Error ? costErr.message : String(costErr);
   333→    return operationFailure(new Error(`[${logTag}] ${message}`), {
   334→      policy: 'degrade',
   335→      errorCode: 'cost_calculation_request_error',
   336→      message: `[${logTag}] ${message}`,
   337→      recoverable: true,
   338→      cause: costErr,
   339→    });
   340→  }
   341→}
   342→

     6→type SupabaseClientInstance = SupabaseClient<Database>;
     7→const SUPABASE_RUNTIME_NOT_INITIALIZED_MESSAGE =
     8→  'Supabase runtime is not initialized. Call initializeSupabaseClientRuntime() during app bootstrap.';
     9→
    10→let runtimeClient: SupabaseClientInstance | null = null;
    11→let runtimeError: Error | null = null;
    12→
    13→export type SupabaseClientAccessResult =
    14→  | { ok: true; client: SupabaseClientInstance }
    15→  | { ok: false; error: Error };
    16→
    17→export function normalizeSupabaseError(error: unknown): Error {
    18→  return error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    19→}
    20→
    21→export function initializeSupabaseClientRuntime(): SupabaseClientInstance {
    22→  if (runtimeClient) {
    23→    return runtimeClient;
    24→  }
    25→
    26→  try {
    27→    const client = createSupabaseClient();
    28→    initializeSupabaseRuntime(client);
    29→    runtimeClient = client;
    30→    runtimeError = null;
    31→    return client;
    32→  } catch (error) {
    33→    const normalized = normalizeSupabaseError(error);
    34→    runtimeClient = null;
    35→    runtimeError = normalized;
    36→    throw normalized;
    37→  }
    38→}
    39→
    40→export function getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    41→  if (runtimeClient) {
    42→    return { ok: true, client: runtimeClient };
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  if (runtimeError) {
    46→    return { ok: false, error: runtimeError };
    47→  }
    48→
    49→  return {
    50→    ok: false,
    51→    error: new Error(SUPABASE_RUNTIME_NOT_INITIALIZED_MESSAGE),
    52→  };
    53→}
    54→
    55→export function getSupabaseRuntimeClient(): SupabaseClientInstance {
    56→  const result = getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult();
    57→  if (!result.ok) {
    58→    throw result.error;
    59→  }
    60→  return result.client;
    61→}

1→export type OperationFailurePolicy = 'fail_closed' | 'fail_open' | 'degrade' | 'best_effort';
     2→
     3→export interface OperationSuccess<T> {
     4→  ok: true;
     5→  value: T;
     6→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
     7→  recoverable: false;
     8→}
     9→
    10→export interface OperationFailure {
    11→  ok: false;
    12→  error: Error;
    13→  message: string;
    14→  recoverable: boolean;
    15→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    16→  errorCode: string;
    17→  cause?: unknown;
    18→}
    19→
    20→export type OperationResult<T> = OperationSuccess<T> | OperationFailure;
    21→
    22→export class OperationResultError extends Error {
    23→  errorCode: string;
    24→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    25→  recoverable: boolean;
    26→  cause?: unknown;
    27→
    28→  constructor(options: {
    29→    message: string;
    30→    errorCode: string;
    31→    policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    32→    recoverable: boolean;
    33→    cause?: unknown;
    34→    sourceError?: Error;
    35→  }) {
    36→    super(options.message);
    37→    this.name = 'OperationResultError';
    38→    this.errorCode = options.errorCode;
    39→    this.policy = options.policy;
    40→    this.recoverable = options.recoverable;
    41→    this.cause = options.cause;
    42→
    43→    // Preserve the original stack for easier debugging when available.
    44→    if (options.sourceError?.stack) {
    45→      this.stack = options.sourceError.stack;
    46→    }
    47→  }
    48→}
    49→
    50→interface OperationSuccessOptions {
    51→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    52→}
    53→
    54→interface OperationFailureOptions {
    55→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    56→  recoverable?: boolean;
    57→  errorCode?: string;
    58→  message?: string;
    59→  cause?: unknown;
    60→}
    61→
    62→export function operationSuccess<T>(value: T, options?: OperationSuccessOptions): OperationSuccess<T> {
    63→  return {
    64→    ok: true,
    65→    value,
    66→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    67→    recoverable: false,
    68→  };
    69→}
    70→
    71→export function operationFailure(error: unknown, options?: OperationFailureOptions): OperationFailure {
    72→  const normalizedError = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    73→  return {
    74→    ok: false,
    75→    error: normalizedError,
    76→    message: options?.message ?? normalizedError.message,
    77→    recoverable: options?.recoverable ?? true,
    78→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    79→    errorCode: options?.errorCode ?? 'operation_failed',
    80→    ...(options?.cause !== undefined ? { cause: options.cause } : {}),
    81→  };
    82→}
    83→
    84→/**
    85→ * Convert a structured operation failure into an Error while preserving machine-readable metadata.
    86→ */
    87→export function toOperationResultError(failure: OperationFailure): OperationResultError {
    88→  return new OperationResultError({
    89→    message: failure.message,
    90→    errorCode: failure.errorCode,
    91→    policy: failure.policy,
    92→    recoverable: failure.recoverable,
    93→    cause: failure.cause,
    94→    sourceError: failure.error,
    95→  });
    96→}

    53→
    54→/** Convert legacy loras format (Record<url, strength>) to ActiveLora[] */
    55→function legacyLorasToArray(lorasObj: Record<string, number>): ActiveLora[] {
    56→  return Object.entries(lorasObj).map(([url, strength]) => {
    57→    const filename = url.split('/').pop()?.replace('.safetensors', '') || url;
    58→    return {
    59→      id: url,
    60→      name: filename,
    61→      path: url,
    62→      strength: typeof strength === 'number' ? strength : 1.0,
    63→    };

    66→
    67→/** Convert pair_loras format (Array<{path, strength}>) to ActiveLora[] */
    68→function pairLorasToArray(pairLoras: Array<{ path: string; strength: number }>): ActiveLora[] {
    69→  return pairLoras.map((lora) => {
    70→    const filename = lora.path.split('/').pop()?.replace('.safetensors', '') || lora.path;
    71→    return {
    72→      id: lora.path,
    73→      name: filename,
    74→      path: lora.path,
    75→      strength: lora.strength,
    76→    };
    77→  });

    80→// =============================================================================
    81→// EXTRACT SETTINGS FROM PARAMS

    83→
    84→/**
    85→ * Extract SegmentSettings from variant/generation params.
    86→ * Used to populate the form with settings from an existing generation.
    87→ *
    88→ * Handles multiple legacy formats:
    89→ * - Top-level fields (base_prompt, amount_of_motion, etc.)
    90→ * - Nested orchestrator_details
    91→ * - Legacy additional_loras (object format)
    92→ * - New loras (array format)
    93→ */
    94→export function extractSettingsFromParams(
    95→  params: Record<string, unknown>,
    96→  defaults?: Partial<SegmentSettings>
    97→): SegmentSettings {
    98→
    99→  // Handle nested orchestrator_details (common in task params)
   100→  const orchDetails = (params.orchestrator_details || {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
   101→
   102→  // Extract prompt: base_prompt > prompt > orchestrator > default
   103→  const prompt = (params.base_prompt ?? params.prompt ?? orchDetails.base_prompt ?? defaults?.prompt ?? '') as string;
   104→
   105→  // Extract negative prompt
   106→  const negativePrompt = (params.negative_prompt ?? orchDetails.negative_prompt ?? defaults?.negativePrompt ?? '') as string;
   107→
   108→  // Extract num_frames
   109→  const numFrames = (params.num_frames ?? orchDetails.num_frames ?? defaults?.numFrames ?? 25) as number;
   110→
   111→  // Extract seed/randomSeed
   112→  const randomSeed = (params.random_seed ?? orchDetails.random_seed ?? defaults?.randomSeed ?? true) as boolean;
   113→  const seed = (params.seed ?? orchDetails.seed ?? defaults?.seed) as number | undefined;
   114→
   115→  // Extract motion settings
   116→  const motionMode = (params.motion_mode ?? orchDetails.motion_mode ?? defaults?.motionMode ?? 'basic') as 'basic' | 'advanced';
   117→  const amountOfMotion = params.amount_of_motion != null
   118→    ? Math.round((params.amount_of_motion as number) * 100) // Convert 0-1 to 0-100
   119→    : (orchDetails.amount_of_motion != null
   120→        ? Math.round((orchDetails.amount_of_motion as number) * 100)
   121→        : (defaults?.amountOfMotion ?? 50));
   122→
   123→  // Extract phase config (only if advanced mode)
   124→  let phaseConfig: PhaseConfig | undefined = undefined;
   125→  if (motionMode === 'advanced') {
   126→    phaseConfig = (params.phase_config ?? orchDetails.phase_config ?? defaults?.phaseConfig) as PhaseConfig | undefined;
   127→    if (phaseConfig) {

   130→  }
   131→
   132→  // Extract selected preset ID
   133→  const selectedPhasePresetId = (params.selected_phase_preset_id ?? orchDetails.selected_phase_preset_id ?? defaults?.selectedPhasePresetId ?? null) as string | null;
   134→
   135→  // Extract LoRAs - handle multiple formats
   136→  let loras: ActiveLora[] = [];
   137→
   138→  // Format 1: loras array at top level (new format)
   139→  if (Array.isArray(params.loras) && params.loras.length > 0) {
   140→    loras = pairLorasToArray(params.loras as Array<{ path: string; strength: number }>);
   141→  }
   142→  // Format 2: additional_loras object at top level (legacy)
   143→  else if (params.additional_loras && typeof params.additional_loras === 'object' && Object.keys(params.additional_loras as Record<string, unknown>).length > 0) {
   144→    loras = legacyLorasToArray(params.additional_loras as Record<string, number>);
   145→  }
   146→  // Format 3: in orchestrator_details (either format)
   147→  else if (Array.isArray(orchDetails.loras) && orchDetails.loras.length > 0) {
   148→    loras = pairLorasToArray(orchDetails.loras as Array<{ path: string; strength: number }>);
   149→  }
   150→  else if (orchDetails.additional_loras && typeof orchDetails.additional_loras === 'object' && Object.keys(orchDetails.additional_loras as Record<string, unknown>).length > 0) {
   151→    loras = legacyLorasToArray(orchDetails.additional_loras as Record<string, number>);
   152→  }
   153→  // Format 4: use defaults if provided
   154→  else if (defaults?.loras) {
   155→    loras = defaults.loras;
   156→  }
   157→
   158→  const result = {
   159→    prompt,
   160→    negativePrompt,
   161→    motionMode,
   162→    amountOfMotion,
   163→    phaseConfig,
   164→    selectedPhasePresetId,
   165→    loras,
   166→    numFrames,
   167→    randomSeed,
   168→    seed,
   169→    makePrimaryVariant: defaults?.makePrimaryVariant ?? false,
   170→  };
   171→
   172→  return result;
   173→}

   175→// =============================================================================

   178→
   179→/**
   180→ * Settings to save to pair metadata.
   181→ * Convention:
   182→ *   undefined = don't touch this field
   183→ *   null = explicitly clear (for nullable fields)
   184→ *   '' = explicitly clear override (for string fields)
   185→ *   value = set the override
   186→ */
   187→interface PairSettingsToSave {
   188→  prompt?: string;
   189→  negativePrompt?: string;
   190→  textBeforePrompts?: string;
   191→  textAfterPrompts?: string;
   192→  motionMode?: 'basic' | 'advanced';

   207→
   208→type TextOverrideKey = 'prompt' | 'negativePrompt' | 'textBeforePrompts' | 'textAfterPrompts';
   209→
   210→function setTextOverride(
   211→  overrides: SegmentOverrides,
   212→  fieldsToClear: (keyof SegmentOverrides)[],
   213→  key: TextOverrideKey,
   214→  value: string | undefined
   215→): void {
   216→  if (value === undefined) return;
   217→  if (value === '') {
   218→    fieldsToClear.push(key);
   219→    return;
   220→  }
   221→  overrides[key] = value;
   222→}
   223→
   224→function setNullableOverride<K extends keyof SegmentOverrides>(
   225→  overrides: SegmentOverrides,
   226→  fieldsToClear: K[],
   227→  key: K,
   228→  value: SegmentOverrides[K] | null | undefined
   229→): void {
   230→  if (value === undefined) return;
   231→  if (value === null) {
   232→    fieldsToClear.push(key);
   233→    return;
   234→  }
   235→  overrides[key] = value;
   236→}
   237→
   238→function applyPairSettingsToOverrides(
   239→  settings: PairSettingsToSave,
   240→  overrides: SegmentOverrides,
   241→  fieldsToClear: (keyof SegmentOverrides)[]
   242→): void {
   243→  setTextOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'prompt', settings.prompt);
   244→  setTextOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'negativePrompt', settings.negativePrompt);
   245→  setTextOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'textBeforePrompts', settings.textBeforePrompts);
   246→  setTextOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'textAfterPrompts', settings.textAfterPrompts);
   247→
   248→  setNullableOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'motionMode', settings.motionMode);
   249→  setNullableOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'amountOfMotion', settings.amountOfMotion);
   250→
   251→  if (settings.phaseConfig !== undefined) {
   252→    if (settings.phaseConfig === null) {
   253→      fieldsToClear.push('phaseConfig');
   254→    } else {
   255→      overrides.phaseConfig = stripModeFromPhaseConfig(settings.phaseConfig);
   256→    }
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  if (settings.loras !== undefined) {
   260→    if (settings.loras === null) {
   261→      fieldsToClear.push('loras');
   262→    } else {
   263→      overrides.loras = settings.loras.map((l): LoraConfig => ({
   264→        id: l.id,
   265→        name: l.name,
   266→        path: l.path,
   267→        strength: l.strength,
   268→      }));
   269→    }
   270→  }
   271→
   272→  if (settings.randomSeed !== undefined) {
   273→    overrides.randomSeed = settings.randomSeed;
   274→  }
   275→  if (settings.seed !== undefined) {
   276→    overrides.seed = settings.seed;
   277→  }
   278→
   279→  setNullableOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'selectedPhasePresetId', settings.selectedPhasePresetId);
   280→  setNullableOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'structureMotionStrength', settings.structureMotionStrength);
   281→  setNullableOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'structureTreatment', settings.structureTreatment);
   282→  setNullableOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'structureUni3cEndPercent', settings.structureUni3cEndPercent);
   283→}

   285→function clearFields(

   294→function cleanupLegacyPairMetadata(

   299→  if (settings.negativePrompt !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_negative_prompt;
   300→  if (settings.motionMode !== undefined || settings.amountOfMotion !== undefined) {

   305→  if (settings.randomSeed !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_random_seed;

   310→function cleanupLegacyUserOverrides(

   312→  settings: PairSettingsToSave
   313→): void {
   314→  const userOverrides = metadata.user_overrides as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   315→  if (!userOverrides) return;
   316→
   317→  if (settings.motionMode !== undefined) delete userOverrides.motion_mode;
   318→  if (settings.amountOfMotion !== undefined) delete userOverrides.amount_of_motion;
   319→  if (settings.phaseConfig !== undefined) delete userOverrides.phase_config;
   320→  if (settings.loras !== undefined) delete userOverrides.additional_loras;
   321→
   322→  if (Object.keys(userOverrides).length === 0) {
   323→    delete metadata.user_overrides;
   324→  }
   325→}
   326→
   327→/**
   328→ * Build metadata update payload for saving pair settings.
   329→ *
   330→ * Writes to the new segmentOverrides format and cleans up old pair_* and
   331→ * legacy user_overrides fields from the metadata.
   332→ */
   333→export function buildMetadataUpdate(
   334→  currentMetadata: Record<string, unknown>,
   335→  settings: PairSettingsToSave
   336→): Record<string, unknown> {
   337→  const overrides: SegmentOverrides = {};
   338→  const fieldsToClear: (keyof SegmentOverrides)[] = [];
   339→  applyPairSettingsToOverrides(settings, overrides, fieldsToClear);
   340→
   341→  // Use writeSegmentOverrides to write to new format
   342→  const newMetadata = writeSegmentOverrides(currentMetadata, overrides);
   343→
   344→  // Access segmentOverrides as a mutable record for cleanup operations
   345→  const segOverrides = newMetadata.segmentOverrides as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   346→
   347→  // Handle explicit clear of phaseConfig (when switching to basic mode)
   348→  if (settings.phaseConfig === null && segOverrides) {
   349→    delete segOverrides.phaseConfig;
   350→    // Note: selectedPhasePresetId is handled independently via fieldsToClear.
   351→    // Don't cascade-delete it here — basic mode presets need to persist.
   352→  }
   353→
   354→  // Handle explicitly cleared fields ('' or null means remove override, use shot default)
   355→  if (fieldsToClear.length > 0 && segOverrides) {
   356→    clearFields(segOverrides, fieldsToClear as string[]);
   357→  }
   358→
   359→  cleanupLegacyPairMetadata(newMetadata, settings);
   360→  cleanupLegacyUserOverrides(newMetadata, settings);
   361→
   362→  return newMetadata;
   363→}
   364→

   218→    message.includes('not authenticated') ||
   219→    message.includes('authentication required')

   224→  // Validation errors

   228→    message.includes('validation')
   229→  ) {
   230→    return new ValidationError(err.message, { context, cause: err });
   231→  }
   232→
   233→  // Default to generic AppError

1→import type { AppError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errors';
     2→import {
     3→  reportError,
     4→  type ErrorReportOptions,
     5→} from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/coreReporter';
     6→import { presentRuntimeError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeErrorPresenter';
     7→
     8→export interface RuntimeErrorOptions extends ErrorReportOptions {
     9→  toastTitle?: string;
    10→  showToast?: boolean;
    11→}
    12→
    13→/** Normalize unknown errors and route them through the shared presenter. */
    14→export function normalizeAndPresentError(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): AppError {
    15→  const { context, logData, onError, toastTitle, showToast } = options;
    16→  const appError = reportError(error, { context, logData, onError });
    17→
    18→  const shouldShowToast = showToast ?? appError.showToast;
    19→  if (shouldShowToast) {
    20→    presentRuntimeError(appError, toastTitle);
    21→  }
    22→
    23→  return appError;
    24→}
    25→
    26→/** Normalize, present, then throw for caller-level control-flow stops. */
    27→export function normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): never {
    28→  throw normalizeAndPresentError(error, options);
    29→}
    30→

     2→  return value instanceof Error;
     3→}
     4→

     6→  code?: string;
     7→}

    47→  return error.name === 'AbortError' ||
    48→         error.message?.includes('Request was cancelled') ||
    49→         error.message?.includes('signal is aborted');

    51→  return error;
    52→}
    53→
    54→function throwIfAborted(signal?: AbortSignal): void {
    55→  if (signal?.aborted) {
    56→    throw createAbortError();
    57→  }
    58→}
    59→
    60→/**
    61→ * Set the write function that performs the actual DB update.
    62→ * Must be called once at app init (in useToolSettings.ts).
    63→ * Also registers page-unload listeners on first call (deferred from module load).
    64→ */
    65→export function setSettingsWriteFunction(fn: (write: QueuedWrite) => Promise<unknown>) {
    66→  const isFirstInit = writeFunction === null;
    67→  writeFunction = fn;
    68→
    69→  if (isFirstInit && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    70→    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
    71→      flushAll();
    72→    });
    73→    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    74→      if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {
    75→        flushAll();
    76→      }
    77→    });
    78→  }
    79→}
    80→
    81→/**
    82→ * Create a unique key for deduplication
    83→ */
    84→function targetKey(write: QueuedWrite): string {
    85→  return `${write.scope}:${write.entityId}:${write.toolId}`;
    86→}
    87→
    88→/**
    89→ * Shallow merge (one level deep)
    90→ */
    91→function shallowMergePatch(existing: Record<string, unknown>, incoming: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
    92→  return { ...existing, ...incoming };
    93→}
    94→
    95→/**
    96→ * Process the next item in the flush queue
    97→ */
    98→async function processQueue() {
    99→  if (inFlightCount >= MAX_CONCURRENT || flushQueue.length === 0) {
   100→    return;
   101→  }
   102→
   103→  const next = flushQueue.shift();
   104→  if (!next) return;
   105→
   106→  const { targetKey: key, pending } = next;
   107→  
   108→  // Remove from pending map (we're about to process it)
   109→  pendingByTarget.delete(key);
   110→  
   111→  inFlightCount++;
   112→  
   113→  try {
   114→    if (!writeFunction) {
   115→      throw new Error('[SettingsWriteQueue] Write function not initialized');
   116→    }
   117→
   118→    throwIfAborted(pending.write.signal);
   119→    const result = await writeFunction(pending.write);
   120→    
   121→    // Resolve all waiters
   122→    for (const { resolve } of pending.resolvers) {
   123→      resolve(result);
   124→    }
   125→  } catch (error) {
   126→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'SettingsWriteQueue', showToast: false });
   127→
   128→    // Reject all waiters
   129→    for (const { reject } of pending.resolvers) {
   130→      reject(error);
   131→    }
   132→  } finally {
   133→    inFlightCount--;
   134→    
   135→    // Process next item
   136→    processQueue();
   137→  }
   138→}
   139→
   140→/**
   141→ * Schedule a pending write for flush
   142→ */
   143→function scheduleFlush(key: string, pending: PendingWrite) {
   144→  // Clear existing timer
   145→  if (pending.timerId) {
   146→    clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
   147→    pending.timerId = null;
   148→  }
   149→  
   150→  // Add to flush queue and process
   151→  flushQueue.push({ targetKey: key, pending });
   152→  processQueue();
   153→}
   154→
   155→/**
   156→ * Enqueue a settings write.
   157→ * 
   158→ * Returns a promise that resolves when the write completes.
   159→ * Multiple writes to the same target within the debounce window are merged.
   160→ * 
   161→ * @param write - The write to enqueue
   162→ * @param mode - 'debounced' (default) waits for debounce window; 'immediate' flushes now
   163→ */
   164→export function enqueueSettingsWrite(
   165→  write: QueuedWrite,
   166→  mode: 'debounced' | 'immediate' = 'debounced'
   167→): Promise<unknown> {
   168→  const key = targetKey(write);
   169→
   170→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
   171→    if (write.signal?.aborted) {
   172→      reject(createAbortError());
   173→      return;
   174→    }
   175→
   176→    const existing = pendingByTarget.get(key);
   177→
   178→    if (existing) {
   179→      // Merge with existing pending write
   180→      existing.write.patch = shallowMergePatch(existing.write.patch, write.patch);
   181→      if (write.signal) {
   182→        existing.write.signal = write.signal;
   183→      }
   184→      existing.resolvers.push({ resolve, reject });
   185→
   186→      if (mode === 'immediate') {
   187→        // Cancel debounce timer and flush now
   188→        scheduleFlush(key, existing);
   189→      }
   190→      // else: existing timer will handle it
   191→      
   192→    } else {
   193→      // Create new pending write
   194→      const pending: PendingWrite = {
   195→        write: { ...write, patch: { ...write.patch } },
   196→        resolvers: [{ resolve, reject }],
   197→        timerId: null,
   198→        enqueuedAt: Date.now(),
   199→      };
   200→
   201→      pendingByTarget.set(key, pending);
   202→
   203→      if (mode === 'immediate') {
   204→        scheduleFlush(key, pending);
   205→      } else {
   206→        // Set debounce timer
   207→        pending.timerId = setTimeout(() => {
   208→          scheduleFlush(key, pending);
   209→        }, DEBOUNCE_MS);
   210→      }
   211→    }
   212→  });
   213→}
   214→
   215→
   216→/**
   217→ * Flush all pending writes immediately.
   218→ * Best-effort: returns without waiting.
   219→ */
   220→function flushAll(): void {
   221→  for (const [key, pending] of pendingByTarget.entries()) {
   222→    if (pending.timerId) {
   223→      clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
   224→      pending.timerId = null;
   225→    }
   226→    flushQueue.push({ targetKey: key, pending });
   227→  }
   228→  pendingByTarget.clear();
   229→  processQueue();
   230→}
   231→
   232→

    26→export function useServerForm<TServer, TLocal extends Record<string, unknown>>({

    47→    isDirtyRef.current = isDirty;
    48→    localDataRef.current = localData;
    49→    saveFnRef.current = saveFn;
    50→  }, [isDirty, localData, saveFn]);
    51→
    52→  useEffect(() => {
    53→    onDirtyChange?.(isDirty);
    54→  }, [isDirty, onDirtyChange]);
    55→
    56→  useEffect(() => {

    58→      if (saveTimeoutRef.current) {
    59→        clearTimeout(saveTimeoutRef.current);

    61→      }
    62→      setLocalData(null);
    63→      setIsDirty(false);
    64→      hasUserEdited.current = false;
    65→      prevContextKeyRef.current = contextKey;

   143→      }
   144→    };
   145→  }, []);

   152→    reset,

1→import { useRef } from 'react';
     2→
     3→/**
     4→ * Hook that returns a stable reference to an object, only updating when dependencies change.
     5→ * Uses deep comparison to prevent unnecessary recreations.
     6→ */
     7→export function useStableObject<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
     8→  factory: () => T,
     9→  deps: React.DependencyList
    10→): T {
    11→  const depsRef = useRef<React.DependencyList>();
    12→  const objectRef = useRef<T>();
    13→
    14→  // Check if dependencies have actually changed
    15→  const depsChanged = !depsRef.current || 
    16→    depsRef.current.length !== deps.length ||
    17→    depsRef.current.some((dep, index) => dep !== deps[index]);
    18→
    19→  if (depsChanged || !objectRef.current) {
    20→    objectRef.current = factory();
    21→    depsRef.current = deps;
    22→  }
    23→
    24→  return objectRef.current;
    25→}
    26→

1→import { useEffect } from 'react';
     2→import usePersistentState from './usePersistentState';
     3→
     4→const PRESERVE_USER_TEXT_CLASS = 'preserve-user-text';
     5→let preserveUserTextClassConsumers = 0;
     6→
     7→function acquirePreserveUserTextClass(): void {
     8→  if (typeof document === 'undefined') {
     9→    return;
    10→  }
    11→  preserveUserTextClassConsumers += 1;
    12→  if (preserveUserTextClassConsumers === 1) {
    13→    document.documentElement.classList.add(PRESERVE_USER_TEXT_CLASS);
    14→  }
    15→}
    16→
    17→function releasePreserveUserTextClass(): void {
    18→  if (typeof document === 'undefined') {
    19→    return;
    20→  }
    21→  if (preserveUserTextClassConsumers === 0) {
    22→    document.documentElement.classList.remove(PRESERVE_USER_TEXT_CLASS);
    23→    return;
    24→  }
    25→  preserveUserTextClassConsumers -= 1;
    26→  if (preserveUserTextClassConsumers === 0) {
    27→    document.documentElement.classList.remove(PRESERVE_USER_TEXT_CLASS);
    28→  }
    29→}
    30→
    31→/**
    32→ * Hook to manage whether user-inputted text preserves its original casing.
    33→ *
    34→ * UI text is ALWAYS lowercase for aesthetic consistency.
    35→ * This setting controls whether user-inputted text (project names, shot names,
    36→ * prompts, etc.) is also lowercased or preserves its original case.
    37→ *
    38→ * - Default (false): All text lowercase, including user inputs
    39→ * - Enabled (true): User-inputted text preserves original case via .preserve-case
    40→ */
    41→export function useTextCase() {
    42→  const [preserveUserText, setPreserveUserText] = usePersistentState<boolean>('preserve-user-text', false);
    43→
    44→  useEffect(() => {
    45→    if (!preserveUserText) {
    46→      return;
    47→    }
    48→    acquirePreserveUserTextClass();
    49→
    50→    return () => {
    51→      releasePreserveUserTextClass();
    52→    };
    53→  }, [preserveUserText]);
    54→
    55→  const toggle = () => setPreserveUserText((prev) => !prev);
    56→
    57→  return { preserveUserText, setPreserveUserText, toggle };
    58→}

    32→export async function preloadGenerationTaskMappings(
    33→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    34→  generationIds: string[],
    35→  options: PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions = {},
    36→) {
    37→  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
    38→  const {

    40→    delayBetweenBatches = 200,
    41→    preloadFullTaskData = false,
    42→    projectId,

    45→  for (let i = 0; i < generationIds.length; i += batchSize) {
    46→    const batch = generationIds.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    47→
    48→    const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(batch, { projectId });
    49→    let reportedBatchQueryFailure = false;
    50→
    51→    const prefetchTasks: Array<Promise<unknown>> = [];
    52→
    53→    batch.forEach((generationId) => {
    54→      const mapping = mappings.get(generationId);
    55→      const cacheEntry = toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry(mapping);
    56→      queryClient.setQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
    57→        taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
    58→        cacheEntry,

    62→        reportedBatchQueryFailure = true;
    63→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(cacheEntry.queryError), {
    64→          context: 'GenerationTaskCache',
    65→          showToast: false,
    66→        });
    67→      }
    68→
    69→      if (preloadFullTaskData && cacheEntry.taskId && cacheEntry.status === 'ok') {
    70→        prefetchTasks.push(queryClient.prefetchQuery({
    71→          [REDACTED](cacheEntry.taskId),
    72→          queryFn: async () => {
    73→            const { data, error } = await supabase
    74→              .from('tasks')
    75→              .select('*')
    76→              .eq('id', cacheEntry.taskId)
    77→              .single();
    78→
    79→            if (error) throw error;
    80→            if (!isTaskDbRow(data)) {
    81→              throw new Error('Task row has unexpected shape');
    82→            }
    83→            return mapTaskDbRowToTask(data);
    84→          },
    85→          staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000,
    86→        }));
    87→      }
    88→    });
    89→
    90→    if (prefetchTasks.length > 0) {
    91→      await Promise.all(prefetchTasks);
    92→    }
    93→
    94→    if (i + batchSize < generationIds.length) {
    95→      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayBetweenBatches));
    96→    }
    97→  }
    98→}
    99→
   100→export function mergeGenerationsWithTaskData(
   101→  generations: GenerationRow[],
   102→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   103→): GenerationWithTaskData[] {
   104→  return generations.map((generation) => {
   105→    const generationId = generation.generation_id ?? generation.id;
   106→    const cachedMapping = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
   107→      taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
   108→    );
   109→    const taskId = cachedMapping?.taskId || null;
   110→    const taskData = taskId ? queryClient.getQueryData<Task>(taskQueryKeys.single(taskId)) : null;
   111→    const taskMappingStatus = cachedMapping?.status ?? (taskId ? 'ok' : 'not_loaded');
   112→
   113→    return {
   114→      ...generation,
   115→      taskId,
   116→      taskData,
   117→      taskMappingStatus,
   118→      ...(cachedMapping?.queryError ? { taskMappingError: cachedMapping.queryError } : {}),
   119→    };
   120→  });

    59→
    60→class TimelineWriteTimeoutError extends Error {
    61→  readonly code = TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CODE;
    62→
    63→  constructor(operation: string, timeoutMs: number, cause?: unknown) {

    65→    this.name = 'TimelineWriteTimeoutError';

    67→      (this as { cause?: unknown }).cause = cause;

    71→

    90→  task: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>,
    91→  options?: TimelineWriteTimeoutOptions,
    92→): Promise<T> {

   138→  operation: string,
   139→  task: () => Promise<T>,
   140→  timeoutMs: number,
   141→  onTimeout: () => void,
   142→): Promise<T> {
   143→  if (timeoutMs <= 0) {

   145→  }
   146→
   147→  return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
   148→    let settled = false;
   149→    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {

   151→        return;
   152→      }
   153→      settled = true;
   154→      onTimeout();
   155→      reject(new TimelineWriteTimeoutError(operation, timeoutMs));
   156→    }, timeoutMs);
   157→
   158→    Promise.resolve()
   159→      .then(task)
   160→      .then(
   161→        (result) => {
   162→          if (settled) {
   163→            return;
   164→          }
   165→          settled = true;
   166→          clearTimeout(timeoutId);
   167→          resolve(result);
   168→        },
   169→        (error) => {
   170→          if (settled) {
   171→            return;
   172→          }
   173→          settled = true;

   175→          reject(error);
   176→        },
   177→      );

   193→
   194→/**
   195→ * Serialize timeline writes per shot to avoid overlapping updates from
   196→ * different UI flows (batch reorder, timeline drag, etc.).
   197→ */
   198→export async function runSerializedTimelineWrite<T>(
   199→  shotId: string,
   200→  operation: string,
   201→  task: () => Promise<T>,
   202→  onEvent?: TimelineWriteEventHandler,
   203→  options?: TimelineSerializedWriteOptions,
   204→): Promise<T> {

   207→  const previousTail = shotWriteTail.get(shotId) ?? Promise.resolve();
   208→  const nextDepth = (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 0) + 1;
   209→  shotWriteDepth.set(shotId, nextDepth);
   210→  const blockedBy = shotWriteActive.get(shotId);
   211→  const blockedByDurationMs = blockedBy ? Math.max(0, queuedAt - blockedBy.startedAt) : null;

   214→    shotId,
   215→    operation,
   216→    waitMs: 0,
   217→    durationMs: 0,
   218→    queueDepth: Math.max(0, nextDepth - 1),
   219→    requestId,
   220→    blockedByOperation: blockedBy?.operation ?? null,
   221→    blockedByDurationMs,
   222→  });
   223→
   224→  let releaseTail!: () => void;
   225→  const currentTail = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
   226→    releaseTail = resolve;
   227→  });
   228→
   229→  const chainedTail = previousTail.catch(() => undefined).then(() => currentTail);
   230→  shotWriteTail.set(shotId, chainedTail);
   231→
   232→  await previousTail.catch(() => undefined);
   233→
   234→  const startedAt = Date.now();
   235→  shotWriteActive.set(shotId, {
   236→    requestId,
   237→    operation,
   238→    startedAt,
   239→  });
   240→  onEvent?.('start', {
   241→    shotId,
   242→    operation,
   243→    waitMs: startedAt - queuedAt,
   244→    durationMs: 0,
   245→    queueDepth: Math.max(0, (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 1) - 1),
   246→    requestId,
   247→    blockedByOperation: blockedBy?.operation ?? null,
   248→    blockedByDurationMs,
   249→  });
   250→
   251→  try {
   252→    const timeoutMs = options?.timeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_SERIALIZED_TIMELINE_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS;
   253→    return await runSerializedTaskWithTimeout(
   254→      operation,
   255→      task,
   256→      timeoutMs,

   258→        options?.onTimeout?.({
   259→          shotId,
   260→          operation,
   261→          timeoutMs,
   262→          pendingMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
   263→          requestId,
   264→        });
   265→      },
   266→    );
   267→  } finally {

   290→      requestId,
   291→      blockedByOperation: blockedBy?.operation ?? null,
   292→      blockedByDurationMs,
   293→    });

1→import { useEffect, useMemo, useReducer, useRef } from 'react';
     2→import { dataFreshnessManager } from '@/shared/realtime/DataFreshnessManager';
     3→
     4→interface SmartPollingConfig {
     5→  queryKey: readonly string[];
     6→  /** Default: 5 minutes. Set to false to disable polling when realtime is healthy. */
     7→  minInterval?: number | false;
     8→  /** Polling interval when realtime is broken. Default: 5 seconds. */
     9→  maxInterval?: number;
    10→  /** How fresh data needs to be to avoid aggressive polling. Default: 30 seconds. */
    11→  freshnessThreshold?: number;
    12→  debug?: boolean;
    13→}
    14→
    15→interface SmartPollingResult {
    16→  /** Use as React Query refetchInterval */
    17→  refetchInterval: number | false;
    18→  /** Use as React Query staleTime */
    19→  staleTime: number;
    20→  isDataFresh: boolean;
    21→  realtimeStatus: 'connected' | 'disconnected' | 'error';
    22→  /** Only populated when debug: true */
    23→  debug?: {
    24→    pollingReason: string;
    25→    lastEventAge?: number;
    26→    diagnostics: ReturnType<typeof dataFreshnessManager.getDiagnostics> | null;
    27→  };
    28→}
    29→
    30→/**
    31→ * @internal Used by useSmartPollingConfig - not directly exported.
    32→ */
    33→function useSmartPolling(config: SmartPollingConfig): SmartPollingResult {
    34→  const {
    35→    queryKey,
    36→    minInterval = 5 * 60 * 1000,
    37→    maxInterval = 15000,
    38→    freshnessThreshold = 30000,
    39→    debug = false
    40→  } = config;
    41→
    42→  // Mobile devices get longer polling intervals to reduce CPU/battery usage
    43→  const isMobile = /iPhone|iPad|iPod|Android/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
    44→
    45→  const [, forceUpdate] = useReducer(x => x + 1, 0);
    46→  const lastIntervalRef = useRef<number | false | null>(null);
    47→
    48→  // Ref keeps queryKey current without adding it to effect deps (arrays are new refs each render)
    49→  const queryKeyRef = useRef(queryKey);
    50→  queryKeyRef.current = queryKey;
    51→  const queryKeyString = JSON.stringify(queryKey);
    52→
    53→  // Batch rapid DataFreshnessManager notifications into a single re-render
    54→  const pendingUpdateRef = useRef(false);
    55→
    56→  useEffect(() => {
    57→    let active = true;
    58→
    59→    const unsubscribe = dataFreshnessManager.subscribe(() => {
    60→      const currentInterval = dataFreshnessManager.getPollingInterval(queryKeyRef.current);
    61→      if (lastIntervalRef.current !== currentInterval) {
    62→        if (!pendingUpdateRef.current) {
    63→          pendingUpdateRef.current = true;
    64→          queueMicrotask(() => {
    65→            pendingUpdateRef.current = false;
    66→            if (active) {
    67→              forceUpdate();
    68→            }
    69→          });
    70→        }
    71→      }
    72→    });
    73→
    74→    return () => {
    75→      active = false;
    76→      unsubscribe();
    77→    };
    78→  }, [queryKeyString, debug]);
    79→
    80→  const pollingInterval = dataFreshnessManager.getPollingInterval(queryKey);
    81→  lastIntervalRef.current = pollingInterval;
    82→  const isDataFresh = dataFreshnessManager.isDataFresh(queryKey, freshnessThreshold);
    83→  const diagnostics = debug ? dataFreshnessManager.getDiagnostics() : null;
    84→
    85→  let finalInterval: number | false;
    86→  let pollingReason: string;
    87→
    88→  const mobileMultiplier = isMobile ? 2 : 1;
    89→  const effectiveMaxInterval = maxInterval * mobileMultiplier;
    90→  const effectiveMinInterval = minInterval === false ? false : minInterval * mobileMultiplier;
    91→
    92→  if (pollingInterval === false) {
    93→    if (effectiveMinInterval === false) {
    94→      finalInterval = false;
    95→      pollingReason = 'disabled (realtime healthy)';
    96→    } else {
    97→      finalInterval = effectiveMinInterval;
    98→      pollingReason = 'minInterval fallback';
    99→    }
   100→  } else if (effectiveMinInterval !== false && pollingInterval > effectiveMinInterval && isDataFresh) {
   101→    finalInterval = effectiveMinInterval;
   102→    pollingReason = 'data fresh, using minInterval';
   103→  } else if (pollingInterval < effectiveMaxInterval) {
   104→    finalInterval = effectiveMaxInterval;
   105→    pollingReason = 'clamped to maxInterval';
   106→  } else {
   107→    finalInterval = pollingInterval * mobileMultiplier;
   108→    pollingReason = 'freshness manager interval';
   109→  }
   110→
   111→  const staleTime = isDataFresh ? freshnessThreshold : 0;
   112→
   113→  const result: SmartPollingResult = {
   114→    refetchInterval: finalInterval,
   115→    staleTime,
   116→    isDataFresh,
   117→    realtimeStatus: diagnostics?.realtimeStatus || 'disconnected'
   118→  };
   119→
   120→  if (debug) {
   121→    const queryAge = diagnostics?.queryAges?.find(q => 
   122→      JSON.stringify(q.query) === JSON.stringify(queryKey)
   123→    );
   124→
   125→    result.debug = {
   126→      pollingReason,
   127→      lastEventAge: queryAge?.ageMs,
   128→      diagnostics
   129→    };
   130→
   131→  }
   132→
   133→  return result;
   134→}
   135→
   136→/**
   137→ * Returns { refetchInterval, staleTime } to spread into useQuery options.
   138→ * Defaults to minInterval: false so polling is fully disabled when realtime is healthy.
   139→ */
   140→export function useSmartPollingConfig(queryKey: readonly string[], debug = false) {
   141→  const { refetchInterval, staleTime } = useSmartPolling({
   142→    queryKey,
   143→    debug,
   144→    minInterval: false,
   145→  });
   146→
   147→  // Stable reference so useQuery doesn't see "changed" options on every render
   148→  return useMemo(() => ({
   149→    refetchInterval,
   150→    staleTime
   151→  }), [refetchInterval, staleTime]);
   152→}
   153→

     5→
     6→const MAX_LOCAL_STORAGE_ITEM_LENGTH = 4 * 1024 * 1024; // 4MB
     7→
     8→// Check if localStorage is available (can fail in iOS Safari private mode)
     9→function isLocalStorageAvailable(): boolean {
    10→  try {
    11→    const test = '__localStorage_test__';
    12→    localStorage.setItem(test, test);
    13→    localStorage.removeItem(test);
    14→    return true;
    15→  } catch {
    16→    return false;
    17→  }
    18→}
    19→
    20→function usePersistentState<T>(key: string, defaultValue: T): [T, React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<T>>] {
    21→  const [state, setState] = useState<T>(() => {
    22→    // Mobile Safari in private mode can throw on localStorage access
    23→    if (!isLocalStorageAvailable()) {
    24→      return defaultValue;
    25→    }
    26→
    27→    try {
    28→      const storedValue = localStorage.getItem(key);
    29→      if (storedValue) {
    30→        return JSON.parse(storedValue) as T;
    31→      }
    32→    } catch (error) {
    33→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'usePersistentState', showToast: false });
    34→    }
    35→    return defaultValue;
    36→  });
    37→
    38→  // Listen for updates from other components using the same key
    39→  const handleExternalUpdate = useCallback((detail: { key: string; value: unknown }) => {
    40→    if (detail?.key === key) {
    41→      setState(detail.value as T);
    42→    }
    43→  }, [key]);
    44→
    45→  useAppEventListener('persistentStateChange', handleExternalUpdate);
    46→
    47→  useEffect(() => {
    48→    // Skip localStorage writes if not available
    49→    if (!isLocalStorageAvailable()) {
    50→      return;
    51→    }
    52→
    53→    try {
    54→      const serializedState = JSON.stringify(state);
    55→      if (serializedState.length > MAX_LOCAL_STORAGE_ITEM_LENGTH) {
    56→        toast.warning("Could not save settings locally.", {
    57→          description: "The data size exceeds the 4MB limit for local storage.",
    58→        });
    59→        return;
    60→      }
    61→      localStorage.setItem(key, serializedState);
    62→
    63→      // Broadcast change to other hook instances in the same tab
    64→      dispatchAppEvent('persistentStateChange', { key, value: state });
    65→    } catch (error) {
    66→      // Different error message for mobile users
    67→      const isMobile = /iPhone|iPad|iPod|Android/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
    68→      const errorDescription = isMobile
    69→        ? "Local storage may be disabled in private browsing mode. Settings will be lost when the tab is closed."
    70→        : "There was an error writing to your browser's local storage.";
    71→
    72→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    73→        context: 'usePersistentState',
    74→        toastTitle: 'Could not save settings locally.',
    75→        logData: { reason: errorDescription }
    76→      });
    77→    }
    78→  }, [key, state]);
    79→
    80→  return [state, setState];
    81→}
    82→
    83→export default usePersistentState;
    84→

    30→/** Runtime accessor that never throws; callers can branch on initialization state. */
    31→export function getSupabaseClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {

    33→  return result.ok ? result : { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(result.error) };

    35→
    36→export const supabaseClientRegistry: SupabaseClientRegistry = {
    37→  getClientResult: getSupabaseClientResult,

    40→/** Runtime accessor for initialized app runtime. Throws if bootstrap has not run. */
    41→export function getSupabaseClient() {

     7→declare const Deno: { env: { get: (key: string) => string | undefined } };
     8→
     9→/**
    10→ * Edge function: task-counts
    11→ *
    12→ * Provides task count information for scaling decisions and monitoring.
    13→ * Optimized for low latency - use debug=true for verbose diagnostics.
    14→ *
    15→ * - Service-role key: returns global task statistics across all users
    16→ * - User token: returns task statistics for that specific user only
    17→ *
    18→ * POST /functions/v1/task-counts
    19→ * Headers: Authorization: Bearer <JWT or PAT>
    20→ * Body: {
    21→ *   run_type?: 'gpu' | 'api',  // Optional: filter tasks by execution environment
    22→ *   debug?: boolean            // Optional: enable verbose logging and extra queries
    23→ * }
    24→ *
    25→ * Returns:
    26→ * {
    27→ *   mode: 'count',
    28→ *   timestamp: string,
    29→ *   run_type_filter?: 'gpu' | 'api' | null,
    30→ *
    31→ *   // Quick counts for scaling math (service role only)
    32→ *   totals: {
    33→ *     // Core counts (capacity-limited)
    34→ *     queued_only: number,             // Immediately claimable tasks (capacity-limited)
    35→ *     active_only: number,             // Tasks being processed
    36→ *     queued_plus_active: number,      // Total workload
    37→ *
    38→ *     // Breakdown for smarter scaling decisions (service role only)
    39→ *     blocked_by_capacity: number,     // Blocked by user's 5-task limit (will free up)
    40→ *     blocked_by_deps: number,         // Blocked by incomplete dependencies
    41→ *     blocked_by_settings: number,     // Blocked because user has cloud disabled
    42→ *     potentially_claimable: number,   // queued_only + blocked_by_capacity (for scaling)
    43→ *   },
    44→ *
    45→ *   // Detailed task arrays (limited to 100 for service role, 50 for user)
    46→ *   // Note: queued_tasks only includes immediately claimable tasks (matches queued_only criteria)
    47→ *   queued_tasks: [{...}],
    48→ *   active_tasks: [{...}],
    49→ *
    50→ *   // User stats (service role only)
    51→ *   users?: [...],
    52→ *
    53→ *   // User-specific info (user token only)
    54→ *   user_id?: string,
    55→ *   user_info?: {...}
    56→ * }
    57→ *
    58→ * - 200 OK with task count data
    59→ * - 401 Unauthorized if no valid token
    60→ * - 403 Forbidden if token invalid
    61→ * - 500 Internal Server Error
    62→ */
    63→serve(async (req) => {
    64→  // Only accept POST requests
    65→  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    66→    return new Response("Method not allowed", { status: 405 });
    67→  }
    68→
    69→  const serviceKey = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY");
    70→  const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL");

    73→    return new Response("Server configuration error", { status: 500 });
    74→  }
    75→
    76→  // Create admin client for database operations
    77→  const supabaseAdmin = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey);
    78→  const logger = new SystemLogger(supabaseAdmin, 'task-counts');
    79→
    80→  // Parse request body

     6→export function validateRequiredFields(params: object, requiredFields: readonly string[]): void {

     5→

     8→  'Supabase runtime is not initialized. Call initializeSupabaseClientRuntime() during app bootstrap.';
     9→
    10→let runtimeClient: SupabaseClientInstance | null = null;
    11→let runtimeError: Error | null = null;
    12→
    13→export type SupabaseClientAccessResult =
    14→  | { ok: true; client: SupabaseClientInstance }
    15→  | { ok: false; error: Error };
    16→
    17→export function normalizeSupabaseError(error: unknown): Error {
    18→  return error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    19→}
    20→
    21→export function initializeSupabaseClientRuntime(): SupabaseClientInstance {
    22→  if (runtimeClient) {
    23→    return runtimeClient;
    24→  }
    25→
    26→  try {
    27→    const client = createSupabaseClient();
    28→    initializeSupabaseRuntime(client);
    29→    runtimeClient = client;
    30→    runtimeError = null;
    31→    return client;
    32→  } catch (error) {
    33→    const normalized = normalizeSupabaseError(error);
    34→    runtimeClient = null;
    35→    runtimeError = normalized;
    36→    throw normalized;
    37→  }
    38→}
    39→
    40→export function getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    41→  if (runtimeClient) {
    42→    return { ok: true, client: runtimeClient };
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  if (runtimeError) {
    46→    return { ok: false, error: runtimeError };
    47→  }
    48→
    49→  return {
    50→    ok: false,
    51→    error: new Error(SUPABASE_RUNTIME_NOT_INITIALIZED_MESSAGE),
    52→  };
    53→}
    54→

    57→  if (!result.ok) {

    59→  }

1→import { AppError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errors';
     2→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     3→import type { TaskCreationResult } from './types';
     4→
     5→/**
     6→ * Processes batch Promise.allSettled results with standard error handling.
     7→ *
     8→ * - Throws if every task failed (surfaces the first error).
     9→ * - Logs individual failures when some succeed.
    10→ * - Returns the fulfilled TaskCreationResult values.
    11→ */
    12→export function processBatchResults(
    13→  results: PromiseSettledResult<TaskCreationResult>[],
    14→  context: string,
    15→): TaskCreationResult[] {
    16→  const successful = results.filter(r => r.status === 'fulfilled').length;
    17→  const failed = results.filter(r => r.status === 'rejected').length;
    18→
    19→  if (successful === 0) {
    20→    const firstError = results.find(r => r.status === 'rejected') as PromiseRejectedResult;
    21→    const reasonError = firstError.reason instanceof Error
    22→      ? firstError.reason
    23→      : new Error(String(firstError.reason));
    24→    throw new AppError(`All batch tasks failed: ${reasonError.message}`, {
    25→      cause: reasonError,
    26→      context: { context },
    27→    });
    28→  }
    29→
    30→  if (failed > 0) {
    31→    results.forEach((result, index) => {
    32→      if (result.status === 'rejected') {
    33→        normalizeAndPresentError(result.reason, { context: `${context}:task${index + 1}`, showToast: false });
    34→      }
    35→    });
    36→  }
    37→
    38→  return results
    39→    .filter((r): r is PromiseFulfilledResult<TaskCreationResult> => r.status === 'fulfilled')
    40→    .map(r => r.value);
    41→}
    42→

   183→        const { data: existingTask, error: fetchError } = await supabaseAdmin
   184→          .from("tasks")

   194→          await logger.flush();

   215→    if (!insertedTask || typeof insertedTask.id !== "string") {

   221→    logger.setDefaultTaskId(insertedTask.id);

   229→      has_idempotency_key: !!requestBody.idempotency_key,
   230→    });
   231→
   232→    await logger.flush();
   233→    return createCorsResponse(
   234→      JSON.stringify({
   235→        task_id: insertedTask.id,
   236→        status: "Task queued",
   237→      }),
   238→      200
   239→    );
   240→  } catch (error: unknown) {
   241→    const message = getErrorMessage(error);
   242→    logger.critical("Unexpected error", { error: message });
   243→    await logger.flush();
   244→    return createCorsResponse(`Internal server error: ${message}`, 500);
   245→  }
   246→});

   529→    return completeTaskErrorResponse("Internal server error", 500);
   530→  }
   531→}

   534→if ((import.meta as unknown).main) {
   535→  serve((req) => completeTaskHandler(req));
   536→}

   241→    .from("projects")
   242→    .select("user_id")
   243→    .eq("id", shotData.project_id)
   244→    .single();
   245→
   246→  if (projectError || !projectData) {
   247→    console.error(`${logPrefix} Project lookup error:`, projectError);
   248→    return {
   249→      success: false,
   250→      error: "Project not found",
   251→      statusCode: 404
   252→    };
   253→  }
   254→
   255→  if (projectData.user_id !== userId) {
   256→    console.error(`${logPrefix} Shot ${shotId} belongs to project ${shotData.project_id} owned by ${projectData.user_id}, not user ${userId}`);
   257→    return {
   258→      success: false,
   259→      error: "Forbidden: Shot does not belong to user",
   260→      statusCode: 403
   261→    };
   262→  }
   263→
   264→  return {
   265→    success: true,
   266→    projectId: shotData.project_id
   267→  };
   268→}

   270→/**
   271→ * Gets the user ID for a task (for service role requests)
   272→ * 
   273→ * @param supabaseAdmin - Supabase admin client
   274→ * @param taskId - Task ID
   275→ * @param logPrefix - Optional prefix for log messages
   276→ * @returns Object with userId or error
   277→ */
   278→export async function getTaskUserId(
   279→  supabaseAdmin: SupabaseClient,
   280→  taskId: string,
   281→  logPrefix: string = "[AUTH]"
   282→): Promise<{ userId: string | null; error?: string; statusCode?: number }> {
   283→
   284→  const { data: taskData, error: taskError } = await supabaseAdmin
   285→    .from("tasks")
   286→    .select("project_id")
   287→    .eq("id", taskId)
   288→    .single();
   289→
   290→  if (taskError || !taskData) {
   291→    console.error(`${logPrefix} Task lookup error:`, taskError);
   292→    return {
   293→      userId: null,
   294→      error: "Task not found",
   295→      statusCode: 404
   296→    };
   297→  }
   298→
   299→  const { data: projectData, error: projectError } = await supabaseAdmin
   300→    .from("projects")
   301→    .select("user_id")
   302→    .eq("id", taskData.project_id)
   303→    .single();
   304→
   305→  if (projectError || !projectData) {
   306→    console.error(`${logPrefix} Project lookup error:`, projectError);
   307→    // Fallback to system folder — files are stored under SYSTEM_USER_ID
   308→    // so the task can still complete even if the project was deleted
   309→    return {
   310→      userId: SYSTEM_USER_ID
   311→    };
   312→  }
   313→
   314→  return {
   315→    userId: projectData.user_id
   316→  };

     7→/**
     8→ * Edge function: get-task-output
     9→ *
    10→ * Fetches the output_location and status for a specific task.
    11→ * Used by workers to get outputs from dependency tasks (e.g., final_stitch getting transition outputs).
    12→ *
    13→ * - Service-role key: can fetch any task
    14→ * - User token: can only fetch tasks from their own projects
    15→ *
    16→ * POST /functions/v1/get-task-output
    17→ * Headers: Authorization: Bearer <service-key or PAT>
    18→ * Body: { "task_id": "uuid" }
    19→ *
    20→ * Returns:
    21→ * - 200 OK with { status, output_location }
    22→ * - 400 Bad Request if task_id missing
    23→ * - 401 Unauthorized if no valid token
    24→ * - 403 Forbidden if user doesn't own the task's project
    25→ * - 404 Not Found if task doesn't exist
    26→ * - 500 Internal Server Error
    27→ */
    28→serve((req) => withEdgeRequest(req, {
    29→  functionName: "get-task-output",
    30→  logPrefix: "[GET-TASK-OUTPUT]",
    31→  parseBody: "strict",
    32→  auth: {
    33→    required: true,
    34→  },
    35→}, async ({ supabaseAdmin, logger, body, auth }) => {
    36→  if (!auth || (!auth.userId && !auth.isServiceRole)) {
    37→    logger.error("Authentication failed");
    38→    return jsonResponse({ error: "Authentication failed" }, 401);
    39→  }
    40→
    41→  const taskId = typeof body.task_id === 'string' || typeof body.task_id === 'number'
    42→    ? String(body.task_id)
    43→    : '';
    44→  if (!taskId) {
    45→    logger.error("Missing task_id");
    46→    return jsonResponse({ error: "task_id is required" }, 400);
    47→  }
    48→
    49→  logger.setDefaultTaskId(taskId);
    50→
    51→  const actor = await authorizeTaskActor({
    52→    supabaseAdmin,
    53→    taskId,
    54→    auth: auth!,
    55→    logPrefix: "[GET-TASK-OUTPUT]",
    56→  });
    57→  if (!actor.ok) {
    58→    logger.error("Task access denied", {
    59→      task_id: taskId,
    60→      error: actor.error,
    61→      status_code: actor.statusCode,
    62→    });
    63→    return jsonResponse({ error: actor.error }, actor.statusCode);
    64→  }
    65→
    66→  // Fetch the task with all needed fields
    67→  const { data: task, error: taskError } = await supabaseAdmin
    68→    .from("tasks")
    69→    .select("id, status, output_location, project_id, params, dependant_on")
    70→    .eq("id", taskId)
    71→    .single();
    72→
    73→  if (taskError || !task) {

    76→  }
    77→
    78→  logger.info("Returning task output", { status: task.status, has_output: !!task.output_location });
    79→  return jsonResponse({
    80→    status: task.status,
    81→    output_location: task.output_location,
    82→    params: task.params,
    83→    dependant_on: task.dependant_on,
    84→  }, 200);
    85→}));

1→// deno-lint-ignore-file
     2→import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
     3→import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2.39.7";
     4→import { authenticateRequest } from "../_shared/auth.ts";
     5→import { SystemLogger } from "../_shared/systemLogger.ts";
     6→
     7→declare const Deno: { env: { get: (key: string) => string | undefined } };
     8→
     9→/**
    10→ * Edge function: get-task-status
    11→ *
    12→ * Returns the current status of a task by ID.
    13→ * Read-only, no side effects.
    14→ *
    15→ * POST /functions/v1/get-task-status
    16→ * Headers: Authorization: Bearer <service-key or PAT>
    17→ * Body: { "task_id": "uuid" }
    18→ *
    19→ * Returns:
    20→ * - 200 OK with { status }
    21→ * - 400 Bad Request if task_id missing
    22→ * - 404 Not Found if task doesn't exist
    23→ */
    24→serve(async (req) => {
    25→  const serviceKey = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY");
    26→  const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL");
    27→
    28→  if (!serviceKey || !supabaseUrl) {
    29→    return new Response("Server configuration error", { status: 500 });
    30→  }
    31→
    32→  const supabaseAdmin = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey);
    33→  const logger = new SystemLogger(supabaseAdmin, 'get-task-status');
    34→
    35→  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    36→    return new Response("Method not allowed", { status: 405 });
    37→  }
    38→
    39→  let requestBody: unknown = {};
    40→  try {
    41→    const bodyText = await req.text();
    42→    if (bodyText) {
    43→      requestBody = JSON.parse(bodyText);
    44→    }
    45→  } catch {
    46→    return new Response("Invalid JSON body", { status: 400 });
    47→  }
    48→
    49→  const taskId = requestBody.task_id;
    50→  if (!taskId) {
    51→    return new Response("task_id is required", { status: 400 });
    52→  }
    53→
    54→  const auth = await authenticateRequest(req, supabaseAdmin, "[GET-TASK-STATUS]");
    55→  if (!auth.success) {
    56→    return new Response(auth.error || "Authentication failed", { status: auth.statusCode || 403 });
    57→  }
    58→
    59→  try {
    60→    const { data: task, error } = await supabaseAdmin
    61→      .from("tasks")
    62→      .select("status")
    63→      .eq("id", taskId)
    64→      .single();
    65→
    66→    if (error || !task) {
    67→      return new Response("Task not found", { status: 404 });
    68→    }
    69→
    70→    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ status: task.status }), {
    71→      status: 200,
    72→      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    73→    });
    74→  } catch (error: unknown) {
    75→    logger.error('Internal server error', { task_id: taskId, error: error?.message });
    76→    await logger.flush();
    77→    return new Response(`Internal server error: ${error?.message}`, { status: 500 });
    78→  }
    79→});
    80→
