1→/**
     2→ * Edge Function: trim-video
     3→ * 
     4→ * Trims a video using Replicate's lucataco/trim-video model and uploads to Supabase storage.
     5→ * Converts WebM to MP4 with proper duration metadata.
     6→ * Note: Thumbnail extraction is done client-side after this function returns.
     7→ * 
     8→ * POST /functions/v1/trim-video
     9→ * Body: {
    10→ *   video_url: string,      // URL of the source video
    11→ *   start_time: number,     // Start time in seconds
    12→ *   end_time: number,       // End time in seconds  
    13→ *   project_id: string,     // For storage path
    14→ *   user_id: string,        // For storage path
    15→ *   generation_id?: string, // Optional: to update variant record
    16→ *   variant_id?: string     // Optional: to update variant record
    17→ * }
    18→ * 
    19→ * Returns:
    20→ * - 200 OK with { video_url, duration, format }
    21→ * - 400 Bad Request if missing required fields
    22→ * - 500 Internal Server Error
    23→ */
    24→
    25→import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
    26→import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2.39.7";
    27→import { storagePaths, MEDIA_BUCKET } from '../_shared/storagePaths.ts';
    28→import { SystemLogger } from "../_shared/systemLogger.ts";
    29→import { authenticateRequest } from "../_shared/auth.ts";
    30→
    31→declare const Deno: {
    32→  env: {
    33→    get(key: string): string | undefined;
    34→  };
    35→};
    36→
    37→const corsHeaders = {
    38→  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
    39→  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type',
    40→};
    41→
    42→const REPLICATE_TRIM_MODEL = "lucataco/trim-video:a58ed80215326cba0a80c77a11dd0d0968c567388228891b3c5c67de2a8d10cb";
    43→
    44→interface TrimRequest {
    45→  video_url: string;
    46→  start_time: number;
    47→  end_time: number;
    48→  project_id: string;
    49→  user_id: string;
    50→  generation_id?: string;
    51→  variant_id?: string;
    52→  test_mode?: boolean;
    53→}
    54→
    55→/**
    56→ * Convert seconds to MM:SS.ms format for Replicate trim-video model
    57→ * Includes milliseconds for sub-second precision
    58→ */
    59→function secondsToTimeString(seconds: number): string {
    60→  const mins = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
    61→  const secs = seconds % 60;
    62→  // Format as MM:SS.ms (e.g., "00:02.5" for 2.5 seconds)
    63→  const secsStr = secs < 10 ? `0${secs.toFixed(1)}` : secs.toFixed(1);
    64→  return `${mins.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${secsStr}`;
    65→}
    66→
    67→/**
    68→ * Wait for Replicate prediction to complete
    69→ */
    70→async function waitForPrediction(
    71→  predictionId: string, 
    72→  apiToken: string,
    73→  maxWaitMs: number = 300000 // 5 minutes max
    74→): Promise<unknown> {
    75→  const startTime = Date.now();
    76→  
    77→  while (Date.now() - startTime < maxWaitMs) {
    78→    const response = await fetch(
    79→      `https://api.replicate.com/v1/predictions/${predictionId}`,
    80→      {
    81→        headers: { 
    82→          'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiToken}`,
    83→          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    84→        },
    85→      }
    86→    );
    87→    
    88→    if (!response.ok) {
    89→      throw new Error(`Failed to check prediction status: ${response.status}`);
    90→    }
    91→    
    92→    const prediction = await response.json();
    93→    
    94→    if (prediction.status === 'succeeded') {
    95→      return prediction;
    96→    }
    97→    
    98→    if (prediction.status === 'failed' || prediction.status === 'canceled') {
    99→      throw new Error(`Prediction ${prediction.status}: ${prediction.error || 'Unknown error'}`);
   100→    }
   101→    
   102→    // Wait 2 seconds before polling again
   103→    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));
   104→  }
   105→  
   106→  throw new Error('Prediction timeout - took too long to process');
   107→}
   108→
   109→/**
   110→ * Call Replicate's trim-video model
   111→ * The model uses start_time and end_time in MM:SS format
   112→ */
   113→async function trimWithReplicate(
   114→  videoUrl: string,
   115→  startTime: number,
   116→  endTime: number,
   117→  apiToken: string
   118→): Promise<string> {
   119→  
   120→  // The model takes start_time and end_time in MM:SS format
   121→  const input: Record<string, string> = {
   122→    video: videoUrl,
   123→    start_time: secondsToTimeString(startTime),
   124→    end_time: secondsToTimeString(endTime),
   125→  };
   126→  
   127→  // Create prediction
   128→  const createResponse = await fetch('https://api.replicate.com/v1/predictions', {
   129→    method: 'POST',
   130→    headers: {
   131→      'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiToken}`,
   132→      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
   133→    },
   134→    body: JSON.stringify({
   135→      version: REPLICATE_TRIM_MODEL.split(':')[1],
   136→      input,
   137→    }),
   138→  });
   139→
   140→  if (!createResponse.ok) {
   141→    const errorText = await createResponse.text();
   142→    console.error(`[TRIM-VIDEO] Replicate API error: ${errorText}`);
   143→    throw new Error(`Replicate API error: ${createResponse.status} - ${errorText}`);
   144→  }
   145→
   146→  const prediction = await createResponse.json();
   147→
   148→  // Wait for completion
   149→  const result = await waitForPrediction(prediction.id, apiToken);
   150→  
   151→  // Get the output URL
   152→  const outputUrl = result.output;
   153→  if (!outputUrl) {
   154→    throw new Error('No output URL in prediction result');
   155→  }
   156→  
   157→  return outputUrl;
   158→}
   159→
   160→/**
   161→ * Download video from URL
   162→ */
   163→async function downloadVideo(url: string): Promise<ArrayBuffer> {
   164→  
   165→  const response = await fetch(url);
   166→  if (!response.ok) {
   167→    throw new Error(`Failed to download video: ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`);
   168→  }
   169→  
   170→  const buffer = await response.arrayBuffer();
   171→  
   172→  return buffer;
   173→}
   174→
   175→/**
   176→ * Upload video to Supabase Storage
   177→ * Note: projectId param kept for backwards compatibility but no longer used in path
   178→ */
   179→async function uploadToStorage(
   180→  supabase: ReturnType<typeof createClient>,
   181→  videoBuffer: ArrayBuffer,
   182→  userId: string,
   183→  projectId: string,
   184→  contentType: string = 'video/mp4'
   185→): Promise<string> {
   186→  // Generate storage path using centralized utilities
   187→  const timestamp = Date.now();
   188→  const randomStr = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8);
   189→  const extension = contentType.includes('mp4') ? 'mp4' : 'webm';
   190→  const filename = `trimmed_${timestamp}_${randomStr}.${extension}`;
   191→  const uploadPath = storagePaths.upload(userId, filename);
   192→
   193→  const { error } = await supabase.storage
   194→    .from(MEDIA_BUCKET)
   195→    .upload(uploadPath, videoBuffer, {
   196→      contentType,
   197→      upsert: true,
   198→    });
   199→
   200→  if (error) {
   201→    throw new Error(`Storage upload failed: ${error.message}`);
   202→  }
   203→
   204→  const { data: urlData } = supabase.storage
   205→    .from(MEDIA_BUCKET)
   206→    .getPublicUrl(uploadPath);
   207→
   208→  return urlData.publicUrl;
   209→}
   210→
   211→/**
   212→ * Update variant record with new video URL
   213→ */
   214→async function updateVariantRecord(
   215→  supabase: ReturnType<typeof createClient>,
   216→  variantId: string,
   217→  videoUrl: string,
   218→  thumbnailUrl: string | null,
   219→  duration: number
   220→): Promise<void> {
   221→  
   222→  const { error } = await supabase
   223→    .from('generation_variants')
   224→    .update({
   225→      location: videoUrl,
   226→      thumbnail_url: thumbnailUrl,
   227→      params: {
   228→        duration_seconds: duration,
   229→        processed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
   230→        format: 'mp4',
   231→      },
   232→    })
   233→    .eq('id', variantId);
   234→
   235→  if (error) {
   236→    console.error(`[TRIM-VIDEO] Failed to update variant: ${error.message}`);
   237→    // Don't throw - the video was still processed successfully
   238→  }
   239→}
   240→
   241→/**
   242→ * Main handler
   243→ */
   244→serve(async (req) => {
   245→  // Handle CORS
   246→  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
   247→    return new Response('ok', { headers: corsHeaders });
   248→  }
   249→
   250→  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
   251→    return new Response('Method not allowed', { 
   252→      status: 405, 
   253→      headers: corsHeaders 
   254→    });
   255→  }
   256→
   257→  const startProcessTime = Date.now();
   258→
   259→  // Initialize Supabase client and logger early so logger is available in catch
   260→  const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!;
   261→  const supabaseServiceKey = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!;
   262→  const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseServiceKey);
   263→  const logger = new SystemLogger(supabase, 'trim-video');
   264→
   265→  try {
   266→    // Parse request
   267→    const body: TrimRequest = await req.json();
   268→    const {
   269→      video_url,
   270→      start_time,
   271→      end_time,
   272→      project_id,
   273→      user_id,
   274→      variant_id,
   275→      test_mode = false,
   276→    } = body;
   277→
   278→    logger.info('Starting video trim request', {
   279→      video_url: video_url?.substring(0, 80),
   280→      start_time,
   281→      end_time,
   282→      duration: end_time - start_time,
   283→      project_id: project_id?.substring(0, 8),
   284→      user_id: user_id?.substring(0, 8),
   285→    });
   286→
   287→    // Validate required fields
   288→    if (!video_url) {
   289→      return new Response(
   290→        JSON.stringify({ error: 'video_url is required', success: false }),
   291→        { status: 400, headers: { ...corsHeaders, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
   292→      );
   293→    }
   294→
   295→    if (typeof start_time !== 'number' || typeof end_time !== 'number') {
   296→      return new Response(

   298→        { status: 400, headers: { ...corsHeaders, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
   299→      );
   300→    }
   301→
   302→    if (start_time >= end_time) {
   303→      logger.error('Invalid times', { start_time, end_time });
   304→      return new Response(

   321→      );
   322→    }
   323→
   324→    if (!project_id || !user_id) {

   111→      const isCurrentRequest = (
   112→        pendingConsumeVersionRef.current === requestVersion
   113→        && activeProjectIdRef.current === projectIdAtRequestStart
   114→      );
   115→      if (!isCurrentRequest) {
   116→        return;
   117→      }

   119→      if (!result.ok) {
   120→        normalizeAndPresentError(toOperationResultError(result), {
   121→          context: 'JoinClipsPage.pendingClipsConsume',
   122→          showToast: false,
   123→        });
   124→        return;
   125→      }
   126→      const actions = result.value;
   127→      if (actions.length > 0) {
   128→        setClips(prev => applyPendingClipActions(prev, actions));
   129→      }
   130→    });
   131→
   132→    return () => {
   133→      cancelled = true;
   134→    };
   135→  }, [settingsLoaded, selectedProjectId, initialHydrationComplete]);

1→/**
     2→ * Best-effort clipboard write that never throws.
     3→ * Returns true when the write succeeds.
     4→ */
     5→export async function writeClipboardTextSafe(
     6→  text: string,
     7→  options: { allowExecCommandFallback?: boolean } = {},
     8→): Promise<boolean> {
     9→  if (!text) {
    10→    return false;
    11→  }
    12→
    13→  if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
    14→    try {
    15→      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    16→      return true;
    17→    } catch {
    18→      // fall through to optional fallback
    19→    }
    20→  }
    21→
    22→  if (!options.allowExecCommandFallback || typeof document === 'undefined') {
    23→    return false;
    24→  }
    25→
    26→  let textarea: HTMLTextAreaElement | null = null;
    27→  try {
    28→    textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
    29→    textarea.value = text;
    30→    textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
    31→    textarea.style.left = '-9999px';
    32→    document.body.appendChild(textarea);
    33→    textarea.select();
    34→    return document.execCommand('copy') === true;
    35→  } catch {
    36→    return false;
    37→  } finally {
    38→    if (textarea?.parentNode) {
    39→      textarea.parentNode.removeChild(textarea);
    40→    }
    41→  }
    42→}
    43→

    12→

    18→
    19→interface ProjectCrudContextType {
    20→  projects: Project[];

    24→  isCreatingProject: boolean;

    26→  isUpdatingProject: boolean;
    27→  deleteProject: (projectId: string) => Promise<boolean>;

    29→}
    30→
    31→interface ProjectIdentityContextType {

    34→}
    35→
    36→interface ProjectContextType
    37→  extends ProjectSelectionContextType,
    38→    ProjectCrudContextType,
    39→    ProjectIdentityContextType {}
    40→
    41→const ProjectSelectionContext = createContext<ProjectSelectionContextType | undefined>(undefined);
    42→const ProjectCrudContext = createContext<ProjectCrudContextType | undefined>(undefined);
    43→const ProjectIdentityContext = createContext<ProjectIdentityContextType | undefined>(undefined);
    44→
    45→export const ProjectProvider = ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => {
    46→  const { userId, selection, crud } = useProjectSessionCoordinator();
    47→  useRenderLogger('ProjectProvider', { userId });

    49→  const projects = crud.projects || [];

    51→  const project = projects.find((item) => item.id === selectedProjectId) ?? null;
    52→
    53→  const selectionValue = useMemo(
    54→    (): ProjectSelectionContextType => ({
    55→      selectedProjectId,
    56→      project,
    57→      setSelectedProjectId: selection.setSelectedProjectId,
    58→    }),
    59→    [selectedProjectId, project, selection.setSelectedProjectId],
    60→  );
    61→
    62→  const crudValue = useMemo(
    63→    (): ProjectCrudContextType => ({
    64→      projects: crud.projects || [],
    65→      isLoadingProjects: crud.isLoadingProjects,
    66→      fetchProjects: crud.fetchProjects,
    67→      addNewProject: crud.addNewProject,
    68→      isCreatingProject: crud.isCreatingProject,
    69→      updateProject: crud.updateProject,
    70→      isUpdatingProject: crud.isUpdatingProject,
    71→      deleteProject: crud.deleteProject,
    72→      isDeletingProject: crud.isDeletingProject,
    73→    }),
    74→    [
    75→      crud.projects,
    76→      crud.isLoadingProjects,
    77→      crud.fetchProjects,
    78→      crud.addNewProject,
    79→      crud.isCreatingProject,
    80→      crud.updateProject,
    81→      crud.isUpdatingProject,
    82→      crud.deleteProject,
    83→      crud.isDeletingProject,
    84→    ],
    85→  );
    86→
    87→  const identityValue = useMemo(
    88→    (): ProjectIdentityContextType => ({
    89→      userId: userId ?? null,
    90→    }),
    91→    [userId],
    92→  );
    93→
    94→  return (
    95→    <ProjectIdentityContext.Provider value={identityValue}>
    96→      <ProjectCrudContext.Provider value={crudValue}>
    97→        <ProjectSelectionContext.Provider value={selectionValue}>
    98→          {children}
    99→        </ProjectSelectionContext.Provider>
   100→      </ProjectCrudContext.Provider>
   101→    </ProjectIdentityContext.Provider>
   102→  );
   103→};
   104→
   105→export const useProjectSelectionContext = () => {
   106→  return requireContextValue(
   107→    useContext(ProjectSelectionContext),
   108→    'useProjectSelectionContext',
   109→    'ProjectProvider',
   110→  );
   111→};
   112→
   113→export const useProjectCrudContext = () => {
   114→  return requireContextValue(

   116→    'useProjectCrudContext',
   117→    'ProjectProvider',
   118→  );
   119→};
   120→
   121→export const useProjectIdentityContext = () => {
   122→  return requireContextValue(
   123→    useContext(ProjectIdentityContext),
   124→    'useProjectIdentityContext',
   125→    'ProjectProvider',
   126→  );
   127→};
   128→
   129→/** Compatibility hook for existing callers that still need the combined project contract. */
   130→export const useProject = () => {
   131→  const selection = requireContextValue(
   132→    useContext(ProjectSelectionContext),
   133→    'useProject',
   134→    'ProjectProvider',
   135→  );
   136→  const crud = requireContextValue(
   137→    useContext(ProjectCrudContext),
   138→    'useProject',
   139→    'ProjectProvider',
   140→  );
   141→  const identity = requireContextValue(
   142→    useContext(ProjectIdentityContext),
   143→    'useProject',
   144→    'ProjectProvider',
   145→  );
   146→
   147→  return useMemo<ProjectContextType>(() => ({
   148→    ...crud,
   149→    ...selection,
   150→    ...identity,
   151→  }), [crud, selection, identity]);
   152→};

1→import React, { createContext, useContext, ReactNode, useMemo } from 'react';
     2→import { useListShots, useProjectImageStats } from '@/shared/hooks/shots';
     3→import { useProject } from '@/shared/contexts/ProjectContext';
     4→import { Shot } from '@/domains/generation/types';
     5→
     6→interface ShotsContextType {
     7→  shots: Shot[] | undefined;
     8→  isLoading: boolean;
     9→  error: Error | null;
    10→  refetchShots: () => void;
    11→  // Stats for SHOT_FILTER.ALL and SHOT_FILTER.NO_SHOT filters
    12→  allImagesCount?: number;
    13→  noShotImagesCount?: number;
    14→}
    15→
    16→const ShotsContext = createContext<ShotsContextType | undefined>(undefined);
    17→
    18→interface ShotsProviderProps {
    19→  children: ReactNode;
    20→}
    21→
    22→export const ShotsProvider: React.FC<ShotsProviderProps> = ({ children }) => {
    23→  const { selectedProjectId } = useProject();
    24→
    25→  // Track previous project ID to detect project switches
    26→  const prevProjectIdRef = React.useRef<string | null>(null);
    27→  const [isProjectTransitioning, setIsProjectTransitioning] = React.useState(false);
    28→
    29→  // Detect project switch and set transitioning state
    30→  React.useEffect(() => {
    31→    if (prevProjectIdRef.current !== null && prevProjectIdRef.current !== selectedProjectId) {
    32→      setIsProjectTransitioning(true);
    33→    }
    34→    prevProjectIdRef.current = selectedProjectId;
    35→  }, [selectedProjectId]);
    36→
    37→  // Load all images per shot (0 = unlimited)
    38→  // Previously limited to 2 on mobile for performance, but this broke expand/collapse UI
    39→  const maxImagesPerShot = 0;
    40→
    41→  const { data: shots, isLoading: isShotsLoading, isFetching: isShotsFetching, error: shotsError, refetch } = useListShots(selectedProjectId, { maxImagesPerShot });
    42→
    43→  // Load project-wide image stats
    44→  const { data: projectStats, isLoading: isStatsLoading } = useProjectImageStats(selectedProjectId);
    45→
    46→  // Clear transitioning state when new shots data arrives
    47→  // Use isFetching (not isLoading) because placeholderData keeps isLoading false during refetches
    48→  React.useEffect(() => {
    49→    if (isProjectTransitioning && !isShotsFetching && shots !== undefined) {
    50→      setIsProjectTransitioning(false);
    51→    }
    52→  }, [isProjectTransitioning, isShotsFetching, shots]);
    53→
    54→  // Show loading during transition or actual loading
    55→  const isLoading = isShotsLoading || isStatsLoading || isProjectTransitioning;
    56→  const error = shotsError;
    57→
    58→  // Return undefined for shots during transition to force skeleton display
    59→  // This prevents showing stale data from a previously cached project
    60→  const effectiveShots = isProjectTransitioning ? undefined : shots;
    61→
    62→  // Memoize context value to prevent unnecessary re-renders of consumers
    63→  const value = useMemo<ShotsContextType>(() => ({
    64→    shots: effectiveShots,
    65→    isLoading,
    66→    error,
    67→    refetchShots: refetch,
    68→    allImagesCount: projectStats?.allCount,
    69→    noShotImagesCount: projectStats?.noShotCount,
    70→  }), [effectiveShots, isLoading, error, refetch, projectStats]);
    71→
    72→  return (
    73→    <ShotsContext.Provider value={value}>
    74→      {children}
    75→    </ShotsContext.Provider>
    76→  );
    77→};
    78→
    79→export const useShots = (): ShotsContextType => {
    80→  const context = useContext(ShotsContext);
    81→  if (context === undefined) {
    82→    throw new Error('useShots must be used within a ShotsProvider');
    83→  }
    84→  return context;
    85→};

1→/**
     2→ * VideoTravelSettingsProvider - Centralized settings context for Video Travel tool
     3→ *
     4→ * This provider owns all shot-specific settings state, making it accessible to
     5→ * any child component without prop drilling. Settings are persisted via useShotSettings.
     6→ *
     7→ * Architecture:
     8→ * - Wraps useShotSettings (state + persistence)
     9→ * - Wraps useVideoTravelSettingsHandlers (all update handlers)
    10→ * - Exposes focused hooks for each settings domain
    11→ *
    12→ * Usage:
    13→ * ```tsx
    14→ * // In VideoTravelToolPage
    15→ * <VideoTravelSettingsProvider projectId={projectId} shotId={shotId}>
    16→ *   <ShotSettingsEditor />
    17→ * </VideoTravelSettingsProvider>
    18→ *
    19→ * // In any child component
    20→ * const { prompt, setPrompt } = usePromptSettings();
    21→ * const { motionMode, setMotionMode } = useMotionSettings();
    22→ * ```
    23→ */
    24→
    25→import React, {
    26→  createContext,
    27→  useContext,
    28→  useMemo,
    29→  useRef
    30→} from 'react';
    31→import { Shot } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    32→import { useShotSettings, UseShotSettingsReturn } from '../hooks/settings/useShotSettings';
    33→import { useVideoTravelSettingsHandlers, VideoTravelSettingsHandlers } from '../hooks/settings/useVideoTravelSettingsHandlers';
    34→import { VideoTravelSettings, PhaseConfig } from '../settings';
    35→import { LoraModel } from '@/shared/components/LoraSelectorModal';
    36→
    37→// =============================================================================
    38→// CONTEXT TYPES
    39→// =============================================================================
    40→
    41→interface VideoTravelSettingsContextValue {
    42→  // Core state
    43→  settings: VideoTravelSettings;
    44→  status: 'idle' | 'loading' | 'ready' | 'saving' | 'error';
    45→  isDirty: boolean;
    46→  isLoading: boolean;
    47→
    48→  // Shot info
    49→  shotId: string | null;
    50→  projectId: string | null;
    51→
    52→  // All handlers from useVideoTravelSettingsHandlers
    53→  handlers: VideoTravelSettingsHandlers;
    54→
    55→  // Direct access to updateField/updateFields for custom updates
    56→  updateField: UseShotSettingsReturn['updateField'];
    57→  updateFields: UseShotSettingsReturn['updateFields'];
    58→
    59→  // Save operations
    60→  save: () => Promise<void>;
    61→  saveImmediate: () => Promise<void>;
    62→
    63→  // LoRAs (passed through from parent)
    64→  availableLoras: LoraModel[];
    65→}
    66→
    67→// Export the context for direct useContext access in bridge hooks
    68→export const VideoTravelSettingsContext = createContext<VideoTravelSettingsContextValue | null>(null);
    69→
    70→// =============================================================================
    71→// PROVIDER COMPONENT
    72→// =============================================================================
    73→
    74→interface VideoTravelSettingsProviderProps {
    75→  projectId: string | null | undefined;
    76→  shotId: string | null | undefined;
    77→  selectedShot: Shot | null;
    78→  availableLoras: LoraModel[];
    79→  /** Function to optimistically update generation mode cache (from useProjectGenerationModesCache) */
    80→  updateShotMode: (shotId: string, mode: 'batch' | 'timeline' | 'by-pair') => void;
    81→  children: React.ReactNode;
    82→}
    83→
    84→export const VideoTravelSettingsProvider: React.FC<VideoTravelSettingsProviderProps> = ({
    85→  projectId,
    86→  shotId,
    87→  selectedShot,
    88→  availableLoras,
    89→  updateShotMode,
    90→  children,
    91→}) => {
    92→  // Core settings hook - manages state + persistence
    93→  const shotSettings = useShotSettings(shotId, projectId);
    94→
    95→  // Create ref for handlers (they need ref to avoid recreation)
    96→  const shotSettingsRef = useRef(shotSettings);
    97→  shotSettingsRef.current = shotSettings;
    98→
    99→  // All handlers
   100→  const handlers = useVideoTravelSettingsHandlers({
   101→    shotSettingsRef,
   102→    currentShotId: shotId || null,
   103→    selectedShot,
   104→    updateShotMode,
   105→  });
   106→
   107→  // Memoize context value
   108→  const contextValue = useMemo<VideoTravelSettingsContextValue>(() => ({
   109→    settings: shotSettings.settings,
   110→    status: shotSettings.status,
   111→    isDirty: shotSettings.isDirty,
   112→    isLoading: shotSettings.status === 'loading' || shotSettings.status === 'idle',
   113→    shotId: shotSettings.shotId,
   114→    projectId: projectId || null,
   115→    handlers,
   116→    updateField: shotSettings.updateField,
   117→    updateFields: shotSettings.updateFields,
   118→    save: shotSettings.save,
   119→    saveImmediate: shotSettings.saveImmediate,
   120→    availableLoras,
   121→  }), [
   122→    shotSettings.settings,
   123→    shotSettings.status,
   124→    shotSettings.isDirty,
   125→    shotSettings.shotId,
   126→    shotSettings.updateField,
   127→    shotSettings.updateFields,
   128→    shotSettings.save,
   129→    shotSettings.saveImmediate,
   130→    projectId,
   131→    handlers,
   132→    availableLoras,
   133→  ]);
   134→
   135→  return (
   136→    <VideoTravelSettingsContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
   137→      {children}
   138→    </VideoTravelSettingsContext.Provider>
   139→  );
   140→};
   141→
   142→// =============================================================================
   143→// BASE HOOK - Full context access

   146→export function useVideoTravelSettings(): VideoTravelSettingsContextValue {
   147→  const ctx = useContext(VideoTravelSettingsContext);
   148→  if (!ctx) {

   167→    textAfterPrompts: settings.textAfterPrompts || '',
   168→    enhancePrompt: settings.enhancePrompt,

   171→    setTextBeforePrompts: handlers.handleTextBeforePromptsChange,
   172→    setTextAfterPrompts: handlers.handleTextAfterPromptsChange,
   173→    setEnhancePrompt: handlers.handleEnhancePromptChange,
   174→  }), [settings.prompt, settings.negativePrompt, settings.textBeforePrompts, settings.textAfterPrompts, settings.enhancePrompt, handlers]);
   175→}
   176→
   177→/**
   178→ * Motion-related settings
   179→ */
   180→export function useMotionSettings() {
   181→  const { settings, handlers, availableLoras } = useVideoTravelSettings();
   182→  return useMemo(() => ({

   185→    turboMode: settings.turboMode ?? false,

   193→}
   194→
   195→/**

   198→export function useFrameSettings() {
   199→  const { settings, handlers } = useVideoTravelSettings();

   207→

1→/**
     2→ * Settings Migration Utilities
     3→ *
     4→ * These utilities handle reading and writing settings in the unified format.
     5→ *
     6→ * SHOT SETTINGS (shots.settings['travel-between-images']):
     7→ * - prompt, negativePrompt, motionMode, amountOfMotion, phaseConfig,
     8→ *   selectedPhasePresetId, loras, numFrames, randomSeed, seed, etc.
     9→ *
    10→ * SEGMENT OVERRIDES (shot_generations.metadata.segmentOverrides):
    11→ * - prompt, negativePrompt, motionMode, amountOfMotion, phaseConfig,
    12→ *   selectedPhasePresetId, loras, numFrames, randomSeed, seed
    13→ *
    14→ * NOTE: Old field names (batchVideoPrompt, selectedLoras, pair_* fields) were

    36→// LORA MIGRATION

    38→
    39→/**
    40→ * Migrate LoRA from any format to LoraConfig.
    41→ * Handles both old ShotLora and new LoraConfig formats.
    42→ */
    43→function migrateLoraConfig(lora: Record<string, unknown>): LoraConfig {
    44→  return {
    45→    id: (lora.id as string) ?? (lora.path as string) ?? '',
    46→    name: (lora.name as string) ?? '',
    47→    path: (lora.path as string) ?? '',
    48→    strength: (lora.strength as number) ?? 1.0,
    49→    lowNoisePath: lora.lowNoisePath as string | undefined,
    50→    isMultiStage: lora.isMultiStage as boolean | undefined,
    51→    previewImageUrl: lora.previewImageUrl as string | undefined,
    52→    triggerWord: (lora.triggerWord as string) ?? (lora.trigger_word as string),
    53→  };
    54→}
    55→
    56→/**
    57→ * Migrate an array of LoRAs to the new format.
    58→ */
    59→function migrateLoras(loras: Record<string, unknown>[] | undefined | null): LoraConfig[] {
    60→  if (!loras || !Array.isArray(loras)) return [];
    61→  return loras.map(migrateLoraConfig);
    62→}
    63→
    64→function toRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null {
    65→  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return null;
    66→  return value as Record<string, unknown>;
    67→}
    68→
    69→function toString(value: unknown, fallback: string): string {
    70→  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : fallback;
    71→}
    72→
    73→function toNullableString(value: unknown, fallback: string | null): string | null {
    74→  if (value === null) return null;
    75→  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : fallback;
    76→}
    77→
    78→function toNumber(value: unknown, fallback: number): number {
    79→  return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : fallback;
    80→}
    81→
    82→function toOptionalNumber(value: unknown): number | undefined {
    83→  return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : undefined;
    84→}
    85→
    86→function toBoolean(value: unknown, fallback: boolean): boolean {
    87→  return typeof value === 'boolean' ? value : fallback;
    88→}

    91→  value: unknown,
    92→  fallback: SegmentSettings['motionMode']
    93→): SegmentSettings['motionMode'] {

    95→}
    96→
    97→function toGenerationTypeMode(
    98→  value: unknown,

   100→): ShotVideoSettings['generationTypeMode'] {

   113→ * Normalize motion amount to 0-100 scale.
   114→ * Old pair metadata stored 0-1, new format uses 0-100.

   116→function normalizeMotionAmount(value: number | undefined): number {
   117→  if (value === undefined) return DEFAULT_SEGMENT_SETTINGS.amountOfMotion;
   118→  // If value is <= 1, assume it's in 0-1 scale and convert

   132→export function readShotSettings(raw: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): ShotVideoSettings {
   133→  if (!raw) return { ...DEFAULT_SHOT_VIDEO_SETTINGS };
   134→
   135→  const settings: ShotVideoSettings = {

   144→    // Advanced config
   145→    phaseConfig: (toRecord(raw.phaseConfig) as unknown as SegmentSettings['phaseConfig']) ?? undefined,
   146→    selectedPhasePresetId: toNullableString(raw.selectedPhasePresetId, DEFAULT_SHOT_VIDEO_SETTINGS.selectedPhasePresetId),
   147→
   148→    // LoRAs (unified field name after DB migration)
   149→    loras: migrateLoras(raw.loras as Record<string, unknown>[] | undefined | null),
   150→
   151→    // Video
   152→    numFrames: toNumber(raw.numFrames, DEFAULT_SHOT_VIDEO_SETTINGS.numFrames),

   156→    seed: toOptionalNumber(raw.seed),
   157→
   158→    // Variant behavior

   160→
   161→    // Batch-specific
   162→    batchVideoFrames: toNumber(raw.batchVideoFrames, DEFAULT_SHOT_VIDEO_SETTINGS.batchVideoFrames),
   163→    textBeforePrompts: toString(raw.textBeforePrompts, DEFAULT_SHOT_VIDEO_SETTINGS.textBeforePrompts),
   164→    textAfterPrompts: toString(raw.textAfterPrompts, DEFAULT_SHOT_VIDEO_SETTINGS.textAfterPrompts),
   165→    enhancePrompt: toBoolean(raw.enhancePrompt, DEFAULT_SHOT_VIDEO_SETTINGS.enhancePrompt),
   166→    generationTypeMode: toGenerationTypeMode(raw.generationTypeMode, DEFAULT_SHOT_VIDEO_SETTINGS.generationTypeMode),
   167→  };

   169→  return settings;
   170→}

   172→// =============================================================================
   173→// SEGMENT/PAIR METADATA MIGRATION
   174→// =============================================================================
   175→
   176→/**
   177→ * Read segment overrides from metadata.
   178→ * Returns sparse SegmentOverrides with only overridden fields.
   179→ *
   180→ * @param metadata - Raw metadata object from shot_generations.metadata
   181→ * @returns Sparse SegmentOverrides (only fields that were set)
   182→ */
   183→export function readSegmentOverrides(metadata: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): SegmentOverrides {
   184→  if (!metadata) return {};
   185→
   186→  const overrides: SegmentOverrides = {};
   187→  const segmentOverrides = toRecord(metadata.segmentOverrides) ?? {};
   188→
   189→  // Prompt - include empty strings to distinguish "explicitly empty" from "no override"
   190→  if (segmentOverrides.prompt !== undefined) {
   191→    overrides.prompt = toString(segmentOverrides.prompt, '');
   192→  }
   193→
   194→  // Negative prompt - include empty strings to distinguish "explicitly empty" from "no override"
   195→  if (segmentOverrides.negativePrompt !== undefined) {
   196→    overrides.negativePrompt = toString(segmentOverrides.negativePrompt, '');
   197→  }
   198→
   199→  // Motion mode
   200→  if (segmentOverrides.motionMode !== undefined) {
   201→    overrides.motionMode = toMotionMode(segmentOverrides.motionMode, DEFAULT_SEGMENT_SETTINGS.motionMode);
   202→  }
   203→
   204→  // Motion amount (normalize to 0-100 scale)
   205→  if (segmentOverrides.amountOfMotion !== undefined) {
   206→    const motionAmount = toOptionalNumber(segmentOverrides.amountOfMotion);
   207→    if (motionAmount !== undefined) {
   208→      overrides.amountOfMotion = normalizeMotionAmount(motionAmount);
   209→    }
   210→  }
   211→
   212→  // Phase config
   213→  if (segmentOverrides.phaseConfig !== undefined) {
   214→    const phaseConfig = toRecord(segmentOverrides.phaseConfig) as unknown as SegmentSettings['phaseConfig'];
   215→    if (phaseConfig) {
   216→      overrides.phaseConfig = phaseConfig;
   217→    }
   218→  }
   219→
   220→  // Phase preset ID
   221→  if (segmentOverrides.selectedPhasePresetId !== undefined) {
   222→    overrides.selectedPhasePresetId = toNullableString(segmentOverrides.selectedPhasePresetId, null);
   223→  }
   224→
   225→  // LoRAs - include empty arrays to distinguish "explicitly no loras" from "no override"
   226→  if (segmentOverrides.loras !== undefined && Array.isArray(segmentOverrides.loras)) {
   227→    overrides.loras = migrateLoras(segmentOverrides.loras as Record<string, unknown>[]);
   228→  }
   229→
   230→  // Frame count
   231→  if (segmentOverrides.numFrames !== undefined) {
   232→    const numFrames = toOptionalNumber(segmentOverrides.numFrames);
   233→    if (numFrames !== undefined) {
   234→      overrides.numFrames = numFrames;
   235→    }
   236→  }
   237→
   238→  // Random seed
   239→  if (segmentOverrides.randomSeed !== undefined) {
   240→    overrides.randomSeed = toBoolean(segmentOverrides.randomSeed, DEFAULT_SEGMENT_SETTINGS.randomSeed);
   241→  }
   242→
   243→  // Seed
   244→  if (segmentOverrides.seed !== undefined) {
   245→    const seed = toOptionalNumber(segmentOverrides.seed);
   246→    if (seed !== undefined) {
   247→      overrides.seed = seed;
   248→    }
   249→  }
   250→
   251→  // Structure video overrides
   252→  if (segmentOverrides.structureMotionStrength !== undefined) {
   253→    const structureMotionStrength = toOptionalNumber(segmentOverrides.structureMotionStrength);
   254→    if (structureMotionStrength !== undefined) {
   255→      overrides.structureMotionStrength = structureMotionStrength;
   256→    }
   257→  }
   258→  if (segmentOverrides.structureTreatment !== undefined) {
   259→    const structureTreatment = toStructureTreatment(segmentOverrides.structureTreatment);
   260→    if (structureTreatment) {
   261→      overrides.structureTreatment = structureTreatment;
   262→    }
   263→  }
   264→  if (segmentOverrides.structureUni3cEndPercent !== undefined) {
   265→    const uni3cEndPercent = toOptionalNumber(segmentOverrides.structureUni3cEndPercent);
   266→    if (uni3cEndPercent !== undefined) {
   267→      overrides.structureUni3cEndPercent = uni3cEndPercent;
   268→    }
   269→  }
   270→
   271→  // Text before/after prompts
   272→  if (segmentOverrides.textBeforePrompts !== undefined) {
   273→    overrides.textBeforePrompts = toString(segmentOverrides.textBeforePrompts, '');
   274→  }
   275→  if (segmentOverrides.textAfterPrompts !== undefined) {
   276→    overrides.textAfterPrompts = toString(segmentOverrides.textAfterPrompts, '');
   277→  }
   278→
   279→  return overrides;
   280→}
   281→
   282→/**
   283→ * Write segment overrides to metadata in new format.
   284→ * MERGES with existing segmentOverrides - only updates fields present in overrides.
   285→ * Use `null` value to explicitly delete a field.
   286→ *
   287→ * @param currentMetadata - Current metadata object
   288→ * @param overrides - New segment overrides to write (null values delete the field)
   289→ * @returns Updated metadata object
   290→ */
   291→export function writeSegmentOverrides(
   292→  currentMetadata: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined,
   293→  overrides: SegmentOverrides
   294→): Record<string, unknown> {
   295→  const metadata = { ...(currentMetadata ?? {}) };
   296→
   297→  // Start with existing segmentOverrides (merge, not replace)
   298→  const existingOverrides = (metadata.segmentOverrides ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
   299→  const newOverrides = { ...existingOverrides };
   300→
   301→  // Update each field if present in overrides
   302→  // Use explicit undefined check so we can distinguish "not provided" from "set to value"
   303→  if (overrides.prompt !== undefined) {
   304→    newOverrides.prompt = overrides.prompt;
   305→  }
   306→  if (overrides.negativePrompt !== undefined) {
   307→    newOverrides.negativePrompt = overrides.negativePrompt;
   308→  }
   309→  if (overrides.motionMode !== undefined) {
   310→    newOverrides.motionMode = overrides.motionMode;
   311→  }
   312→  if (overrides.amountOfMotion !== undefined) {
   313→    newOverrides.amountOfMotion = overrides.amountOfMotion;
   314→  }
   315→  if (overrides.phaseConfig !== undefined) {
   316→    newOverrides.phaseConfig = overrides.phaseConfig;
   317→  }
   318→  if (overrides.selectedPhasePresetId !== undefined) {
   319→    newOverrides.selectedPhasePresetId = overrides.selectedPhasePresetId;
   320→  }
   321→  if (overrides.loras !== undefined) {
   322→    newOverrides.loras = overrides.loras;  // Preserve empty arrays to distinguish "no loras" from "use shot default"
   323→  }
   324→  if (overrides.numFrames !== undefined) {
   325→    newOverrides.numFrames = overrides.numFrames;
   326→  }
   327→  if (overrides.randomSeed !== undefined) {
   328→    newOverrides.randomSeed = overrides.randomSeed;
   329→  }
   330→  if (overrides.seed !== undefined) {
   331→    newOverrides.seed = overrides.seed;
   332→  }
   333→  // Structure video overrides
   334→  if (overrides.structureMotionStrength !== undefined) {
   335→    newOverrides.structureMotionStrength = overrides.structureMotionStrength;
   336→  }
   337→  if (overrides.structureTreatment !== undefined) {
   338→    newOverrides.structureTreatment = overrides.structureTreatment;
   339→  }
   340→  if (overrides.structureUni3cEndPercent !== undefined) {
   341→    newOverrides.structureUni3cEndPercent = overrides.structureUni3cEndPercent;
   342→  }
   343→  // Text before/after prompts
   344→  if (overrides.textBeforePrompts !== undefined) {
   345→    newOverrides.textBeforePrompts = overrides.textBeforePrompts;
   346→  }
   347→  if (overrides.textAfterPrompts !== undefined) {
   348→    newOverrides.textAfterPrompts = overrides.textAfterPrompts;
   349→  }
   350→
   351→  metadata.segmentOverrides = newOverrides;
   352→
   353→  // Clean up empty segmentOverrides
   354→  if (Object.keys(newOverrides).length === 0) {
   355→    delete metadata.segmentOverrides;
   356→  }
   357→
   358→  return metadata;
   359→}

    55→
    56→  const { userId, amount, description, isWelcomeBonus = false } = body;
    57→  if (!userId || !amount || typeof amount !== 'number' || amount <= 0) {

   163→      }
   164→
   165→      // given_credits is now true — we own the grant. Insert credit into ledger.
   166→      const { data: ledgerEntry, error: ledgerError } = await adminClient

   168→        .insert({
   169→          user_id: userId,
   170→          amount: amount * 100, // Convert dollars to cents
   171→          type: 'manual',
   172→          metadata: {

   252→/**
   253→ * Aggregate daily buckets into weekly buckets (Mon-Sun weeks)
   254→ */
   255→function aggregateByWeek(buckets: DayBucket[]): DayBucket[] {
   256→  const weekMap = new Map<string, DayBucket>();
   257→
   258→  for (const bucket of buckets) {
   259→    const date = new Date(bucket.date + "T00:00:00Z");
   260→    // Get Monday of this week
   261→    const day = date.getUTCDay();
   262→    const diff = day === 0 ? -6 : 1 - day; // Monday = 1
   263→    const monday = new Date(date);
   264→    monday.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate() + diff);
   265→    const [REDACTED]().substring(0, 10);
   266→
   267→    if (!weekMap.has(weekKey)) {
   268→      weekMap.set(weekKey, { date: weekKey, images_generated: 0, images_edited: 0, videos_generated: 0 });
   269→    }
   270→    const week = weekMap.get(weekKey)!;
   271→    week.images_generated += bucket.images_generated;
   272→    week.images_edited += bucket.images_edited;
   273→    week.videos_generated += bucket.videos_generated;
   274→  }
   275→
   276→  return Array.from(weekMap.values()).sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
   277→}

1→import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
     2→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     3→import type { LoraCategory } from '../../types';
     4→import { getLoraCategoryForModel } from '../../types';
     5→import type { ActiveLora } from '@/shared/types/lora';
     6→import type { LegacyMigrationsInput } from './types';
     7→
     8→type LoraCategoryMigrationInput = Pick<
     9→  LegacyMigrationsInput,
    10→  'projectImageSettings' | 'selectedProjectId' | 'updateProjectImageSettings'
    11→>;
    12→
    13→/**
    14→ * Migrates `selectedLorasByTextModel` (per-model LoRA selections) to
    15→ * `selectedLorasByCategory` (per-category: 'qwen' | 'z-image').
    16→ *
    17→ * All qwen-family models share the 'qwen' category, so the migration
    18→ * merges their LoRAs (deduped by id) into a single list.
    19→ */
    20→export function useLoraCategoryMigration(input: LoraCategoryMigrationInput): void {
    21→  const {
    22→    projectImageSettings,
    23→    selectedProjectId,
    24→    updateProjectImageSettings,
    25→  } = input;
    26→
    27→  const migrationAttemptedRef = useRef<Record<string, boolean>>({});
    28→
    29→  useEffect(() => {
    30→    const migrate = async () => {
    31→      if (!projectImageSettings || !selectedProjectId) {
    32→        return;
    33→      }
    34→
    35→      if (migrationAttemptedRef.current[selectedProjectId]) {
    36→        return;
    37→      }
    38→
    39→      // Only migrate if old format exists and new format doesn't
    40→      if (!projectImageSettings.selectedLorasByTextModel || projectImageSettings.selectedLorasByCategory) {
    41→        migrationAttemptedRef.current[selectedProjectId] = true;
    42→        return;
    43→      }
    44→
    45→      migrationAttemptedRef.current[selectedProjectId] = true;
    46→
    47→      // Convert per-text-model selections to per-category
    48→      const byCategory: Record<LoraCategory, ActiveLora[]> = {
    49→        'qwen': [],
    50→        'z-image': [],
    51→      };
    52→
    53→      const seenIds: Record<LoraCategory, Set<string>> = {
    54→        'qwen': new Set(),
    55→        'z-image': new Set(),
    56→      };
    57→
    58→      for (const [model, loras] of Object.entries(projectImageSettings.selectedLorasByTextModel)) {
    59→        const category = getLoraCategoryForModel(model as Parameters<typeof getLoraCategoryForModel>[0]);
    60→        for (const lora of loras) {
    61→          if (!seenIds[category].has(lora.id)) {
    62→            seenIds[category].add(lora.id);
    63→            byCategory[category].push(lora);
    64→          }
    65→        }
    66→      }
    67→
    68→      try {
    69→        await updateProjectImageSettings('project', {
    70→          selectedLorasByCategory: byCategory,
    71→          selectedLorasByTextModel: undefined,
    72→        });

    75→          context: 'ImageGenerationForm.migrateLoraCategoryFormat',
    76→          showToast: false,
    77→        });
    78→        migrationAttemptedRef.current[selectedProjectId] = false;
    79→      }
    80→    };
    81→
    82→    void migrate();
    83→  }, [projectImageSettings, selectedProjectId, updateProjectImageSettings]);
    84→}

1→import { AppError, isNetworkError, SilentError } from './errors';
     2→
     3→const DEFAULT_ERROR_TITLES: Record<string, string> = {
     4→  NetworkError: 'Connection Error',
     5→  AuthError: 'Authentication Required',
     6→  ValidationError: 'Invalid Input',
     7→  ServerError: 'Server Error',
     8→  AppError: 'Error',
     9→};
    10→
    11→export function logAppError(context: string, appError: AppError): void {
    12→  if (appError instanceof SilentError) {
    13→    return;
    14→  }
    15→
    16→  const tag = `[${context}]`;
    17→  console.error(`${tag} ${appError.name}:`, appError.message, {
    18→    errorType: appError.name,
    19→    cause: appError.cause?.message,
    20→    ...appError.context,
    21→  });
    22→}
    23→
    24→export function getErrorTitle(appError: AppError, override?: string): string {
    25→  return override ?? DEFAULT_ERROR_TITLES[appError.name] ?? DEFAULT_ERROR_TITLES.AppError;
    26→}
    27→
    28→export function getErrorDescription(appError: AppError): string {
    29→  if (!isNetworkError(appError)) {
    30→    return appError.message;
    31→  }
    32→
    33→  if (appError.isOffline) {

    59→      [REDACTED](projectId)

    64→    });
    65→    
    66→    return {

    69→    };
    70→  },

     7→
     8→/**
     9→ * Edge function: update-shot-pair-prompts
    10→ * 
    11→ * Updates the shot_generations.metadata.enhanced_prompt field for all positioned
    12→ * images in a shot with the provided enhanced prompts array.
    13→ * 
    14→ * POST /functions/v1/update-shot-pair-prompts
    15→ * Headers: Authorization: Bearer <Service Role Key or PAT>
    16→ * Body: {
    17→ *   "shot_id": "uuid-string",           // Shot ID to update
    18→ *   "task_id": "uuid-string",           // Optional: Task ID for log association
    19→ *   "enhanced_prompts": [               // Array of enhanced prompts (one per image)
    20→ *     "Detailed VLM description...",
    21→ *     "",                               // Empty strings are skipped
    22→ *     "Another description..."
    23→ *   ]
    24→ * }
    25→ * 
    26→ * Returns:
    27→ * - 200 OK with updated shot_generations count
    28→ * - 400 Bad Request if missing required fields
    29→ * - 401 Unauthorized if no valid token
    30→ * - 403 Forbidden if user doesn't own the shot
    31→ * - 404 Not Found if shot doesn't exist
    32→ * - 500 Internal Server Error
    33→ */
    34→
    35→serve((req) => withEdgeRequest(req, {
    36→  functionName: "update-shot-pair-prompts",
    37→  logPrefix: "[UPDATE-SHOT-PAIR-PROMPTS]",
    38→  parseBody: "strict",
    39→  auth: {
    40→    required: true,
    41→  },
    42→}, async ({ supabaseAdmin, logger, body: requestBody, auth }) => {
    43→  const isServiceRole = auth!.isServiceRole;
    44→  const callerId = auth!.userId;
    45→
    46→  // Validate required fields
    47→  const shot_id = typeof requestBody.shot_id === "string" ? requestBody.shot_id : null;
    48→  const task_id = typeof requestBody.task_id === "string" ? requestBody.task_id : null;
    49→  const enhancedPrompts = Array.isArray(requestBody.enhanced_prompts)
    50→    ? requestBody.enhanced_prompts.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === "string")
    51→    : null;
    52→  
    53→  // Set task_id for all subsequent logs if provided
    54→  if (task_id) {
    55→    logger.setDefaultTaskId(task_id);
    56→    logger.info("Task ID associated with request", { task_id, shot_id });
    57→  }
    58→  
    59→  if (!shot_id) {
    60→    logger.error("Missing required field: shot_id");
    61→    return jsonResponse({ error: "Missing required field: shot_id" }, 400);
    62→  }
    63→  if (!enhancedPrompts) {
    64→    logger.error("Missing or invalid required field: enhanced_prompts", { 
    65→      shot_id,
    66→      hasEnhancedPrompts: Array.isArray(requestBody.enhanced_prompts),
    67→      isArray: Array.isArray(requestBody.enhanced_prompts),
    68→    });
    69→    return jsonResponse({ error: "Missing or invalid required field: enhanced_prompts (must be array)" }, 400);
    70→  }
    71→
    72→  // Verify shot ownership if user token
    73→  if (!isServiceRole && callerId) {
    74→    const ownershipResult = await verifyShotOwnership(
    75→      supabaseAdmin,
    76→      shot_id,
    77→      callerId,
    78→      "[UPDATE-SHOT-PAIR-PROMPTS]",
    79→    );
    80→
    81→    if (!ownershipResult.success) {
    82→      logger.error("Shot ownership verification failed", {
    83→        shot_id,
    84→        userId: callerId,
    85→        error: ownershipResult.error,
    86→      });
    87→      return jsonResponse({ error: ownershipResult.error || "Forbidden" }, ownershipResult.statusCode || 403);
    88→    }
    89→
    90→    logger.info("Shot ownership verified", { shot_id, userId: callerId });
    91→  }
    92→
    93→  logger.info("Processing shot", {
    94→    shot_id,
    95→    enhancedPromptsCount: enhancedPrompts.length,
    96→  });
    97→
    98→  // Get all shot_generations for this shot, filtering for images with timeline_frame
    99→  const { data: shotGenerations, error: sgError } = await supabaseAdmin
   100→    .from("shot_generations")
   101→    .select(`
   102→      id,
   103→      generation_id,
   104→      timeline_frame,
   105→      metadata,
   106→      generation:generations!shot_generations_generation_id_generations_id_fk(
   107→        id,
   108→        type,
   109→        location
   110→      )
   111→    `)
   112→    .eq("shot_id", shot_id)
   113→    .not("timeline_frame", "is", null)
   114→    // Deterministic ordering: Timeline sorts by timeline_frame; add a stable tie-breaker.
   115→    .order("timeline_frame", { ascending: true })
   116→    .order("id", { ascending: true });
   117→
   118→  if (sgError) {
   119→    logger.error("Error fetching shot_generations", {
   120→      shot_id,
   121→      error: sgError.message,
   122→    });
   123→    return jsonResponse({ error: `Database error: ${sgError.message}` }, 500);
   124→  }
   125→
   126→  if (!shotGenerations || shotGenerations.length === 0) {
   127→    logger.warn("No shot_generations found for shot", { shot_id });
   128→    return jsonResponse({
   129→      success: true,
   130→      message: "No positioned images found for this shot",
   131→      updated_count: 0,
   132→    }, 200);
   133→  }
   134→
   135→  // Use shared timeline eligibility contract to keep edge behavior aligned with Timeline UI.
   136→  const imageGenerations = shotGenerations.filter((sg) => {
   137→    const generation = sg.generation as { type?: string | null; location?: string | null } | null;
   138→    return isTimelineEligiblePositionedImage({
   139→      timeline_frame: sg.timeline_frame,
   140→      type: generation?.type ?? null,
   141→      location: generation?.location ?? null,

   157→      shot_id,
   158→      imageCount: imageGenerations.length,
   159→      expectedPromptCount,
   160→      actualPromptCount: enhancedPrompts.length,
   161→      note: 'Enhanced prompts describe transitions between images (N-1 prompts for N images)',
   162→    });
   163→  }
   164→
   165→  if (imageGenerations.length === 0) {
   166→    logger.info("No image generations found for shot", { shot_id });
   167→    return jsonResponse({
   168→      success: true,
   169→      message: "No image generations found for this shot",
   170→      updated_count: 0,
   171→    }, 200);
   172→  }
   173→
   174→  // Update each shot_generation's metadata with the corresponding enhanced_prompt
   175→  // Image at index i gets enhanced_prompts[i] (describes transition FROM this image TO the next)
   176→  const updatePromises = imageGenerations.map(async (sg, index) => {
   177→    const existingMetadata = sg.metadata || {};
   178→    const enhancedPrompt = index < enhancedPrompts.length ? enhancedPrompts[index] : undefined;
   179→
   180→    // Skip if enhanced_prompt is empty/falsy (expected for last image)
   181→    if (!enhancedPrompt) {
   182→      logger.debug("Skipping shot_generation (no prompt for this index)", {
   183→        shot_id,
   184→        shotGenerationId: sg.id.substring(0, 8),
   185→        index,
   186→        timeline_frame: sg.timeline_frame,
   187→        reason: index >= enhancedPrompts.length ? 'last_image_no_transition' : 'empty_prompt',
   188→      });
   189→      return { id: sg.id, success: true, skipped: true };
   190→    }
   191→
   192→    const updatedMetadata = {
   193→      ...existingMetadata,
   194→      enhanced_prompt: enhancedPrompt,
   195→    };
   196→
   197→    logger.debug("Updating shot_generation with enhanced_prompt", {
   198→      shot_id,
   199→      shotGenerationId: sg.id.substring(0, 8),
   200→      index,
   201→      timeline_frame: sg.timeline_frame,
   202→      promptPreview: enhancedPrompt.substring(0, 80) + (enhancedPrompt.length > 80 ? '...' : ''),
   203→    });
   204→
   205→    const { error: updateError } = await supabaseAdmin
   206→      .from("shot_generations")
   207→      .update({ metadata: updatedMetadata })
   208→      .eq("id", sg.id);
   209→
   210→    if (updateError) {
   211→      logger.error("Error updating shot_generation", {
   212→        shot_id,
   213→        shotGenerationId: sg.id.substring(0, 8),
   214→        error: updateError.message,
   215→      });
   216→      return { id: sg.id, success: false, error: updateError.message };
   217→    }
   218→
   219→    return { id: sg.id, success: true };
   220→  });
   221→
   222→  const results = await Promise.all(updatePromises);
   223→  const successCount = results.filter((r) => r.success).length;
   224→  const failedCount = results.filter((r) => !r.success).length;
   225→  const skippedCount = results.filter((r) => (r as { skipped?: boolean }).skipped).length;
   226→
   227→  logger.info("Update complete", {
   228→    shot_id,
   229→    total: results.length,
   230→    success: successCount,
   231→    failed: failedCount,
   232→    skipped: skippedCount,
   233→  });
   234→
   235→  return jsonResponse({
   236→    success: true,
   237→    message: `Updated ${successCount - skippedCount} shot_generation(s) with enhanced prompts`,
   238→    updated_count: successCount - skippedCount,
   239→    skipped_count: skippedCount,
   240→    failed_count: failedCount,
   241→    shot_id,
   242→  }, 200);
   243→}));
   244→

   228→function applyAtomicShotCacheUpdate(input: {
   229→  selectedProjectId: string;
   230→  shotId: string;
   231→  shotName: string;
   232→  shotGenerationId: string;
   233→  generationId: string;
   234→  generationPreview?: GenerationPreviewInput;
   235→  shots: Shot[] | undefined;
   236→  queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>;
   237→}): void {
   238→  const {
   239→    selectedProjectId,
   240→    shotId,
   241→    shotName,
   242→    shotGenerationId,
   243→    generationId,
   244→    generationPreview,
   245→    shots,
   246→    queryClient,
   247→  } = input;
   248→
   249→  const updateShotCache = (oldShots: Shot[] = []) => {
   250→    if (oldShots.some((shot) => shot.id === shotId)) {
   251→      return oldShots;
   252→    }
   253→
   254→    const maxPosition = oldShots.reduce((max, shot) => {
   255→      const position = typeof shot.position === 'number' ? shot.position : 0;
   256→      return Math.max(max, position);
   257→    }, 0);
   258→
   259→    const optimisticImage: GenerationRow = {
   260→      id: shotGenerationId,
   261→      generation_id: generationId,
   262→      imageUrl: generationPreview?.imageUrl,
   263→      thumbUrl: generationPreview?.thumbUrl,
   264→      type: generationPreview?.type ?? undefined,
   265→      location: generationPreview?.location ?? generationPreview?.imageUrl ?? undefined,
   266→      timeline_frame: 0,
   267→      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
   268→      isOptimistic: true,
   269→    };
   270→
   271→    const newShot: Shot = {
   272→      id: shotId,
   273→      name: shotName,
   274→      images: [optimisticImage],
   275→      project_id: selectedProjectId,
   276→      position: maxPosition + 1,
   277→      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
   278→    };

1→import { ServerError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errors';
     2→import type { TaskCreationResult } from './types';
     3→
     4→interface TaskCreationContext {
     5→  requestId: string;
     6→  taskType: string;
     7→  projectId: string;
     8→}
     9→
    10→function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
    11→  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
    12→}
    13→
    14→export function parseTaskCreationResponse(
    15→  payload: unknown,
    16→  context: TaskCreationContext,
    17→): TaskCreationResult {
    18→  if (!isRecord(payload)) {
    19→    throw new ServerError('Task creation returned an invalid response', {
    20→      context,
    21→    });
    22→  }
    23→
    24→  const taskId = typeof payload.task_id === 'string' ? payload.task_id.trim() : '';
    25→  if (!taskId) {
    26→    const inlineError = typeof payload.error === 'string' ? payload.error.trim() : '';
    27→    throw new ServerError(inlineError || 'Task creation failed before returning a task id', {
    28→      context: {
    29→        ...context,
    30→        responseStatus: typeof payload.status === 'string' ? payload.status : 'unknown',
    31→      },
    32→    });
    33→  }
    34→
    35→  const status = typeof payload.status === 'string' && payload.status.trim().length > 0
    36→    ? payload.status
    37→    : 'pending';
    38→
    39→  return {
    40→    task_id: taskId,
    41→    status,
    42→  };
    43→}
    44→

     4→ * Creates a new generation record from an existing variant.
     5→ * This allows variants to be promoted to standalone generations that can

    40→  }

    42→}
    43→
    44→/**
    45→ * Hook for promoting a variant to a standalone generation

    47→export const usePromoteVariantToGeneration = () => {
    48→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    49→
    50→  return useMutation({
    51→    mutationFn: async ({
    52→      variantId,
    53→      projectId,
    54→    }: PromoteVariantParams): Promise<PromotedGeneration> => {
    55→      // 1. Fetch the variant — its generation_id is the single source of truth for lineage
    56→      const { data: variant, error: variantError } = await supabase().from('generation_variants')
    57→        .select('*')
    58→        .eq('id', variantId)
    59→        .single();
    60→
    61→      if (variantError || !variant) {
    62→        throw new Error(`Failed to fetch variant: ${variantError?.message || 'Not found'}`);
    63→      }
    64→

    66→      if (!sourceGenerationId) {
    67→        throw new Error('Variant is missing generation_id');
    68→      }

    70→      // 2. Determine if this is a video or image based on the URL
    71→      const isVideo = hasVideoExtension(variant.location);
    72→      const mediaType = isVideo ? 'video' : 'image';
    73→
    74→      // 3. Create new generation record
    75→      // Strip generation_id from variant params — if it leaks into the new generation's params,
    76→      // generationTransformers spreads params into metadata, and getGenerationId() reads
    77→      // metadata.generation_id (priority 2) over media.id (priority 3), causing the lightbox
    78→      // to fetch variants for the SOURCE generation instead of the new one.
    79→      const {

    81→        source_task_id: _stripTaskId,

    92→        project_id: projectId,

    95→        params: {

    97→          source: 'variant_promotion',
    98→          source_variant_id: variantId,
    99→          source_generation_id: sourceGenerationId,
   100→          tool_type: toolType,
   101→          promoted_at: new Date().toISOString(),
   102→        },
   103→      };

     4→ * Single source of truth for ALL shot creation in the app.
     5→ * Handles:
     6→ * - Empty shots (name only)
     7→ * - Shots with a generation (atomic RPC)
     8→ * - Shots with files (upload + add)
     9→ * 
    10→ * Automatically handles:
    11→ * - Settings inheritance (runs in background)
    12→ * - Last affected shot tracking
    13→ * - Optimistic UI events (skeleton display)
    14→ * - Error handling with cleanup
    15→ * 
    16→ * @see CLAUDE.md - Settings/persistence → settings_system.md
    17→ */
    18→

    60→
    61→  /**

   227→
   228→function applyAtomicShotCacheUpdate(input: {
   229→  selectedProjectId: string;
   230→  shotId: string;
   231→  shotName: string;
   232→  shotGenerationId: string;
   233→  generationId: string;
   234→  generationPreview?: GenerationPreviewInput;
   235→  shots: Shot[] | undefined;
   236→  queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>;
   237→}): void {
   238→  const {
   239→    selectedProjectId,
   240→    shotId,
   241→    shotName,
   242→    shotGenerationId,
   243→    generationId,
   244→    generationPreview,
   245→    shots,
   246→    queryClient,
   247→  } = input;
   248→
   249→  const updateShotCache = (oldShots: Shot[] = []) => {
   250→    if (oldShots.some((shot) => shot.id === shotId)) {
   251→      return oldShots;
   252→    }
   253→
   254→    const maxPosition = oldShots.reduce((max, shot) => {
   255→      const position = typeof shot.position === 'number' ? shot.position : 0;
   256→      return Math.max(max, position);
   257→    }, 0);
   258→
   259→    const optimisticImage: GenerationRow = {
   260→      id: shotGenerationId,
   261→      generation_id: generationId,
   262→      imageUrl: generationPreview?.imageUrl,
   263→      thumbUrl: generationPreview?.thumbUrl,
   264→      type: generationPreview?.type ?? undefined,
   265→      location: generationPreview?.location ?? generationPreview?.imageUrl ?? undefined,
   266→      timeline_frame: 0,
   267→      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
   268→      isOptimistic: true,
   269→    };
   270→
   271→    const newShot: Shot = {
   272→      id: shotId,
   273→      name: shotName,
   274→      images: [optimisticImage],
   275→      project_id: selectedProjectId,
   276→      position: maxPosition + 1,
   277→      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
   278→    };
   279→
   280→    return [...oldShots, newShot];
   281→  };
   282→
   283→  queryClient.setQueryData<Shot[]>(shotQueryKeys.list(selectedProjectId, 0), updateShotCache);
   284→  queryClient.setQueryData<Shot[]>(shotQueryKeys.list(selectedProjectId, 5), updateShotCache);
   285→  queryClient.setQueryData<Shot[]>([...shotQueryKeys.all, selectedProjectId], updateShotCache);
   286→  queryClient.setQueryData(shotQueryKeys.detail(shotId), (old: Shot | undefined) => old ?? ({
   287→    id: shotId,
   288→    name: shotName,
   289→    images: [],
   290→    project_id: selectedProjectId,
   291→    position: (shots?.reduce((max, shot) => Math.max(max, shot.position || 0), 0) ?? 0) + 1,
   292→    created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
   293→  } as Shot));
   294→}
   295→
   296→async function createShotWithGenerationPath(input: CreateShotWithGenerationPathInput): Promise<ShotCreationResult> {
   297→  const {
   298→    selectedProjectId,
   299→    shotName,
   300→    generationId,
   301→    generationPreview,
   302→    shots,
   303→    queryClient,
   304→    createShotWithImage,
   305→  } = input;
   306→
   307→  const rpcResult = await createShotWithImage({
   308→    projectId: selectedProjectId,
   309→    shotName,
   310→    generationId,
   311→  });
   312→
   313→  applyAtomicShotCacheUpdate({
   314→    selectedProjectId,
   315→    shotId: rpcResult.shotId,
   316→    shotName: rpcResult.shotName || shotName,
   317→    shotGenerationId: rpcResult.shotGenerationId,
   318→    generationId,
   319→    generationPreview,
   320→    shots,
   321→    queryClient,
   322→  });
   323→
   324→  return {
   325→    shotId: rpcResult.shotId,
   326→    shotName: rpcResult.shotName,
   327→    generationIds: [generationId],
   328→  };
   329→}
   330→
   331→async function createShotWithFilesPath(input: CreateShotWithFilesPathInput): Promise<ShotCreationResult> {
   332→  const {
   333→    selectedProjectId,
   334→    shotName,
   335→    files,
   336→    aspectRatio,
   337→    shots,
   338→    onProgress,
   339→    createShot,
   340→    uploadToShot,
   341→  } = input;
   342→
   343→  const created = await createShot({
   344→    name: shotName,
   345→    projectId: selectedProjectId,
   346→    aspectRatio: aspectRatio || undefined,
   347→    shouldSelectAfterCreation: false,
   348→  });
   349→
   350→  const newShotId = created?.shot?.id;
   351→  if (!newShotId) {
   352→    throw new Error('Shot creation failed - no ID returned');
   353→  }
   354→
   355→  const uploadResult = await uploadToShot({
   356→    imageFiles: files,
   357→    targetShotId: newShotId,
   358→    [REDACTED],
   359→    currentShotCount: shots?.length ?? 0,
   360→    onProgress,
   361→  });
   362→
   363→  if (!uploadResult?.shotId) {
   364→    throw new Error('File upload failed - no images processed');
   365→  }
   366→
   367→  return {
   368→    shotId: newShotId,
   369→    shotName: created.shot?.name || shotName,
   370→    shot: created.shot,
   371→    generationIds: uploadResult.generationIds,
   372→  };
   373→}
   374→
   375→async function createEmptyShotPath(input: CreateEmptyShotPathInput): Promise<ShotCreationResult> {
   376→  const { selectedProjectId, shotName, aspectRatio, createShot } = input;
   377→
   378→  const createResult = await createShot({
   379→    name: shotName,
   380→    projectId: selectedProjectId,
   381→    aspectRatio: aspectRatio || undefined,
   382→    shouldSelectAfterCreation: false,
   383→  });
   384→
   385→  if (!createResult?.shot?.id) {
   386→    throw new Error('Shot creation failed - no ID returned');
   387→  }
   388→
   389→  return {
   390→    shotId: createResult.shot.id,
   391→    shotName: createResult.shot.name || shotName,
   392→    shot: createResult.shot,
   393→  };
   394→}
   395→
   396→function dispatchShotSkeletonEvent(imageCount: number): void {
   397→  dispatchAppEvent('shot-pending-create', { imageCount });
   398→}
   399→
   400→function clearShotSkeletonEvent(): void {
   401→  dispatchAppEvent('shot-pending-create-clear');
   402→}
   403→
   404→function useShotCreationPostEffects(params: {
   405→  selectedProjectId: string | null;
   406→  shots: Shot[] | undefined;
   407→  setLastAffectedShotId: (shotId: string) => void;
   408→  setLastCreatedShot: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<{ id: string; name: string } | null>>;
   409→}) {
   410→  const { selectedProjectId, shots, setLastAffectedShotId, setLastCreatedShot } = params;
   411→
   412→  return useCallback((result: ShotCreationResult, options: CreateShotOptions) => {
   413→    const {
   414→      inheritSettings = true,
   415→      updateLastAffected = true,
   416→    } = options;
   417→
   418→    if (updateLastAffected) {
   419→      setLastAffectedShotId(result.shotId);
   420→    }
   421→
   422→    if (inheritSettings && selectedProjectId) {
   423→      inheritSettingsForNewShot({
   424→        newShotId: result.shotId,
   425→        projectId: selectedProjectId,
   426→        shots: (shots || []) as Array<{ id: string; name: string; created_at?: string; settings?: Record<string, unknown> }>,
   427→      });
   428→    }
   429→
   430→    setLastCreatedShot({ id: result.shotId, name: result.shotName });
   431→  }, [selectedProjectId, shots, setLastAffectedShotId, setLastCreatedShot]);
   432→}
   433→
   434→function useCreateShotAction(input: UseCreateShotActionInput): UseShotCreationReturn['createShot'] {
   435→  const {
   436→    selectedProjectId,
   437→    shots,
   438→    queryClient,
   439→    setIsCreating,
   440→    generateShotName,
   441→    applyPostCreationEffects,
   442→    createShotMutation,
   443→    createShotWithImageMutation,
   444→    handleExternalImageDropMutation,
   445→  } = input;
   446→
   447→  return useCallback(async (options: CreateShotOptions = {}): Promise<ShotCreationResult | null> => {
   448→    if (!selectedProjectId) {
   449→      toast.error('No project selected');
   450→      return null;
   451→    }
   452→
   453→    const {
   454→      name,
   455→      generationId,
   456→      generationPreview,
   457→      files,
   458→      aspectRatio,
   459→      dispatchSkeletonEvents = true,
   460→      onProgress,
   461→    } = options;
   462→    const shotName = name || generateShotName();
   463→    const imageCount = files?.length || (generationId ? 1 : 0);
   464→
   465→    if (dispatchSkeletonEvents && imageCount > 0) {
   466→      dispatchShotSkeletonEvent(imageCount);
   467→    }
   468→
   469→    setIsCreating(true);
   470→
   471→    try {
   472→      let result: ShotCreationResult;
   473→      if (generationId && !files?.length) {
   474→        result = await createShotWithGenerationPath({
   475→          selectedProjectId,
   476→          shotName,
   477→          generationId,
   478→          generationPreview,
   479→          shots,
   480→          queryClient,
   481→          createShotWithImage: createShotWithImageMutation,
   482→        });
   483→      } else if (files?.length) {
   484→        result = await createShotWithFilesPath({
   485→          selectedProjectId,
   486→          shotName,
   487→          files,
   488→          aspectRatio,
   489→          shots,
   490→          onProgress,
   491→          createShot: createShotMutation,
   492→          uploadToShot: handleExternalImageDropMutation,
   493→        });
   494→      } else {
   495→        result = await createEmptyShotPath({
   496→          selectedProjectId,
   497→          shotName,
   498→          aspectRatio,
   499→          createShot: createShotMutation,
   500→        });
   501→      }
   502→
   503→      applyPostCreationEffects(result, options);
   504→      options.onSuccess?.(result);
   505→      return result;
   506→    } catch (error) {
   507→      if (dispatchSkeletonEvents) {
   508→        clearShotSkeletonEvent();
   509→      }
   510→
   511→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   512→        context: 'useShotCreation',
   513→        toastTitle: 'Failed to create shot',
   514→      });
   515→      return null;
   516→    } finally {
   517→      setIsCreating(false);
   518→    }
   519→  }, [
   520→    selectedProjectId,
   521→    shots,
   522→    queryClient,
   523→    setIsCreating,
   524→    generateShotName,
   525→    applyPostCreationEffects,
   526→    createShotMutation,
   527→    createShotWithImageMutation,
   528→    handleExternalImageDropMutation,
   529→  ]);
   530→}
   531→
   532→// ============================================================================
   533→// HOOK IMPLEMENTATION
   534→// ============================================================================
   535→
   536→export function useShotCreation(): UseShotCreationReturn {
   537→  const { selectedProjectId } = useProject();
   538→  const { shots } = useShots();
   539→  const { setLastAffectedShotId } = useLastAffectedShot();
   540→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   541→
   542→  const createShotMutation = useCreateShot();
   543→  const createShotWithImageMutation = useCreateShotWithImage();
   544→  const handleExternalImageDropMutation = useHandleExternalImageDrop();
   545→
   546→  const [isCreating, setIsCreating] = useState(false);
   547→  const [lastCreatedShot, setLastCreatedShot] = useState<{ id: string; name: string } | null>(null);
   548→
   549→  const clearLastCreated = useCallback(() => {
   550→    setLastCreatedShot(null);
   551→  }, []);
   552→
   553→  const generateShotName = useCallback(() => {
   554→    const count = shots?.length ?? 0;
   555→    return `Shot ${count + 1}`;
   556→  }, [shots]);
   557→
   558→  const applyPostCreationEffects = useShotCreationPostEffects({
   559→    selectedProjectId,
   560→    shots,
   561→    setLastAffectedShotId,
   562→    setLastCreatedShot,
   563→  });
   564→
   565→  const createShot = useCreateShotAction({
   566→    selectedProjectId,
   567→    shots,
   568→    queryClient,
   569→    setIsCreating,
   570→    generateShotName,
   571→    applyPostCreationEffects,
   572→    createShotMutation: createShotMutation.mutateAsync,
   573→    createShotWithImageMutation: createShotWithImageMutation.mutateAsync,
   574→    handleExternalImageDropMutation: handleExternalImageDropMutation.mutateAsync,
   575→  });
   576→
   577→  return {
   578→    createShot,
   579→    isCreating,
   580→    lastCreatedShot,
   581→    clearLastCreated,
   582→  };
   583→}
   584→
   585→// NOTE: Default export removed - use named export { useShotCreation } instead
   586→

    12→ */
    13→
    14→// ── helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    15→
    16→function pluralize(n: number, singular: string, plural: string): string {
    17→  return `${n} ${n === 1 ? singular : plural}`;
    18→}
    19→
    20→export interface FormatClockTimeOptions {
    21→  showMilliseconds?: boolean;
    22→  millisecondsDigits?: 1 | 2 | 3;
    23→}
    24→
    25→export function formatTime(
    26→  seconds: number,
    27→  options: FormatClockTimeOptions = {},
    28→): string {
    29→  const { showMilliseconds = false, millisecondsDigits = 1 } = options;
    30→
    31→  if (!Number.isFinite(seconds) || seconds < 0) {
    32→    return showMilliseconds ? '0:00.0' : '0:00';
    33→  }
    34→
    35→  const mins = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
    36→  const secs = Math.floor(seconds % 60);
    37→  const base = `${mins}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
    38→
    39→  if (!showMilliseconds) {
    40→    return base;
    41→  }
    42→
    43→  const divisor = Math.pow(10, 3 - millisecondsDigits);
    44→  const ms = Math.floor((seconds % 1) * 1000 / divisor);
    45→  return `${base}.${ms.toString().padStart(millisecondsDigits, '0')}`;
    46→}
    47→
    48→// ── precise duration from a Date ─────────────────────────────────────────
    49→
    50→export interface FormatRelativeDurationOptions {
    51→  /** Include days in the output (default true). When false, hours keep accumulating. */
    52→  includeDays?: boolean;
    53→}
    54→
    55→/**
    56→ * Format the duration between `date` and *now* as an abbreviated string.
    57→ *
    58→ * Examples:
    59→ *  - 30 s  → "<1 min"
    60→ *  - 5 min → "5 mins"
    61→ *  - 90 min → "1 hr, 30 mins"
    62→ *  - 48 h  → "2 days"
    63→ *  - 25 h  → "1 day, 1 hr"
    64→ */
    65→export function formatRelativeDuration(
    66→  date: Date,
    67→  options?: FormatRelativeDurationOptions,
    68→): string {
    69→  const { includeDays = true } = options ?? {};
    70→
    71→  const diffMs = Date.now() - date.getTime();
    72→  const totalMinutes = Math.floor(diffMs / 60_000);
    73→
    74→  if (totalMinutes < 1) return '<1 min';
    75→
    76→  if (totalMinutes < 60) return pluralize(totalMinutes, 'min', 'mins');
    77→
    78→  if (!includeDays) {
    79→    const hours = Math.floor(totalMinutes / 60);
    80→    const remainingMinutes = totalMinutes % 60;
    81→    if (remainingMinutes === 0) return pluralize(hours, 'hr', 'hrs');
    82→    return `${pluralize(hours, 'hr', 'hrs')}, ${pluralize(remainingMinutes, 'min', 'mins')}`;
    83→  }
    84→
    85→  // < 24 hours — show hours + minutes
    86→  if (totalMinutes < 24 * 60) {
    87→    const hours = Math.floor(totalMinutes / 60);
    88→    const remainingMinutes = totalMinutes % 60;
    89→    if (remainingMinutes === 0) return pluralize(hours, 'hr', 'hrs');
    90→    return `${pluralize(hours, 'hr', 'hrs')}, ${pluralize(remainingMinutes, 'min', 'mins')}`;
    91→  }
    92→
    93→  // >= 24 hours — show days + hours
    94→  const days = Math.floor(totalMinutes / (24 * 60));
    95→  const remainingHours = Math.floor((totalMinutes % (24 * 60)) / 60);
    96→  if (remainingHours === 0) return pluralize(days, 'day', 'days');
    97→  return `${pluralize(days, 'day', 'days')}, ${pluralize(remainingHours, 'hr', 'hrs')}`;
    98→}
    99→
   100→// ── abbreviate a date-fns "formatDistanceToNow" string ───────────────────
   101→
   102→/**
   103→ * Shorten a `formatDistanceToNow(..., { addSuffix: true })` result.
   104→ *
   105→ * "less than a minute ago" → "<1 min ago"
   106→ * "about 2 hours ago"      → "2 hrs ago"
   107→ * "3 minutes ago"           → "3 mins ago"
   108→ */
   109→export function abbreviateRelativeTime(str: string): string {
   110→  // Handle singular special-cases first (date-fns may prefix with "about")
   111→  if (str.includes('1 hr') || str.includes('1 hour'))   return '1 hr ago';
   112→  if (str.includes('1 day'))                             return '1 day ago';
   113→  if (str.includes('less than a minute'))                return '<1 min ago';
   114→  if (str.includes('1 minute'))                          return '1 min ago';
   115→  if (str.includes('1 second'))                          return '1 sec ago';
   116→
   117→  // General abbreviation
   118→  return str
   119→    .replace(/^about /, '')
   120→    .replace(/minutes?/, 'mins')
   121→    .replace(/hours?/, 'hrs')
   122→    .replace(/seconds?/, 'secs')
   123→    .replace(/\bday\b/, 'days');
   124→}
   125→
